  <script id="shared-zip-builder-js" type="text/plain">
// Universal Pure-JS ZIP Builder (Works in Node.js & Browser without native dependencies)
class SimpleZip {
  constructor() {
    this.files = [];
    this.crcTable = this.makeCRCTable();
  }

  makeCRCTable() {
    const table = new Uint32Array(256);
    for (let n = 0; n < 256; n++) {
      let c = n;
      for (let k = 0; k < 8; k++) {
        c = (c & 1) ? (0xEDB88320 ^ (c >>> 1)) : (c >>> 1);
      }
      table[n] = c;
    }
    return table;
  }

  crc32(uint8Arr) {
    let crc = 0 ^ (-1);
    for (let i = 0; i < uint8Arr.length; i++) {
      crc = (crc >>> 8) ^ this.crcTable[(crc ^ uint8Arr[i]) & 0xFF];
    }
    return (crc ^ (-1)) >>> 0;
  }

  addFile(path, uint8Data) {
    const nameBytes = new TextEncoder().encode(path);
    const data = uint8Data instanceof Uint8Array ? uint8Data : new Uint8Array(uint8Data);
    const crc = this.crc32(data);
    this.files.push({ nameBytes, data, crc, size: data.length });
  }

  addTextFile(path, textContent) {
    this.addFile(path, new TextEncoder().encode(String(textContent || "")));
  }

  generateUint8Array() {
    let offset = 0;
    const chunks = [];
    const centralHeaders = [];
    const now = new Date();
    const dosTime = ((now.getHours() << 11) | (now.getMinutes() << 5) | (now.getSeconds() >> 1)) & 0xFFFF;
    const dosDate = (((now.getFullYear() - 1980) << 9) | ((now.getMonth() + 1) << 5) | now.getDate()) & 0xFFFF;

    for (const file of this.files) {
      const nameLen = file.nameBytes.length;
      const lh = new Uint8Array(30 + nameLen);
      const lv = new DataView(lh.buffer);
      lv.setUint32(0, 0x04034b50, true);
      lv.setUint16(4, 20, true);
      lv.setUint16(6, 0x0800, true);
      lv.setUint16(8, 0, true);
      lv.setUint16(10, dosTime, true);
      lv.setUint16(12, dosDate, true);
      lv.setUint32(14, file.crc, true);
      lv.setUint32(18, file.size, true);
      lv.setUint32(22, file.size, true);
      lv.setUint16(26, nameLen, true);
      lv.setUint16(28, 0, true);
      lh.set(file.nameBytes, 30);
      chunks.push(lh, file.data);

      const ch = new Uint8Array(46 + nameLen);
      const cv = new DataView(ch.buffer);
      cv.setUint32(0, 0x02014b50, true);
      cv.setUint16(4, 20, true);
      cv.setUint16(6, 20, true);
      cv.setUint16(8, 0x0800, true);
      cv.setUint16(10, 0, true);
      cv.setUint16(12, dosTime, true);
      cv.setUint16(14, dosDate, true);
      cv.setUint32(16, file.crc, true);
      cv.setUint32(20, file.size, true);
      cv.setUint32(24, file.size, true);
      cv.setUint16(28, nameLen, true);
      cv.setUint32(42, offset, true);
      ch.set(file.nameBytes, 46);
      centralHeaders.push(ch);

      offset += lh.length + file.size;
    }

    let centralSize = 0;
    for (const ch of centralHeaders) {
      chunks.push(ch);
      centralSize += ch.length;
    }

    const eocd = new Uint8Array(22);
    const ev = new DataView(eocd.buffer);
    ev.setUint32(0, 0x06054b50, true);
    ev.setUint16(8, this.files.length, true);
    ev.setUint16(10, this.files.length, true);
    ev.setUint32(12, centralSize, true);
    ev.setUint32(16, offset, true);
    chunks.push(eocd);

    const totalLen = chunks.reduce((acc, arr) => acc + arr.length, 0);
    const out = new Uint8Array(totalLen);
    let pos = 0;
    for (const arr of chunks) {
      out.set(arr, pos);
      pos += arr.length;
    }
    return out;
  }

  generateBuffer() {
    return Buffer.from(this.generateUint8Array());
  }

  generateBlob() {
    return new Blob([this.generateUint8Array()], { type: "application/zip" });
  }
}

if (typeof module !== "undefined" && module.exports) {
  module.exports = SimpleZip;
}
if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
  window.SimpleZip = SimpleZip;
}
  </script>

  <script id="srv-database-js" type="text/plain">
const fs = require("fs");
const path = require("path");

const DATA_DIR = path.join(__dirname, "data");
const DB_FILE = path.join(DATA_DIR, "chats_db.json");
const SETTINGS_FILE = path.join(DATA_DIR, "settings.json");

if (!fs.existsSync(DATA_DIR)) {
  fs.mkdirSync(DATA_DIR, { recursive: true });
}

class ArchiveDatabase {
  constructor() {
    this.chats = new Map();
    this.streamBuffers = new Map();
    this.settings = {
      geminiKeys: process.env.GEMINI_API_KEYS
        ? process.env.GEMINI_API_KEYS.split(",").map(k => k.trim()).filter(Boolean)
        : [],
      apiSecret: process.env.API_SECRET || ""
    };
    this.loadFromDisk();
  }

  loadFromDisk() {
    try {
      if (fs.existsSync(DB_FILE)) {
        const raw = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(DB_FILE, "utf8"));
        (raw || []).forEach(c => this.chats.set(c.chatId, c));
      }
      if (fs.existsSync(SETTINGS_FILE)) {
        const s = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(SETTINGS_FILE, "utf8"));
        if (s.geminiKeys && s.geminiKeys.length) this.settings.geminiKeys = s.geminiKeys;
        if (s.apiSecret !== undefined) this.settings.apiSecret = s.apiSecret;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("[DB] Warning loading disk files:", e.message);
    }
  }

  persistChats() {
    try {
      const arr = Array.from(this.chats.values());
      fs.writeFileSync(DB_FILE, JSON.stringify(arr, null, 2), "utf8");
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("[DB] Persist error:", e.message);
    }
  }

  saveSettings(newSettings) {
    if (Array.isArray(newSettings.geminiKeys)) {
      this.settings.geminiKeys = newSettings.geminiKeys.map(k => k.trim()).filter(Boolean);
    }
    if (newSettings.apiSecret !== undefined) {
      this.settings.apiSecret = String(newSettings.apiSecret).trim();
    }
    fs.writeFileSync(SETTINGS_FILE, JSON.stringify(this.settings, null, 2), "utf8");
    return this.settings;
  }

  appendStreamChunk({ chatId, platform, title, url, messagesChunk = [], attachmentsChunk = [] }) {
    if (!this.streamBuffers.has(chatId)) {
      this.streamBuffers.set(chatId, {
        chatId,
        platform: platform || "Gemini",
        title: title || "Chat",
        url: url || "",
        date: new Date().toLocaleString("ar-EG"),
        timestamp: Date.now(),
        messagesMap: new Map(),
        attachmentsMap: new Map()
      });
    }
    const buf = this.streamBuffers.get(chatId);
    if (title) buf.title = title;
    if (url) buf.url = url;

    messagesChunk.forEach(m => {
      const key = m.key || m.index || (m.role + "_" + String(m.text).slice(0, 40));
      buf.messagesMap.set(key, m);
    });

    attachmentsChunk.forEach(a => {
      if (a && a.id) buf.attachmentsMap.set(a.id, a);
    });

    return {
      chatId,
      bufferedMessages: buf.messagesMap.size,
      bufferedAttachments: buf.attachmentsMap.size
    };
  }

  finalizeStreamedChat(chatId, directChatObj = null) {
    let finalObj = directChatObj;
    if (!finalObj && this.streamBuffers.has(chatId)) {
      const buf = this.streamBuffers.get(chatId);
      const messages = Array.from(buf.messagesMap.values()).map((m, idx) => ({
        index: idx + 1,
        role: m.role,
        text: m.text
      }));
      const attachments = Array.from(buf.attachmentsMap.values());
      finalObj = {
        chatId: buf.chatId,
        platform: buf.platform,
        title: buf.title,
        url: buf.url,
        date: buf.date,
        timestamp: Date.now(),
        messageCount: messages.length,
        messages,
        attachments,
        aiCapsule: "",
        extractedFiles: []
      };
      this.streamBuffers.delete(chatId);
    }

    if (!finalObj) return null;
    const existing = this.chats.get(finalObj.chatId);
    if (existing && !finalObj.aiCapsule && existing.aiCapsule) {
      finalObj.aiCapsule = existing.aiCapsule;
    }
    this.chats.set(finalObj.chatId, finalObj);
    this.persistChats();
    return finalObj;
  }

  getChat(chatId) {
    return this.chats.get(chatId) || null;
  }

  getAllChats(platformFilter = "") {
    let list = Array.from(this.chats.values()).sort((a, b) => (b.timestamp || 0) - (a.timestamp || 0));
    if (platformFilter) {
      list = list.filter(c => c.platform.toLowerCase() === platformFilter.toLowerCase());
    }
    return list;
  }

  deleteChat(chatId) {
    const existed = this.chats.delete(chatId);
    if (existed) this.persistChats();
    return existed;
  }
}

module.exports = new ArchiveDatabase();
  </script>

  <script id="srv-gemini-service-js" type="text/plain">
// Smart Gemini AI Service with Multi-Key Rotation, Context Capsule & Final Code Extractor
class GeminiService {
  constructor(db) {
    this.db = db;
    this.keyIndex = 0;
  }

  getNextApiKey() {
    const keys = this.db.settings.geminiKeys || [];
    if (!keys.length) return null;
    const key = keys[this.keyIndex % keys.length];
    this.keyIndex = (this.keyIndex + 1) % keys.length;
    return key;
  }

  async callGemini(promptText, inlineImageBase64 = null, mimeType = "image/png") {
    const keys = this.db.settings.geminiKeys || [];
    if (!keys.length) {
      throw new Error("لم يتم إضافة مفتاح Gemini API في الإعدادات بعد.");
    }

    let lastErr = null;
    for (let attempt = 0; attempt < keys.length; attempt++) {
      const apiKey = this.getNextApiKey();
      try {
        const parts = [{ text: promptText }];
        if (inlineImageBase64) {
          const cleanB64 = inlineImageBase64.includes(",") ? inlineImageBase64.split(",")[1] : inlineImageBase64;
          parts.push({ inline_data: { mime_type: mimeType, data: cleanB64 } });
        }

        const url = `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemini-2.5-flash:generateContent?key=${apiKey}`;
        const res = await fetch(url, {
          method: "POST",
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
          body: JSON.stringify({ contents: [{ parts }] })
        });

        const data = await res.json();
        if (!res.ok) {
          throw new Error(data.error ? data.error.message : `HTTP ${res.status}`);
        }
        const reply = data?.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts?.[0]?.text;
        if (reply) return reply.trim();
      } catch (err) {
        lastErr = err;
      }
    }
    throw lastErr || new Error("فشل الاتصال بجميع مفاتيح Gemini المتاحة.");
  }

  async generateContextCapsule(chatObj) {
    const transcript = (chatObj.messages || [])
      .map(m => `[${m.role} #${m.index}]:\n${m.text}`)
      .join("\n\n")
      .slice(-28000);

    const prompt = [
      "أنت مهندس برمجيات ومحلل سياق محترف. قم بتحليل هذه المحادثة وإنشاء (كبسولة استعادة السياق الفورية) باللغة العربية بحيث لو رفع المستخدم هذا الملف لنموذج ذكاء اصطناعي جديد يفهم كل شيء في ثوانٍ.",
      "يجب أن تتضمن الكبسولة الأقسام التالية بوضوح:",
      "1. 🎯 الهدف الأساسي للمشروع أو النقاش.",
      "2. ✅ أهم القرارات والمواصفات التقنية التي تم اعتمادها.",
      "3. 💻 جرد لأحدث الملفات والأكواد النهائية المعتمدة في المحادثة (تجاهل النسخ القديمة الملغاة).",
      "4. 📍 نقطة التوقف الأخيرة والخطوة المطلوبة تالياً.",
      "",
      "نص المحادثة:",
      transcript
    ].join("\n");

    return await this.callGemini(prompt);
  }

  extractCodeBlocksFromChat(chatObj) {
    const codeFiles = [];
    const extMap = {
      javascript: "js", js: "js", python: "py", py: "py",
      html: "html", css: "css", json: "json", sql: "sql",
      bash: "sh", sh: "sh", typescript: "ts", ts: "ts"
    };

    const regex = /```([a-zA-Z0-9_-]*)\r?\n([\s\S]*?)```/g;
    (chatObj.messages || []).forEach((m) => {
      let match;
      let blockIdx = 1;
      while ((match = regex.exec(m.text)) !== null) {
        const lang = (match[1] || "txt").toLowerCase();
        const code = (match[2] || "").trim();
        if (code.length < 30) continue;
        const ext = extMap[lang] || "txt";
        const fileName = `MSG${String(m.index).padStart(3, "0")}_Code${blockIdx}.${ext}`;
        codeFiles.push({
          fileName,
          zipPath: `Extracted_Code/${fileName}`,
          lang,
          msgIndex: m.index,
          content: code
        });
        blockIdx++;
      }
    });
    return codeFiles;
  }

  async askAcrossArchive(question) {
    const allChats = this.db.getAllChats();
    if (!allChats.length) return "لا توجد محادثات في الأرشيف للبحث فيها بعد.";

    const contextDigest = allChats.slice(0, 15).map(c => {
      const lastMsgs = (c.messages || []).slice(-4).map(m => `${m.role}: ${m.text.slice(0, 400)}`).join("\n");
      return `=== محادثة: ${c.title} (${c.platform} | ID: ${c.chatId}) ===\nالملخص: ${c.aiCapsule || "لا يوجد"}\nمقتطفات:\n${lastMsgs}`;
    }).join("\n\n");

    const prompt = `بناءً على أرشيف محادثات المستخدم التالي، أجب بدقة عن سؤاله مع ذكر اسم المحادثة ومعرفها (ID):\n\nسؤال المستخدم: ${question}\n\nالأرشيف:\n${contextDigest}`;
    return await this.callGemini(prompt);
  }
}

module.exports = GeminiService;
  </script>

  <script id="srv-server-js" type="text/plain">
const express = require("express");
const cors = require("cors");
const path = require("path");
const db = require("./database");
const GeminiService = require("./gemini_service");
const SimpleZip = require("./zip_builder");

const app = express();
const PORT = process.env.PORT || 3000;
const gemini = new GeminiService(db);

app.use(cors());
app.use(express.json({ limit: "50mb" }));
app.use(express.static(path.join(__dirname, "public")));

app.get("/api/status", (req, res) => {
  const chats = db.getAllChats();
  const gemCount = chats.filter(c => c.platform === "Gemini").length;
  const gptCount = chats.filter(c => c.platform === "ChatGPT").length;
  res.json({
    ok: true,
    version: "8.0.0-Wispyte-Cloud",
    totalChats: chats.length,
    geminiChats: gemCount,
    gptChats: gptCount,
    configuredKeysCount: (db.settings.geminiKeys || []).length
  });
});

app.post("/api/settings", (req, res) => {
  const { geminiKeys, apiSecret } = req.body || {};
  const updated = db.saveSettings({ geminiKeys, apiSecret });
  res.json({
    ok: true,
    configuredKeysCount: updated.geminiKeys.length,
    message: `تم حفظ ${updated.geminiKeys.length} مفتاح Gemini API بنجاح!`
  });
});

app.post("/api/stream-chunk", (req, res) => {
  try {
    const result = db.appendStreamChunk(req.body || {});
    res.json({ ok: true, ...result });
  } catch (err) {
    res.status(500).json({ ok: false, error: err.message });
  }
});

app.post("/api/save-chat", async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { chatId, generateAiCapsule = true, ...payload } = req.body || {};
    const finalChat = db.finalizeStreamedChat(chatId, payload.messages ? { chatId, ...payload } : null);
    if (!finalChat) {
      return res.status(400).json({ ok: false, error: "لم يتم العثور على بيانات المحادثة." });
    }

    finalChat.extractedFiles = gemini.extractCodeBlocksFromChat(finalChat);

    if (generateAiCapsule && (db.settings.geminiKeys || []).length > 0) {
      try {
        finalChat.aiCapsule = await gemini.generateContextCapsule(finalChat);
      } catch (aiErr) {
        finalChat.aiCapsule = `تعذر توليد الكبسولة تلقائياً: ${aiErr.message}`;
      }
    }

    db.finalizeStreamedChat(finalChat.chatId, finalChat);
    res.json({
      ok: true,
      chatId: finalChat.chatId,
      messageCount: finalChat.messageCount,
      extractedCodeCount: finalChat.extractedFiles.length,
      aiCapsule: finalChat.aiCapsule
    });
  } catch (err) {
    res.status(500).json({ ok: false, error: err.message });
  }
});

app.post("/api/chats/:chatId/generate-capsule", async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const chat = db.getChat(req.params.chatId);
    if (!chat) return res.status(404).json({ ok: false, error: "المحادثة غير موجودة" });
    chat.aiCapsule = await gemini.generateContextCapsule(chat);
    db.finalizeStreamedChat(chat.chatId, chat);
    res.json({ ok: true, aiCapsule: chat.aiCapsule });
  } catch (err) {
    res.status(500).json({ ok: false, error: err.message });
  }
});

app.get("/api/chats", (req, res) => {
  const platform = req.query.platform || "";
  const q = (req.query.q || "").toLowerCase().trim();
  let chats = db.getAllChats(platform);

  if (q) {
    chats = chats.filter(c =>
      (c.title || "").toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      (c.aiCapsule || "").toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      (c.messages || []).some(m => (m.text || "").toLowerCase().includes(q))
    );
  }

  res.json({
    ok: true,
    chats: chats.map(c => ({
      chatId: c.chatId,
      platform: c.platform,
      title: c.title,
      url: c.url,
      date: c.date,
      timestamp: c.timestamp,
      messageCount: c.messageCount,
      attachmentCount: (c.attachments || []).length,
      extractedCodeCount: (c.extractedFiles || []).length,
      aiCapsule: c.aiCapsule || ""
    }))
  });
});

app.delete("/api/chats/:chatId", (req, res) => {
  db.deleteChat(req.params.chatId);
  res.json({ ok: true });
});

app.post("/api/ask-archive", async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const answer = await gemini.askAcrossArchive(req.body.question || "");
    res.json({ ok: true, answer });
  } catch (err) {
    res.status(500).json({ ok: false, error: err.message });
  }
});

function buildStandaloneTxt(chatsList, label = "ARCHIVE") {
  const dateStamp = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  const zipName = `AI_Chats_${label}_${dateStamp}_Attachments.zip`;
  const gemCount = chatsList.filter(c => c.platform === "Gemini").length;
  const gptCount = chatsList.filter(c => c.platform === "ChatGPT").length;
  const totalMsgs = chatsList.reduce((a, c) => a + (c.messageCount || 0), 0);
  const totalAtts = chatsList.reduce((a, c) => a + (c.attachments ? c.attachments.length : 0), 0);

  let out = "";
  out += "================================================================================\n";
  out += "         ☁️ أرشيف محادثات الذكاء الاصطناعي السحابي (WISPYTE AI ARCHIVE V8)\n";
  out += "================================================================================\n";
  out += `• تاريخ التصدير: ${new Date().toLocaleString("ar-EG")}\n`;
  out += `• إجمالي المحادثات: ${chatsList.length} (${totalMsgs} رسالة) | Gemini: ${gemCount} | ChatGPT: ${gptCount}\n`;
  out += `• ملف الـ ZIP المرفق للصور والأكواد المستخرجة: ${totalAtts > 0 ? zipName : "متاح عند الطلب"}\n`;
  out += "--------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n";
  out += "💡 [توجيه للذكاء الاصطناعي]: يحتوي هذا الملف في بداية كل محادثة على (كبسولة استعادة السياق)\n";
  out += "التي تلخص الهدف والقرارات والأكواد النهائية، يليها النص الكامل للمحادثة وبطاقات المرفقات.\n";
  out += "================================================================================\n\n";

  chatsList.forEach((chat, idx) => {
    out += `╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗\n`;
    out += `  محادثة (#${idx + 1}) | المنصة: [${chat.platform}] | المعرف: ${chat.chatId}\n`;
    out += `  العنوان: ${chat.title} | التاريخ: ${chat.date}\n`;
    out += `  الرابط: ${chat.url}\n`;
    out += `╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝\n\n`;

    if (chat.aiCapsule) {
      out += `┏━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🧠 [كبسولة استعادة السياق الذكية - Gemini AI] ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┓\n`;
      out += `${chat.aiCapsule}\n`;
      out += `┗━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┛\n\n`;
    }

    (chat.messages || []).forEach(m => {
      const speaker = m.role === "User"
        ? `👤 [المستخدم -> ${chat.platform}] (رسالة #${m.index})`
        : `🤖 [${m.role}] (رد #${m.index})`;
      out += `${speaker}:\n${m.text}\n\n--------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n`;
    });

    out += `\n════════════════════ [نهاية محادثة #${idx + 1} (${chat.chatId})] ════════════════════\n\n\n`;
  });

  return out;
}

app.get("/api/export/txt", (req, res) => {
  const { chatId, platform } = req.query;
  let list = [];
  let label = "ALL";

  if (chatId) {
    const c = db.getChat(chatId);
    if (c) list = [c];
    label = chatId;
  } else {
    list = db.getAllChats(platform || "");
    if (platform) label = platform.toUpperCase();
  }

  const txtContent = buildStandaloneTxt(list, label);
  const filename = `AI_Chats_${label}_${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.txt`;
  res.setHeader("Content-Type", "text/plain; charset=utf-8");
  res.setHeader("Content-Disposition", `attachment; filename="${filename}"`);
  res.send(txtContent);
});

app.get("/api/export/zip", async (req, res) => {
  const { chatId, platform } = req.query;
  let list = [];
  let label = "ALL";

  if (chatId) {
    const c = db.getChat(chatId);
    if (c) list = [c];
    label = chatId;
  } else {
    list = db.getAllChats(platform || "");
    if (platform) label = platform.toUpperCase();
  }

  const zip = new SimpleZip();
  const indexManifest = { exportDate: new Date().toISOString(), chatsCount: list.length, attachments: [], codeFiles: [] };

  for (const chat of list) {
    const codes = chat.extractedFiles && chat.extractedFiles.length
      ? chat.extractedFiles
      : gemini.extractCodeBlocksFromChat(chat);

    codes.forEach(cf => {
      const pathInZip = `${chat.platform}_${chat.chatId}/${cf.zipPath}`;
      zip.addTextFile(pathInZip, cf.content);
      indexManifest.codeFiles.push({ chatId: chat.chatId, pathInZip, lang: cf.lang });
    });

    for (const att of (chat.attachments || [])) {
      indexManifest.attachments.push(att);
      if (att.dataUrl && att.dataUrl.includes(",")) {
        const b64 = att.dataUrl.split(",")[1];
        zip.addFile(att.zipPath, Buffer.from(b64, "base64"));
      } else {
        zip.addTextFile(att.zipPath + ".url.txt", `Original URL: ${att.originalUrl}\nAlt: ${att.alt}`);
      }
    }
  }

  zip.addTextFile("archive_manifest.json", JSON.stringify(indexManifest, null, 2));
  const zipBuf = zip.generateBuffer();
  const filename = `AI_Chats_${label}_${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}_Attachments_And_Code.zip`;
  res.setHeader("Content-Type", "application/zip");
  res.setHeader("Content-Disposition", `attachment; filename="${filename}"`);
  res.send(zipBuf);
});

app.listen(PORT, "0.0.0.0", () => {
  console.log(`🚀 Wispyte AI Cloud Archiver V8 running on http://0.0.0.0:${PORT}`);
});
  </script>

  <script id="srv-public-index-html" type="text/plain">
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ar" dir="rtl">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Wispyte AI Cloud Archiver V8 - لوحة التحكم السحابية</title>
  <style>
    :root {
      --bg: #090d16; --card: #131c2e; --border: #263554;
      --text: #f8fafc; --muted: #94a3b8; --accent: #38bdf8;
      --gem: #2563eb; --gpt: #10b981;
    }
    * { box-sizing: border-box; }
    body { margin: 0; padding: 20px; background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); font-family: 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; }
    .container { max-width: 1020px; margin: 0 auto; }
    .top-bar { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); padding-bottom: 14px; margin-bottom: 18px; }
    .top-bar h1 { margin: 0; font-size: 21px; color: var(--accent); }
    .stats-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr)); gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 18px; }
    .stat-card { background: var(--card); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 12px; padding: 14px; }
    .stat-card .lbl { color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; }
    .stat-card .val { font-size: 20px; font-weight: bold; margin-top: 4px; }
    .panel { background: var(--card); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px; margin-bottom: 18px; }
    .panel h3 { margin: 0 0 10px 0; font-size: 15px; color: var(--accent); }
    input, textarea, select { width: 100%; background: #090d16; color: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px; font-family: inherit; font-size: 13px; }
    button { border: none; border-radius: 8px; padding: 9px 14px; font-family: inherit; font-weight: bold; font-size: 12.5px; cursor: pointer; color: #fff; transition: filter 0.15s; }
    button:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); }
    .btn-blue { background: var(--gem); }
    .btn-green { background: var(--gpt); color: #052e16; }
    .btn-sky { background: #0284c7; }
    .btn-amber { background: #f59e0b; color: #090d16; }
    .btn-red { background: rgba(239,68,68,0.2); color: #fca5a5; border: 1px solid rgba(239,68,68,0.4); }
    .chat-card { background: var(--card); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px; margin-bottom: 12px; }
    .chat-header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; }
    .badge { padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: bold; }
    .badge-gem { background: var(--gem); }
    .badge-gpt { background: var(--gpt); color: #052e16; }
    .capsule-box { background: #090d16; border: 1px solid #1e293b; border-right: 3px solid var(--accent); padding: 12px; border-radius: 8px; margin-top: 10px; font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1.65; white-space: pre-wrap; color: #cbd5e1; }
    .actions-bar { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-top: 12px; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="container">
    <div class="top-bar">
      <h1>☁️ Wispyte AI Cloud Archiver (V8)</h1>
      <div style="display:flex; gap:8px; flex-wrap:wrap;">
        <button class="btn-sky" onclick="window.location.href='/api/export/txt'">📥 تحميل كل الأرشيف (TXT)</button>
        <button class="btn-blue" onclick="window.location.href='/api/export/txt?platform=Gemini'">🟦 تحميل Gemini (TXT)</button>
        <button class="btn-green" onclick="window.location.href='/api/export/txt?platform=ChatGPT'">🟩 تحميل ChatGPT (TXT)</button>
        <button class="btn-amber" onclick="window.location.href='/api/export/zip'">📦 تحميل كل المرفقات والأكواد (ZIP)</button>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="stats-row">
      <div class="stat-card"><div class="lbl">📚 إجمالي المحادثات السحابية</div><div class="val" id="stTotal">0</div></div>
      <div class="stat-card"><div class="lbl">🟦 محادثات Google Gemini</div><div class="val" id="stGem" style="color:#60a5fa;">0</div></div>
      <div class="stat-card"><div class="lbl">🟩 محادثات OpenAI ChatGPT</div><div class="val" id="stGpt" style="color:#4ade80;">0</div></div>
      <div class="stat-card"><div class="lbl">🔑 مفاتيح Gemini API النشطة</div><div class="val" id="stKeys" style="color:#fbbf24;">0</div></div>
    </div>

    <div style="display:grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(320px, 1fr)); gap:14px;">
      <div class="panel">
        <h3>🔑 إعداد تدوير مفاتيح Gemini API (يدعم حتى 20 مفتاحاً)</h3>
        <textarea id="keysInput" rows="2" placeholder="ضع مفاتيح Gemini API مفصولة بفاصلة (AIzaSy..., AIzaSy...)"></textarea>
        <button class="btn-blue" style="margin-top:8px; width:100%;" onclick="saveKeys()">💾 حفظ وتفعيل مفاتيح الذكاء الاصطناعي</button>
      </div>

      <div class="panel">
        <h3>🤖 اسأل الذكاء الاصطناعي داخل أرشيف محادثاتك</h3>
        <div style="display:flex; gap:8px;">
          <input type="text" id="askInput" placeholder="مثال: ما هو الكود النهائي الذي وصلنا له في محادثة البوت؟">
          <button class="btn-green" onclick="askArchive()">اسأل</button>
        </div>
        <div id="askAnswer" class="capsule-box" style="display:none;"></div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="panel" style="display:flex; gap:10px; align-items:center;">
      <input type="text" id="searchBox" placeholder="🔍 ابحث في عناوين المحادثات، الرسائل، أو كبسولات السياق..." oninput="loadChats()">
      <select id="platformFilter" style="width:180px;" onchange="loadChats()">
        <option value="">كل المنصات (Gemini + GPT)</option>
        <option value="Gemini">🟦 Gemini فقط</option>
        <option value="ChatGPT">🟩 ChatGPT فقط</option>
      </select>
    </div>

    <div id="chatsList">جاري الاتصال بقاعدة بيانات Wispyte...</div>
  </div>

  <script>
    async function loadStats() {
      const res = await fetch('/api/status');
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.ok) {
        document.getElementById('stTotal').textContent = data.totalChats;
        document.getElementById('stGem').textContent = data.geminiChats;
        document.getElementById('stGpt').textContent = data.gptChats;
        document.getElementById('stKeys').textContent = data.configuredKeysCount + ' مفتاح';
      }
    }

    async function saveKeys() {
      const raw = document.getElementById('keysInput').value;
      const geminiKeys = raw.split(/[,\n]+/).map(k => k.trim()).filter(Boolean);
      const res = await fetch('/api/settings', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ geminiKeys })
      });
      const data = await res.json();
      alert(data.message || 'تم الحفظ');
      loadStats();
    }

    async function askArchive() {
      const question = document.getElementById('askInput').value.trim();
      if (!question) return;
      const box = document.getElementById('askAnswer');
      box.style.display = 'block';
      box.textContent = '⏳ جاري البحث في الأرشيف وتحليل الإجابة عبر Gemini...';
      const res = await fetch('/api/ask-archive', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ question })
      });
      const data = await res.json();
      box.textContent = data.ok ? data.answer : ('❌ خطأ: ' + data.error);
    }

    async function regenerateCapsule(chatId) {
      const el = document.getElementById('cap-' + chatId);
      if (el) el.textContent = '⏳ جاري قراءة المحادثة وتوليد كبسولة استعادة السياق عبر Gemini...';
      const res = await fetch(`/api/chats/${chatId}/generate-capsule`, { method: 'POST' });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (el) el.textContent = data.ok ? data.aiCapsule : ('❌ ' + data.error);
    }

    async function deleteChat(chatId) {
      if (!confirm('هل تريد حذف هذه المحادثة من السيرفر؟')) return;
      await fetch(`/api/chats/${chatId}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
      loadStats();
      loadChats();
    }

    async function loadChats() {
      const q = encodeURIComponent(document.getElementById('searchBox').value.trim());
      const platform = encodeURIComponent(document.getElementById('platformFilter').value);
      const res = await fetch(`/api/chats?q=${q}&platform=${platform}`);
      const data = await res.json();
      const container = document.getElementById('chatsList');

      if (!data.chats || !data.chats.length) {
        container.innerHTML = '<div class="panel" style="text-align:center; color:#94a3b8;">لا توجد محادثات مطابقة في السيرفر حالياً.</div>';
        return;
      }

      container.innerHTML = data.chats.map(c => `
        <div class="chat-card">
          <div class="chat-header">
            <div>
              <span class="badge ${c.platform === 'Gemini' ? 'badge-gem' : 'badge-gpt'}">${c.platform}</span>
              <strong style="font-size:15px; margin-right:6px;">${c.title}</strong>
            </div>
            <span style="color:#94a3b8; font-size:12px;">📅 ${c.date} | المعرف: ${c.chatId}</span>
          </div>
          <div style="color:#94a3b8; font-size:12px; margin-top:6px;">
            💬 الرسائل: <b>${c.messageCount}</b> | 📎 المرفقات: <b>${c.attachmentCount}</b> | 💻 الأكواد المستخرجة: <b>${c.extractedCodeCount} ملف</b>
          </div>
          <div class="capsule-box" id="cap-${c.chatId}"><strong>🧠 كبسولة استعادة السياق (Gemini AI):</strong>\n${c.aiCapsule || 'اضغط على زر (توليد كبسولة السياق) بالأسفل لتلخيص هذه المحادثة واستخراج أكوادها النهائية.'}</div>
          <div class="actions-bar">
            <button class="btn-sky" onclick="window.location.href='/api/export/txt?chatId=${c.chatId}'">📄 تحميل TXT مستقل</button>
            <button class="btn-amber" onclick="window.location.href='/api/export/zip?chatId=${c.chatId}'">📦 تحميل ZIP (المرفقات + الأكواد)</button>
            <button class="btn-blue" onclick="regenerateCapsule('${c.chatId}')">🧠 توليد/تحديث كبسولة السياق</button>
            <button class="btn-red" onclick="deleteChat('${c.chatId}')">🗑️ حذف</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      `).join('');
    }

    loadStats();
    loadChats();
  <\/script>
</body>
</html>
  </script>

  <!-- ========================================================================= -->
  <!--              PART B: CLOUD-CONNECTED BROWSER EXTENSION V8                 -->
  <!-- ========================================================================= -->

  <script id="ext-background-js" type="text/plain">
// Background Service Worker Proxy: Allows HTTPS Gemini/ChatGPT tabs to stream to HTTP Wispyte Server (http://IP:PORT) without Mixed-Content blocks!
chrome.runtime.onMessage.addListener((req, sender, sendResponse) => {
  if (req.action === "CLOUD_PROXY_POST") {
    fetch(req.url, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify(req.payload || {})
    })
      .then(async (r) => {
        const data = await r.json().catch(() => ({}));
        sendResponse({ ok: r.ok, data });
      })
      .catch((err) => sendResponse({ ok: false, error: err.message }));
    return true;
  }
});
  </script>

  <script id="ext-exporter-js" type="text/plain">
window.AIArchiverExporter = {
  async fetchBinaryUint8(url) {
    if (!url || url.startsWith("javascript:")) return null;
    if (url.startsWith("data:")) {
      try {
        const binStr = atob(url.split(",")[1]);
        const arr = new Uint8Array(binStr.length);
        for (let i = 0; i < binStr.length; i++) arr[i] = binStr.charCodeAt(i);
        return { uint8: arr, size: arr.byteLength };
      } catch (e) { return null; }
    }
    const ctrl = new AbortController();
    const timer = setTimeout(() => ctrl.abort(), 4500);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(url, { credentials: "include", signal: ctrl.signal });
      clearTimeout(timer);
      if (!res.ok) return null;
      const buf = await res.arrayBuffer();
      if (buf.byteLength > 20 * 1024 * 1024) return null;
      return { uint8: new Uint8Array(buf), size: buf.byteLength };
    } catch (e) {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      return null;
    }
  },

  async exportChatsDual(chatsToExport, exportLabel = "ALL", onProgress = null) {
    if (!chatsToExport || chatsToExport.length === 0) {
      return { ok: false, message: "⚠️ لا توجد محادثات محفوظة لتصديرها!" };
    }
    const dateStamp = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    const baseFilename = `AI_Chats_${exportLabel}_${dateStamp}`;
    const zipFilename = `${baseFilename}_Attachments.zip`;
    const totalMessages = chatsToExport.reduce((acc, c) => acc + (c.messageCount || 0), 0);
    const totalAttachments = chatsToExport.reduce((acc, c) => acc + (c.attachments ? c.attachments.length : 0), 0);

    const chunks = [];
    chunks.push(
      "================================================================================\n",
      "                 📚 أرشيف محادثات الذكاء الاصطناعي الموحّد (AI CONTEXT ARCHIVE)\n",
      "================================================================================\n",
      `• تاريخ التصدير: ${new Date().toLocaleString("ar-EG")}\n`,
      `• إجمالي المحادثات: ${chatsToExport.length} (${totalMessages} رسالة) | المرفقات: ${totalAttachments}\n`,
      `• ملف الـ ZIP المرتبط: ${totalAttachments > 0 ? zipFilename : "لا توجد مرفقات"}\n`,
      "================================================================================\n\n"
    );

    chatsToExport.forEach((chat, idx) => {
      chunks.push(
        `╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗\n`,
        `  محادثة (#${idx + 1}) | المنصة: [${chat.platform}] | المعرف: ${chat.chatId}\n`,
        `  العنوان: ${chat.title} | التاريخ: ${chat.date}\n`,
        `  الرابط: ${chat.url}\n`,
        `╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝\n\n`
      );
      if (chat.aiCapsule) {
        chunks.push(`┏━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🧠 [كبسولة استعادة السياق - Gemini AI] ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┓\n${chat.aiCapsule}\n┗━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┛\n\n`);
      }
      (chat.messages || []).forEach((m) => {
        const speaker = m.role === "User" ? `👤 [المستخدم -> ${chat.platform}] (#${m.index})` : `🤖 [${m.role}] (#${m.index})`;
        chunks.push(`${speaker}:\n${m.text}\n\n--------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n`);
      });
    });

    const txtBlob = new Blob(chunks, { type: "text/plain;charset=utf-8" });
    const txtUrl = URL.createObjectURL(txtBlob);
    const aTxt = document.createElement("a");
    aTxt.href = txtUrl;
    aTxt.download = `${baseFilename}.txt`;
    document.body.appendChild(aTxt);
    aTxt.click();
    aTxt.remove();

    if (totalAttachments > 0 && window.SimpleZip) {
      const zip = new window.SimpleZip();
      let count = 0;
      for (const chat of chatsToExport) {
        for (const att of (chat.attachments || [])) {
          count++;
          if (onProgress) onProgress(`📎 ضغط المرفق (${count}/${totalAttachments})...`);
          const fetched = await this.fetchBinaryUint8(att.originalUrl);
          if (fetched && fetched.uint8) zip.addFile(att.zipPath, fetched.uint8);
          else zip.addTextFile(att.zipPath + ".url.txt", att.originalUrl);
        }
      }
      const zipBlob = zip.generateBlob();
      const zipUrl = URL.createObjectURL(zipBlob);
      const aZip = document.createElement("a");
      aZip.href = zipUrl;
      aZip.download = zipFilename;
      document.body.appendChild(aZip);
      aZip.click();
      aZip.remove();
    }
    return { ok: true, message: `✅ تم تنزيل الملفات بنجاح!` };
  }
};
  </script>

  <script id="ext-content-js" type="text/plain">
// AI Chat Archiver Pro V8 Cloud - Zero-Lag TreeWalker + Real-Time Wispyte Cloud Streaming
if (!window.__AI_ARCHIVER_V8_CLOUD__) {
  window.__AI_ARCHIVER_V8_CLOUD__ = true;

  const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));
  const yieldToMain = () => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 0));

  const SPEED_PROFILES = {
    slow:   { upWait: 820, downWait: 620, stepRatio: 0.58 },
    medium: { upWait: 450, downWait: 300, stepRatio: 0.78 },
    fast:   { upWait: 220, downWait: 150, stepRatio: 0.95 }
  };

  const state = {
    url: "",
    platform: "",
    chatPrefix: "",
    isRunning: false,
    isPaused: false,
    forceFinish: false,
    speedMode: "medium",
    statusText: "جاهز",
    progressPct: 0,
    lastScrollTop: 0,
    elapsedSeconds: 0,
    timerInterval: null,
    capturedMap: new Map(),
    mediaMap: new Map(),
    unsentChunk: [],
    orderCounter: 0
  };

  function detectPlatform() {
    return window.location.hostname.includes("gemini.google.com") ? "Gemini" : "ChatGPT";
  }

  function formatTime(sec) {
    return `${String(Math.floor(sec / 60)).padStart(2, "0")}:${String(sec % 60).padStart(2, "0")}`;
  }

  function getCloudUrl() {
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      chrome.storage.local.get(["wispyteServerUrl"], (res) => {
        resolve((res.wispyteServerUrl || "").replace(/\/+$/, ""));
      });
    });
  }

  function sendToWispyteProxy(endpoint, payload) {
    return new Promise(async (resolve) => {
      const baseUrl = await getCloudUrl();
      if (!baseUrl) return resolve({ ok: false });
      chrome.runtime.sendMessage(
        { action: "CLOUD_PROXY_POST", url: `${baseUrl}${endpoint}`, payload },
        (res) => resolve(res || { ok: false })
      );
    });
  }

  function resetSession() {
    clearInterval(state.timerInterval);
    document.querySelectorAll("[data-arch-len]").forEach((el) => el.removeAttribute("data-arch-len"));
    state.url = window.location.href;
    state.platform = detectPlatform();
    state.chatPrefix = (state.platform === "Gemini" ? "GEM" : "GPT") + "_" + Date.now().toString().slice(-5);
    state.isRunning = false;
    state.isPaused = false;
    state.forceFinish = false;
    state.phase = "UP";
    state.lastScrollTop = 0;
    state.elapsedSeconds = 0;
    state.capturedMap.clear();
    state.mediaMap.clear();
    state.unsentChunk = [];
    state.orderCounter = 0;
  }

  function findScrollableContainerFast() {
    const direct = document.querySelector("infinite-scroller") || document.querySelector("main div.overflow-y-auto");
    if (direct && direct.scrollHeight > direct.clientHeight + 30) return direct;
    const sample = document.querySelector('user-query, model-response, [data-message-author-role], article');
    if (sample) {
      let p = sample.parentElement, steps = 0;
      while (p && p !== document.body && steps < 15) {
        if (p.scrollHeight > p.clientHeight + 40) {
          const ov = window.getComputedStyle(p).overflowY;
          if (ov === "auto" || ov === "scroll") return p;
        }
        p = p.parentElement;
        steps++;
      }
    }
    return document.scrollingElement || document.documentElement;
  }

  function formatTableFast(tableEl) {
    const rows = Array.from(tableEl.querySelectorAll("tr"));
    if (!rows.length) return "";
    const matrix = rows.map((r) => Array.from(r.querySelectorAll("th, td")).map((c) => (c.textContent || "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim()));
    let out = "\n[جدول بيانات]:\n";
    matrix.forEach((r, idx) => {
      out += "| " + r.join(" | ") + " |\n";
      if (idx === 0) out += "| " + r.map(() => "---").join(" | ") + " |\n";
    });
    return out + "\n";
  }

  function extractNodeHybrid(rootEl, role) {
    rootEl.querySelectorAll("details:not([open])").forEach((d) => d.setAttribute("open", "true"));
    const msgMediaIds = [];
    const parts = [];
    const thoughtSet = new Set();

    rootEl.querySelectorAll('model-thoughts, details, [data-testid*="thought"], [class*="thought-"], [class*="reasoning"]').forEach((tEl) => {
      thoughtSet.add(tEl);
      const tTxt = (tEl.textContent || "").trim();
      if (tTxt.length > 5) parts.push(`\n--- 🧠 [بداية خطوات التفكير العميق] ---\n${tTxt}\n--- [نهاية خطوات التفكير] ---\n`);
    });

    rootEl.querySelectorAll("img").forEach((img) => {
      const src = img.currentSrc || img.src || "";
      const w = img.naturalWidth || img.width || 0;
      const h = img.naturalHeight || img.height || 0;
      if (!src || (w > 0 && w < 42 && h > 0 && h < 42) || /avatar|profile|icon|emoji/i.test(src)) return;
      let mediaId = null;
      for (const [id, item] of state.mediaMap.entries()) { if (item.src === src) { mediaId = id; break; } }
      if (!mediaId) {
        mediaId = `ATT_${state.chatPrefix}_IMG${String(state.mediaMap.size + 1).padStart(3, "0")}`;
        state.mediaMap.set(mediaId, { id: mediaId, type: "image", role, src, ext: "png", alt: (img.alt || "").trim() || "صورة مرفقة" });
      }
      msgMediaIds.push(mediaId);
      parts.push(`\n[[__MEDIA_REF_${mediaId}__]]\n`);
    });

    const walker = document.createTreeWalker(rootEl, NodeFilter.SHOW_ELEMENT | NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT, {
      acceptNode(node) {
        if (node.nodeType === Node.ELEMENT_NODE) {
          if (thoughtSet.has(node)) return NodeFilter.FILTER_REJECT;
          const tag = node.tagName.toLowerCase();
          if (/^(script|style|svg|button|nav|model-thoughts|details)$/.test(tag)) return NodeFilter.FILTER_REJECT;
        }
        return NodeFilter.FILTER_ACCEPT;
      }
    });

    let skipEl = null, cur = walker.currentNode;
    while (cur) {
      if (skipEl) {
        if (skipEl.contains(cur)) { cur = walker.nextNode(); continue; }
        skipEl = null;
      }
      if (cur.nodeType === Node.ELEMENT_NODE) {
        const tag = cur.tagName.toLowerCase();
        if (tag === "pre") {
          const codeEl = cur.querySelector("code");
          const m = codeEl && codeEl.className ? codeEl.className.match(/language-([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)/) : null;
          parts.push(`\n\`\`\`${m ? m[1] : ""}\n${(codeEl ? codeEl.textContent : cur.textContent).trim()}\n\`\`\`\n`);
          skipEl = cur; cur = walker.nextNode(); continue;
        }
        if (tag === "table") {
          parts.push(formatTableFast(cur));
          skipEl = cur; cur = walker.nextNode(); continue;
        }
        if (/^(p|div|li|br|h[1-6])$/.test(tag)) parts.push("\n");
      } else if (cur.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE && cur.nodeValue && cur.nodeValue.trim()) {
        parts.push(cur.nodeValue);
      }
      cur = walker.nextNode();
    }

    const cleanText = parts.join(" ").replace(/[ \t]+/g, " ").replace(/\n\s*\n\s*\n+/g, "\n\n").trim();
    return { cleanText, msgMediaIds };
  }

  async function scanIncrementalAndStream() {
    const platform = state.platform;
    const selector = platform === "ChatGPT"
      ? 'article[data-testid^="conversation-turn-"], [data-message-author-role]'
      : 'user-query, model-response, .query-content, .response-content';

    const nodes = document.querySelectorAll(selector);
    let newlyParsed = 0;

    for (let i = 0; i < nodes.length; i++) {
      const el = nodes[i];
      if (platform === "ChatGPT" && el.tagName !== "ARTICLE" && el.closest('article[data-testid^="conversation-turn-"]')) continue;
      if (platform === "Gemini" && el.parentElement && el.parentElement.closest("user-query, model-response")) continue;

      const raw = el.textContent || "";
      const curLen = raw.length;
      if (!curLen && !el.querySelector("img")) continue;

      const cachedLen = el.getAttribute("data-arch-len");
      if (cachedLen && Number(cachedLen) === curLen) continue;

      let key = el.getAttribute("data-testid") || el.getAttribute("data-message-id") || el.id;
      let role = "User";
      if (platform === "ChatGPT") {
        const rNode = el.hasAttribute("data-message-author-role") ? el : el.querySelector("[data-message-author-role]");
        role = (rNode ? rNode.getAttribute("data-message-author-role") : (i % 2 === 0 ? "user" : "assistant")) === "user" ? "User" : "ChatGPT";
      } else {
        role = (el.tagName.toLowerCase() === "user-query" || el.classList.contains("query-content")) ? "User" : "Gemini";
      }
      if (!key) key = role + "_" + raw.trim().slice(0, 60).replace(/\s+/g, "_");

      const prev = state.capturedMap.get(key);
      if (!prev || curLen > prev.rawLength) {
        const { cleanText, msgMediaIds } = extractNodeHybrid(el, role);
        if (cleanText) {
          const entry = { key, role, parsedText: cleanText, mediaIds: msgMediaIds, rawLength: curLen, order: prev ? prev.order : ++state.orderCounter };
          state.capturedMap.set(key, entry);
          state.unsentChunk.push({ key, role, text: cleanText });
        }
      }
      el.setAttribute("data-arch-len", String(curLen));
      newlyParsed++;
      if (newlyParsed % 8 === 0) await yieldToMain();
    }

    // Stream chunk to Wispyte if >= 10 new messages collected
    if (state.unsentChunk.length >= 10) {
      const batch = state.unsentChunk.splice(0, state.unsentChunk.length);
      sendToWispyteProxy("/api/stream-chunk", {
        chatId: state.chatPrefix,
        platform: state.platform,
        title: document.title || "Chat",
        url: window.location.href,
        messagesChunk: batch
      });
    }
    refreshHUD();
  }

  function buildFinalChatObject() {
    const platform = state.platform || detectPlatform();
    const folder = platform === "Gemini" ? "Gemini_Attachments" : "ChatGPT_Attachments";
    const sorted = Array.from(state.capturedMap.values()).sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order);
    const finalAtts = [];

    for (const m of state.mediaMap.values()) {
      finalAtts.push({
        id: m.id,
        fileName: `${m.id}.${m.ext}`,
        zipPath: `${folder}/${m.id}.${m.ext}`,
        platform,
        role: m.role,
        type: m.type,
        alt: m.alt,
        originalUrl: m.src
      });
    }

    const messages = sorted.map((item, idx) => {
      let txt = item.parsedText;
      (item.mediaIds || []).forEach((mid) => {
        const att = finalAtts.find((a) => a.id === mid);
        if (att) {
          const card = `--- 📎 [بطاقة مرفق | معرّف: ${att.id}] ---\n• المسار بالـ ZIP: ${att.zipPath} | الوصف: ${att.alt}\n• الرابط: ${att.originalUrl}\n---------------------------------------------------`;
          txt = txt.replace(`[[__MEDIA_REF_${mid}__]]`, "\n" + card + "\n");
        }
      });
      return { index: idx + 1, role: item.role, text: txt };
    });

    return {
      chatId: state.chatPrefix,
      platform,
      title: (document.title || `${platform} Chat`).replace(/[\\/:*?"<>|]/g, "_").trim(),
      url: window.location.href,
      date: new Date().toLocaleString("ar-EG"),
      timestamp: Date.now(),
      messageCount: messages.length,
      messages,
      attachments: finalAtts
    };
  }

  async function saveLocalAndCloud(chatObj) {
    chrome.storage.local.get(["archivedChats"], (res) => {
      const list = res.archivedChats || [];
      const idx = list.findIndex((c) => c.chatId === chatObj.chatId || c.url === chatObj.url);
      if (idx >= 0) list[idx] = chatObj;
      else list.push(chatObj);
      chrome.storage.local.set({ archivedChats: list });
    });

    const cloudRes = await sendToWispyteProxy("/api/save-chat", { ...chatObj, generateAiCapsule: true });
    if (cloudRes && cloudRes.ok && cloudRes.data && cloudRes.data.aiCapsule) {
      chatObj.aiCapsule = cloudRes.data.aiCapsule;
    }
    return cloudRes;
  }

  async function runExtraction({ autoScroll = true, resume = false, downloadAfter = false }) {
    if (state.isRunning) return;
    if (!resume || state.url !== window.location.href || state.capturedMap.size === 0) resetSession();

    state.isRunning = true;
    state.isPaused = false;
    state.forceFinish = false;
    showHUD();

    clearInterval(state.timerInterval);
    state.timerInterval = setInterval(() => {
      if (!state.isPaused) {
        state.elapsedSeconds++;
        const t = document.getElementById("v8-hud-time");
        if (t) t.textContent = formatTime(state.elapsedSeconds);
      }
    }, 1000);

    const container = findScrollableContainerFast();
    await scanIncrementalAndStream();

    if (autoScroll && container) {
      if (state.phase === "UP") {
        let stag = 0, pCount = state.capturedMap.size, pH = container.scrollHeight;
        for (let s = 0; s < 90; s++) {
          while (state.isPaused && !state.forceFinish) await sleep(250);
          if (state.forceFinish) break;
          container.scrollTop = 0; window.scrollTo(0, 0);
          await sleep((SPEED_PROFILES[state.speedMode] || SPEED_PROFILES.medium).upWait);
          await scanIncrementalAndStream();
          setHUDState(`⬆️ تحميل الرسائل القديمة (${state.capturedMap.size} رسالة)...`, Math.min(40, 15 + s));
          if (container.scrollHeight === pH && state.capturedMap.size === pCount && container.scrollTop <= 10) {
            if (++stag >= 3) break;
          } else stag = 0;
          pH = container.scrollHeight; pCount = state.capturedMap.size;
        }
        state.phase = "DOWN";
      }

      if (state.phase === "DOWN" && !state.forceFinish) {
        let pos = state.lastScrollTop || 0, bTicks = 0;
        for (let s = 0; s < 500; s++) {
          while (state.isPaused && !state.forceFinish) await sleep(250);
          if (state.forceFinish) break;
          const spd = SPEED_PROFILES[state.speedMode] || SPEED_PROFILES.medium;
          container.scrollTop = pos; window.scrollTo(0, pos);
          state.lastScrollTop = pos;
          await sleep(spd.downWait);
          await scanIncrementalAndStream();
          const maxS = Math.max(container.scrollHeight - container.clientHeight, 1);
          setHUDState(`⬇️ مسح وإرسال لسيرفر Wispyte... (${Math.min(100, Math.round((pos / maxS) * 100))}%)`, 40 + Math.round(Math.min(1, pos / maxS) * 50));
          if (pos >= container.scrollHeight - container.clientHeight - 25) {
            if (++bTicks >= 2) break;
          } else bTicks = 0;
          pos += Math.max(window.innerHeight * spd.stepRatio, 450);
        }
      }
    }

    setHUDState("☁️ جاري الحفظ وتوليد كبسولة Gemini على سيرفر Wispyte...", 95);
    const finalChat = buildFinalChatObject();
    if (finalChat.messageCount > 0) {
      await saveLocalAndCloud(finalChat);
      setHUDState(`🎉 تم الحفظ السحابي! (${finalChat.messageCount} رسالة)`, 100);
      if (downloadAfter && window.AIArchiverExporter) {
        await window.AIArchiverExporter.exportChatsDual([finalChat], finalChat.platform.toUpperCase() + "_CLOUD");
      }
    }
    state.isRunning = false;
    setTimeout(() => { const h = document.getElementById("ai-archiver-v8-hud"); if (h) h.remove(); }, 2500);
  }

  function setHUDState(txt, pct) {
    state.statusText = txt;
    state.progressPct = pct;
    refreshHUD();
  }

  function refreshHUD() {
    const m = document.getElementById("v8-hud-msgs");
    const a = document.getElementById("v8-hud-atts");
    const s = document.getElementById("v8-hud-status");
    const b = document.getElementById("v8-hud-bar");
    if (m) m.textContent = state.capturedMap.size;
    if (a) a.textContent = state.mediaMap.size;
    if (s) s.textContent = state.statusText;
    if (b) b.style.width = state.progressPct + "%";
  }

  function showHUD() {
    let hud = document.getElementById("ai-archiver-v8-hud");
    if (hud) hud.remove();
    hud = document.createElement("div");
    hud.id = "ai-archiver-v8-hud";
    hud.style.cssText = "position:fixed;top:12px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:2147483647;background:#0f172a;color:#fff;padding:12px 14px;border-radius:12px;width:92%;max-width:370px;border:1.5px solid #38bdf8;font-family:system-ui,sans-serif;font-size:12px;direction:rtl;box-shadow:0 12px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.8);";
    hud.innerHTML = `
      <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:7px;">
        <b style="color:#38bdf8;">☁️ Wispyte Cloud Stream (V8)</b>
        <span style="color:#fbbf24;font-weight:bold;">⏱️ <span id="v8-hud-time">00:00</span></span>
      </div>
      <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:6px;background:#1e293b;padding:6px;border-radius:7px;text-align:center;margin-bottom:7px;">
        <div>💬 الرسائل: <b id="v8-hud-msgs" style="color:#4ade80;">0</b></div>
        <div>📎 المرفقات: <b id="v8-hud-atts" style="color:#38bdf8;">0</b></div>
      </div>
      <div id="v8-hud-status" style="font-size:11px;color:#cbd5e1;margin-bottom:6px;">جاري الفحص...</div>
      <div style="width:100%;background:#1e293b;height:6px;border-radius:4px;overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:8px;">
        <div id="v8-hud-bar" style="width:10%;background:#38bdf8;height:100%;"></div>
      </div>
      <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:6px;">
        <button id="v8-pause" style="padding:6px;border:none;border-radius:6px;background:#f59e0b;color:#090d16;font-weight:bold;cursor:pointer;">⏸️ إيقاف / استكمال</button>
        <button id="v8-finish" style="padding:6px;border:none;border-radius:6px;background:#10b981;color:#052e16;font-weight:bold;cursor:pointer;">✅ اكتفاء وحفظ الآن</button>
      </div>
    `;
    document.body.appendChild(hud);
    hud.querySelector("#v8-pause").onclick = () => { state.isPaused = !state.isPaused; };
    hud.querySelector("#v8-finish").onclick = () => { state.forceFinish = true; state.isPaused = false; };
  }

  function injectFAB() {
    if (document.getElementById("v8-cloud-fab")) return;
    const fab = document.createElement("div");
    fab.id = "v8-cloud-fab";
    fab.style.cssText = "position:fixed;bottom:85px;left:16px;z-index:2147483645;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#2563eb,#10b981);color:#fff;width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:20px;box-shadow:0 5px 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);cursor:pointer;border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.3);";
    fab.textContent = "☁️";
    fab.title = "أرشفة سحابية إلى Wispyte";
    fab.onclick = () => runExtraction({ autoScroll: true, resume: false, downloadAfter: true });
    document.body.appendChild(fab);
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", injectFAB);
  else injectFAB();

  chrome.runtime.onMessage.addListener((req, sender, sendResponse) => {
    if (req.action === "START_EXTRACTION") {
      if (req.speedMode) state.speedMode = req.speedMode;
      runExtraction({ autoScroll: req.autoScroll !== false, resume: Boolean(req.resume), downloadAfter: Boolean(req.downloadAfter) });
      sendResponse({ ok: true });
    }
    return false;
  });
}
  </script>

  <script id="ext-popup-js" type="text/plain">
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  chrome.storage.local.get(["wispyteServerUrl"], (res) => {
    if (res.wispyteServerUrl) document.getElementById("serverUrlInput").value = res.wispyteServerUrl;
  });
});

function setStatus(msg) { document.getElementById("statusBox").textContent = msg; }

document.getElementById("saveServerBtn").addEventListener("click", () => {
  const url = document.getElementById("serverUrlInput").value.trim().replace(/\/+$/, "");
  chrome.storage.local.set({ wispyteServerUrl: url }, () => {
    setStatus("✅ تم حفظ رابط سيرفر Wispyte!");
    if (url) chrome.tabs.create({ url });
  });
});

async function triggerTab(downloadAfter) {
  const tabs = await chrome.tabs.query({});
  const target = tabs.find(t => t.active && t.url && /gemini\.google\.com|chatgpt\.com|openai\.com/.test(t.url))
    || tabs.find(t => t.url && /gemini\.google\.com|chatgpt\.com|openai\.com/.test(t.url));
  if (!target) return setStatus("⚠️ افتح محادثة Gemini أو ChatGPT أولاً!");
  const autoScroll = document.getElementById("autoScrollChk").checked;
  const speedMode = document.getElementById("speedSelect").value;
  chrome.tabs.sendMessage(target.id, { action: "START_EXTRACTION", autoScroll, speedMode, downloadAfter }, () => {
    setStatus("☁️ بدأ السحب والإرسال السحابي داخل صفحة المحادثة!");
  });
}

document.getElementById("startBtn").addEventListener("click", () => triggerTab(false));
document.getElementById("exportNowBtn").addEventListener("click", () => triggerTab(true));
document.getElementById("exportAllLocalBtn").addEventListener("click", () => {
  chrome.storage.local.get(["archivedChats"], async (res) => {
    const out = await window.AIArchiverExporter.exportChatsDual(res.archivedChats || [], "ALL", setStatus);
    setStatus(out.message);
  });
});
  </script>

  <!-- ================= Generator Execution Logic ================= -->
  <script>
    eval(document.getElementById("shared-zip-builder-js").textContent);

    function showNotice(txt) {
      const box = document.getElementById("statusMsg");
      box.style.display = "block";
      box.textContent = txt;
    }

    function triggerDownload(blob, filename) {
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = url;
      a.download = filename;
      document.body.appendChild(a);
      a.click();
      a.remove();
      setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 5000);
    }

    // 1. Build Wispyte Cloud Server V8 ZIP
    document.getElementById("dlServerBtn").addEventListener("click", () => {
      const zip = new window.SimpleZip();
      zip.addTextFile("package.json", document.getElementById("srv-package-json").textContent.trim());
      zip.addTextFile("zip_builder.js", document.getElementById("shared-zip-builder-js").textContent.trim());
      zip.addTextFile("database.js", document.getElementById("srv-database-js").textContent.trim());
      zip.addTextFile("gemini_service.js", document.getElementById("srv-gemini-service-js").textContent.trim());
      zip.addTextFile("server.js", document.getElementById("srv-server-js").textContent.trim());
      zip.addTextFile("public/index.html", document.getElementById("srv-public-index-html").textContent.trim().replace(/<\\\/script>/g, "</" + "script>"));

      triggerDownload(zip.generateBlob(), "Wispyte-Cloud-Server-V8.zip");
      showNotice("✅ تم تحميل ملف السيرفر (Wispyte-Cloud-Server-V8.zip)! ارفعه إلى تبويب Files في استضافة Wispyte وفك الضغط عنه.");
    });

    // 2. Build Cloud-Connected Browser Extension V8 ZIP
    document.getElementById("dlExtBtn").addEventListener("click", () => {
      const zip = new window.SimpleZip();
      const manifest = {
        "manifest_version": 3,
        "name": "AI Chat Archiver Pro (V8 Wispyte Cloud)",
        "version": "8.0.0",
        "description": "إضافة أرشفة محادثات Gemini و ChatGPT المربوطة سحابياً بسيرفر Wispyte بدون لاق.",
        "permissions": ["activeTab", "tabs", "scripting", "storage", "unlimitedStorage", "downloads"],
        "host_permissions": ["<all_urls>"],
        "background": { "service_worker": "background.js" },
        "content_scripts": [{
          "matches": ["https://gemini.google.com/*", "https://chatgpt.com/*", "https://chat.openai.com/*"],
          "js": ["zip_builder.js", "exporter.js", "content.js"],
          "run_at": "document_idle"
        }],
        "action": { "default_popup": "popup.html", "default_title": "Wispyte AI Archiver V8" }
      };

      zip.addTextFile("manifest.json", JSON.stringify(manifest, null, 2));
      zip.addTextFile("background.js", document.getElementById("ext-background-js").textContent.trim());
      zip.addTextFile("zip_builder.js", document.getElementById("shared-zip-builder-js").textContent.trim());
      zip.addTextFile("exporter.js", document.getElementById("ext-exporter-js").textContent.trim());
      zip.addTextFile("content.js", document.getElementById("ext-content-js").textContent.trim());
      zip.addTextFile("popup.html", document.getElementById("ext-popup-html").textContent.trim().replace(/<\\\/script>/g, "</" + "script>"));
      zip.addTextFile("popup.js", document.getElementById("ext-popup-js").textContent.trim());

      triggerDownload(zip.generateBlob(), "AI-Chat-Archiver-Extension-V8-Cloud.zip");
      showNotice("✅ تم تحميل ملف الإضافة السحابية (AI-Chat-Archiver-Extension-V8-Cloud.zip)! ركبه في متصفحك وضع رابط سيرفر Wispyte بداخله.");
    });
  </script>
</body>

احفظ الكود التالي في ملف باسم Wispyte_Server_V8_Builder.html وافتحه في متصفحك، ثم اضغط على زر التحميل ليقوم المتصفح فوراً بتوليد وتنزيل ملف Wispyte-Cloud-Server-V8.zip الجاهز للرفع وفك الضغط على استضافة Wispyte:
