  <!-- ================= 2. FILE: zip_builder.js ================= -->
  <script id="file-zip-builder-js" type="text/plain">
// Universal Pure-JS ZIP Builder (Works in Node.js & Browser without native dependencies)
class SimpleZip {
  constructor() {
    this.files = [];
    this.crcTable = this.makeCRCTable();
  }

  makeCRCTable() {
    const table = new Uint32Array(256);
    for (let n = 0; n < 256; n++) {
      let c = n;
      for (let k = 0; k < 8; k++) {
        c = (c & 1) ? (0xEDB88320 ^ (c >>> 1)) : (c >>> 1);
      }
      table[n] = c;
    }
    return table;
  }

  crc32(uint8Arr) {
    let crc = 0 ^ (-1);
    for (let i = 0; i < uint8Arr.length; i++) {
      crc = (crc >>> 8) ^ this.crcTable[(crc ^ uint8Arr[i]) & 0xFF];
    }
    return (crc ^ (-1)) >>> 0;
  }

  addFile(path, uint8Data) {
    const nameBytes = new TextEncoder().encode(path);
    const data = uint8Data instanceof Uint8Array ? uint8Data : new Uint8Array(uint8Data);
    const crc = this.crc32(data);
    this.files.push({ nameBytes, data, crc, size: data.length });
  }

  addTextFile(path, textContent) {
    this.addFile(path, new TextEncoder().encode(String(textContent || "")));
  }

  generateUint8Array() {
    let offset = 0;
    const chunks = [];
    const centralHeaders = [];
    const now = new Date();
    const dosTime = ((now.getHours() << 11) | (now.getMinutes() << 5) | (now.getSeconds() >> 1)) & 0xFFFF;
    const dosDate = (((now.getFullYear() - 1980) << 9) | ((now.getMonth() + 1) << 5) | now.getDate()) & 0xFFFF;

    for (const file of this.files) {
      const nameLen = file.nameBytes.length;
      const lh = new Uint8Array(30 + nameLen);
      const lv = new DataView(lh.buffer);
      lv.setUint32(0, 0x04034b50, true);
      lv.setUint16(4, 20, true);
      lv.setUint16(6, 0x0800, true);
      lv.setUint16(8, 0, true);
      lv.setUint16(10, dosTime, true);
      lv.setUint16(12, dosDate, true);
      lv.setUint32(14, file.crc, true);
      lv.setUint32(18, file.size, true);
      lv.setUint32(22, file.size, true);
      lv.setUint16(26, nameLen, true);
      lv.setUint16(28, 0, true);
      lh.set(file.nameBytes, 30);
      chunks.push(lh, file.data);

      const ch = new Uint8Array(46 + nameLen);
      const cv = new DataView(ch.buffer);
      cv.setUint32(0, 0x02014b50, true);
      cv.setUint16(4, 20, true);
      cv.setUint16(6, 20, true);
      cv.setUint16(8, 0x0800, true);
      cv.setUint16(10, 0, true);
      cv.setUint16(12, dosTime, true);
      cv.setUint16(14, dosDate, true);
      cv.setUint32(16, file.crc, true);
      cv.setUint32(20, file.size, true);
      cv.setUint32(24, file.size, true);
      cv.setUint16(28, nameLen, true);
      cv.setUint32(42, offset, true);
      ch.set(file.nameBytes, 46);
      centralHeaders.push(ch);

      offset += lh.length + file.size;
    }

    let centralSize = 0;
    for (const ch of centralHeaders) {
      chunks.push(ch);
      centralSize += ch.length;
    }

    const eocd = new Uint8Array(22);
    const ev = new DataView(eocd.buffer);
    ev.setUint32(0, 0x06054b50, true);
    ev.setUint16(8, this.files.length, true);
    ev.setUint16(10, this.files.length, true);
    ev.setUint32(12, centralSize, true);
    ev.setUint32(16, offset, true);
    chunks.push(eocd);

    const totalLen = chunks.reduce((acc, arr) => acc + arr.length, 0);
    const out = new Uint8Array(totalLen);
    let pos = 0;
    for (const arr of chunks) {
      out.set(arr, pos);
      pos += arr.length;
    }
    return out;
  }

  generateBuffer() {
    return Buffer.from(this.generateUint8Array());
  }

  generateBlob() {
    return new Blob([this.generateUint8Array()], { type: "application/zip" });
  }
}

if (typeof module !== "undefined" && module.exports) {
  module.exports = SimpleZip;
}
if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
  window.SimpleZip = SimpleZip;
}
  </script>

  <!-- ================= 3. FILE: database.js ================= -->
  <script id="file-database-js" type="text/plain">
const fs = require("fs");
const path = require("path");

const DATA_DIR = path.join(__dirname, "data");
const DB_FILE = path.join(DATA_DIR, "chats_db.json");
const SETTINGS_FILE = path.join(DATA_DIR, "settings.json");

if (!fs.existsSync(DATA_DIR)) {
  fs.mkdirSync(DATA_DIR, { recursive: true });
}

class ArchiveDatabase {
  constructor() {
    this.chats = new Map();
    this.streamBuffers = new Map();
    this.settings = {
      geminiKeys: process.env.GEMINI_API_KEYS
        ? process.env.GEMINI_API_KEYS.split(",").map(k => k.trim()).filter(Boolean)
        : [],
      apiSecret: process.env.API_SECRET || ""
    };
    this.loadFromDisk();
  }

  loadFromDisk() {
    try {
      if (fs.existsSync(DB_FILE)) {
        const raw = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(DB_FILE, "utf8"));
        (raw || []).forEach(c => this.chats.set(c.chatId, c));
      }
      if (fs.existsSync(SETTINGS_FILE)) {
        const s = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(SETTINGS_FILE, "utf8"));
        if (s.geminiKeys && s.geminiKeys.length) this.settings.geminiKeys = s.geminiKeys;
        if (s.apiSecret !== undefined) this.settings.apiSecret = s.apiSecret;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("[DB] Warning loading disk files:", e.message);
    }
  }

  persistChats() {
    try {
      const arr = Array.from(this.chats.values());
      fs.writeFileSync(DB_FILE, JSON.stringify(arr, null, 2), "utf8");
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("[DB] Persist error:", e.message);
    }
  }

  saveSettings(newSettings) {
    if (Array.isArray(newSettings.geminiKeys)) {
      this.settings.geminiKeys = newSettings.geminiKeys.map(k => k.trim()).filter(Boolean);
    }
    if (newSettings.apiSecret !== undefined) {
      this.settings.apiSecret = String(newSettings.apiSecret).trim();
    }
    fs.writeFileSync(SETTINGS_FILE, JSON.stringify(this.settings, null, 2), "utf8");
    return this.settings;
  }

  appendStreamChunk({ chatId, platform, title, url, messagesChunk = [], attachmentsChunk = [] }) {
    if (!this.streamBuffers.has(chatId)) {
      this.streamBuffers.set(chatId, {
        chatId,
        platform: platform || "Gemini",
        title: title || "Chat",
        url: url || "",
        date: new Date().toLocaleString("ar-EG"),
        timestamp: Date.now(),
        messagesMap: new Map(),
        attachmentsMap: new Map()
      });
    }
    const buf = this.streamBuffers.get(chatId);
    if (title) buf.title = title;
    if (url) buf.url = url;

    messagesChunk.forEach(m => {
      const key = m.key || m.index || (m.role + "_" + String(m.text).slice(0, 40));
      buf.messagesMap.set(key, m);
    });

    attachmentsChunk.forEach(a => {
      if (a && a.id) buf.attachmentsMap.set(a.id, a);
    });

    return {
      chatId,
      bufferedMessages: buf.messagesMap.size,
      bufferedAttachments: buf.attachmentsMap.size
    };
  }

  finalizeStreamedChat(chatId, directChatObj = null) {
    let finalObj = directChatObj;
    if (!finalObj && this.streamBuffers.has(chatId)) {
      const buf = this.streamBuffers.get(chatId);
      const messages = Array.from(buf.messagesMap.values()).map((m, idx) => ({
        index: idx + 1,
        role: m.role,
        text: m.text
      }));
      const attachments = Array.from(buf.attachmentsMap.values());
      finalObj = {
        chatId: buf.chatId,
        platform: buf.platform,
        title: buf.title,
        url: buf.url,
        date: buf.date,
        timestamp: Date.now(),
        messageCount: messages.length,
        messages,
        attachments,
        aiCapsule: "",
        extractedFiles: []
      };
      this.streamBuffers.delete(chatId);
    }

    if (!finalObj) return null;
    const existing = this.chats.get(finalObj.chatId);
    if (existing && !finalObj.aiCapsule && existing.aiCapsule) {
      finalObj.aiCapsule = existing.aiCapsule;
    }
    this.chats.set(finalObj.chatId, finalObj);
    this.persistChats();
    return finalObj;
  }

  getChat(chatId) {
    return this.chats.get(chatId) || null;
  }

  getAllChats(platformFilter = "") {
    let list = Array.from(this.chats.values()).sort((a, b) => (b.timestamp || 0) - (a.timestamp || 0));
    if (platformFilter) {
      list = list.filter(c => c.platform.toLowerCase() === platformFilter.toLowerCase());
    }
    return list;
  }

  deleteChat(chatId) {
    const existed = this.chats.delete(chatId);
    if (existed) this.persistChats();
    return existed;
  }
}

module.exports = new ArchiveDatabase();
  </script>

  <!-- ================= 4. FILE: gemini_service.js ================= -->
  <script id="file-gemini-service-js" type="text/plain">
// Smart Gemini AI Service with Multi-Key Rotation, Context Capsule & Final Code Extractor
class GeminiService {
  constructor(db) {
    this.db = db;
    this.keyIndex = 0;
  }

  getNextApiKey() {
    const keys = this.db.settings.geminiKeys || [];
    if (!keys.length) return null;
    const key = keys[this.keyIndex % keys.length];
    this.keyIndex = (this.keyIndex + 1) % keys.length;
    return key;
  }

  async callGemini(promptText, inlineImageBase64 = null, mimeType = "image/png") {
    const keys = this.db.settings.geminiKeys || [];
    if (!keys.length) {
      throw new Error("لم يتم إضافة مفتاح Gemini API في الإعدادات بعد.");
    }

    let lastErr = null;
    for (let attempt = 0; attempt < keys.length; attempt++) {
      const apiKey = this.getNextApiKey();
      try {
        const parts = [{ text: promptText }];
        if (inlineImageBase64) {
          const cleanB64 = inlineImageBase64.includes(",") ? inlineImageBase64.split(",")[1] : inlineImageBase64;
          parts.push({ inline_data: { mime_type: mimeType, data: cleanB64 } });
        }

        const url = `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemini-2.5-flash:generateContent?key=${apiKey}`;
        const res = await fetch(url, {
          method: "POST",
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
          body: JSON.stringify({ contents: [{ parts }] })
        });

        const data = await res.json();
        if (!res.ok) {
          throw new Error(data.error ? data.error.message : `HTTP ${res.status}`);
        }
        const reply = data?.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts?.[0]?.text;
        if (reply) return reply.trim();
      } catch (err) {
        lastErr = err;
      }
    }
    throw lastErr || new Error("فشل الاتصال بجميع مفاتيح Gemini المتاحة.");
  }

  async generateContextCapsule(chatObj) {
    const transcript = (chatObj.messages || [])
      .map(m => `[${m.role} #${m.index}]:\n${m.text}`)
      .join("\n\n")
      .slice(-28000);

    const prompt = [
      "أنت مهندس برمجيات ومحلل سياق محترف. قم بتحليل هذه المحادثة وإنشاء (كبسولة استعادة السياق الفورية) باللغة العربية بحيث لو رفع المستخدم هذا الملف لنموذج ذكاء اصطناعي جديد يفهم كل شيء في ثوانٍ.",
      "يجب أن تتضمن الكبسولة الأقسام التالية بوضوح:",
      "1. 🎯 الهدف الأساسي للمشروع أو النقاش.",
      "2. ✅ أهم القرارات والمواصفات التقنية التي تم اعتمادها.",
      "3. 💻 جرد لأحدث الملفات والأكواد النهائية المعتمدة في المحادثة (تجاهل النسخ القديمة الملغاة).",
      "4. 📍 نقطة التوقف الأخيرة والخطوة المطلوبة تالياً.",
      "",
      "نص المحادثة:",
      transcript
    ].join("\n");

    return await this.callGemini(prompt);
  }

  extractCodeBlocksFromChat(chatObj) {
    const codeFiles = [];
    const extMap = {
      javascript: "js", js: "js", python: "py", py: "py",
      html: "html", css: "css", json: "json", sql: "sql",
      bash: "sh", sh: "sh", typescript: "ts", ts: "ts"
    };

    const regex = /```([a-zA-Z0-9_-]*)\r?\n([\s\S]*?)```/g;
    (chatObj.messages || []).forEach((m) => {
      let match;
      let blockIdx = 1;
      while ((match = regex.exec(m.text)) !== null) {
        const lang = (match[1] || "txt").toLowerCase();
        const code = (match[2] || "").trim();
        if (code.length < 30) continue;
        const ext = extMap[lang] || "txt";
        const fileName = `MSG${String(m.index).padStart(3, "0")}_Code${blockIdx}.${ext}`;
        codeFiles.push({
          fileName,
          zipPath: `Extracted_Code/${fileName}`,
          lang,
          msgIndex: m.index,
          content: code
        });
        blockIdx++;
      }
    });
    return codeFiles;
  }

  async askAcrossArchive(question) {
    const allChats = this.db.getAllChats();
    if (!allChats.length) return "لا توجد محادثات في الأرشيف للبحث فيها بعد.";

    const contextDigest = allChats.slice(0, 15).map(c => {
      const lastMsgs = (c.messages || []).slice(-4).map(m => `${m.role}: ${m.text.slice(0, 400)}`).join("\n");
      return `=== محادثة: ${c.title} (${c.platform} | ID: ${c.chatId}) ===\nالملخص: ${c.aiCapsule || "لا يوجد"}\nمقتطفات:\n${lastMsgs}`;
    }).join("\n\n");

    const prompt = `بناءً على أرشيف محادثات المستخدم التالي، أجب بدقة عن سؤاله مع ذكر اسم المحادثة ومعرفها (ID):\n\nسؤال المستخدم: ${question}\n\nالأرشيف:\n${contextDigest}`;
    return await this.callGemini(prompt);
  }
}

module.exports = GeminiService;
  </script>

  <!-- ================= 5. FILE: server.js ================= -->
  <script id="file-server-js" type="text/plain">
const express = require("express");
const cors = require("cors");
const path = require("path");
const db = require("./database");
const GeminiService = require("./gemini_service");
const SimpleZip = require("./zip_builder");

const app = express();
const PORT = process.env.PORT || 3000;
const gemini = new GeminiService(db);

app.use(cors());
app.use(express.json({ limit: "50mb" }));
app.use(express.static(path.join(__dirname, "public")));

app.get("/api/status", (req, res) => {
  const chats = db.getAllChats();
  const gemCount = chats.filter(c => c.platform === "Gemini").length;
  const gptCount = chats.filter(c => c.platform === "ChatGPT").length;
  res.json({
    ok: true,
    version: "8.0.0-Wispyte-Cloud",
    totalChats: chats.length,
    geminiChats: gemCount,
    gptChats: gptCount,
    configuredKeysCount: (db.settings.geminiKeys || []).length
  });
});

app.post("/api/settings", (req, res) => {
  const { geminiKeys, apiSecret } = req.body || {};
  const updated = db.saveSettings({ geminiKeys, apiSecret });
  res.json({
    ok: true,
    configuredKeysCount: updated.geminiKeys.length,
    message: `تم حفظ ${updated.geminiKeys.length} مفتاح Gemini API بنجاح!`
  });
});

app.post("/api/stream-chunk", (req, res) => {
  try {
    const result = db.appendStreamChunk(req.body || {});
    res.json({ ok: true, ...result });
  } catch (err) {
    res.status(500).json({ ok: false, error: err.message });
  }
});

app.post("/api/save-chat", async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { chatId, generateAiCapsule = true, ...payload } = req.body || {};
    const finalChat = db.finalizeStreamedChat(chatId, payload.messages ? { chatId, ...payload } : null);
    if (!finalChat) {
      return res.status(400).json({ ok: false, error: "لم يتم العثور على بيانات المحادثة." });
    }

    finalChat.extractedFiles = gemini.extractCodeBlocksFromChat(finalChat);

    if (generateAiCapsule && (db.settings.geminiKeys || []).length > 0) {
      try {
        finalChat.aiCapsule = await gemini.generateContextCapsule(finalChat);
      } catch (aiErr) {
        finalChat.aiCapsule = `تعذر توليد الكبسولة تلقائياً: ${aiErr.message}`;
      }
    }

    db.finalizeStreamedChat(finalChat.chatId, finalChat);
    res.json({
      ok: true,
      chatId: finalChat.chatId,
      messageCount: finalChat.messageCount,
      extractedCodeCount: finalChat.extractedFiles.length,
      aiCapsule: finalChat.aiCapsule
    });
  } catch (err) {
    res.status(500).json({ ok: false, error: err.message });
  }
});

app.post("/api/chats/:chatId/generate-capsule", async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const chat = db.getChat(req.params.chatId);
    if (!chat) return res.status(404).json({ ok: false, error: "المحادثة غير موجودة" });
    chat.aiCapsule = await gemini.generateContextCapsule(chat);
    db.finalizeStreamedChat(chat.chatId, chat);
    res.json({ ok: true, aiCapsule: chat.aiCapsule });
  } catch (err) {
    res.status(500).json({ ok: false, error: err.message });
  }
});

app.get("/api/chats", (req, res) => {
  const platform = req.query.platform || "";
  const q = (req.query.q || "").toLowerCase().trim();
  let chats = db.getAllChats(platform);

  if (q) {
    chats = chats.filter(c =>
      (c.title || "").toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      (c.aiCapsule || "").toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      (c.messages || []).some(m => (m.text || "").toLowerCase().includes(q))
    );
  }

  res.json({
    ok: true,
    chats: chats.map(c => ({
      chatId: c.chatId,
      platform: c.platform,
      title: c.title,
      url: c.url,
      date: c.date,
      timestamp: c.timestamp,
      messageCount: c.messageCount,
      attachmentCount: (c.attachments || []).length,
      extractedCodeCount: (c.extractedFiles || []).length,
      aiCapsule: c.aiCapsule || ""
    }))
  });
});

app.delete("/api/chats/:chatId", (req, res) => {
  db.deleteChat(req.params.chatId);
  res.json({ ok: true });
});

app.post("/api/ask-archive", async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const answer = await gemini.askAcrossArchive(req.body.question || "");
    res.json({ ok: true, answer });
  } catch (err) {
    res.status(500).json({ ok: false, error: err.message });
  }
});

function buildStandaloneTxt(chatsList, label = "ARCHIVE") {
  const dateStamp = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  const zipName = `AI_Chats_${label}_${dateStamp}_Attachments.zip`;
  const gemCount = chatsList.filter(c => c.platform === "Gemini").length;
  const gptCount = chatsList.filter(c => c.platform === "ChatGPT").length;
  const totalMsgs = chatsList.reduce((a, c) => a + (c.messageCount || 0), 0);
  const totalAtts = chatsList.reduce((a, c) => a + (c.attachments ? c.attachments.length : 0), 0);

  let out = "";
  out += "================================================================================\n";
  out += "         ☁️ أرشيف محادثات الذكاء الاصطناعي السحابي (WISPYTE AI ARCHIVE V8)\n";
  out += "================================================================================\n";
  out += `• تاريخ التصدير: ${new Date().toLocaleString("ar-EG")}\n`;
  out += `• إجمالي المحادثات: ${chatsList.length} (${totalMsgs} رسالة) | Gemini: ${gemCount} | ChatGPT: ${gptCount}\n`;
  out += `• ملف الـ ZIP المرفق للصور والأكواد المستخرجة: ${totalAtts > 0 ? zipName : "متاح عند الطلب"}\n`;
  out += "--------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n";
  out += "💡 [توجيه للذكاء الاصطناعي]: يحتوي هذا الملف في بداية كل محادثة على (كبسولة استعادة السياق)\n";
  out += "التي تلخص الهدف والقرارات والأكواد النهائية، يليها النص الكامل للمحادثة وبطاقات المرفقات.\n";
  out += "================================================================================\n\n";

  chatsList.forEach((chat, idx) => {
    out += `╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗\n`;
    out += `  محادثة (#${idx + 1}) | المنصة: [${chat.platform}] | المعرف: ${chat.chatId}\n`;
    out += `  العنوان: ${chat.title} | التاريخ: ${chat.date}\n`;
    out += `  الرابط: ${chat.url}\n`;
    out += `╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝\n\n`;

    if (chat.aiCapsule) {
      out += `┏━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🧠 [كبسولة استعادة السياق الذكية - Gemini AI] ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┓\n`;
      out += `${chat.aiCapsule}\n`;
      out += `┗━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┛\n\n`;
    }

    (chat.messages || []).forEach(m => {
      const speaker = m.role === "User"
        ? `👤 [المستخدم -> ${chat.platform}] (رسالة #${m.index})`
        : `🤖 [${m.role}] (رد #${m.index})`;
      out += `${speaker}:\n${m.text}\n\n--------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n`;
    });

    out += `\n════════════════════ [نهاية محادثة #${idx + 1} (${chat.chatId})] ════════════════════\n\n\n`;
  });

  return out;
}

app.get("/api/export/txt", (req, res) => {
  const { chatId, platform } = req.query;
  let list = [];
  let label = "ALL";

  if (chatId) {
    const c = db.getChat(chatId);
    if (c) list = [c];
    label = chatId;
  } else {
    list = db.getAllChats(platform || "");
    if (platform) label = platform.toUpperCase();
  }

  const txtContent = buildStandaloneTxt(list, label);
  const filename = `AI_Chats_${label}_${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.txt`;
  res.setHeader("Content-Type", "text/plain; charset=utf-8");
  res.setHeader("Content-Disposition", `attachment; filename="${filename}"`);
  res.send(txtContent);
});

app.get("/api/export/zip", async (req, res) => {
  const { chatId, platform } = req.query;
  let list = [];
  let label = "ALL";

  if (chatId) {
    const c = db.getChat(chatId);
    if (c) list = [c];
    label = chatId;
  } else {
    list = db.getAllChats(platform || "");
    if (platform) label = platform.toUpperCase();
  }

  const zip = new SimpleZip();
  const indexManifest = { exportDate: new Date().toISOString(), chatsCount: list.length, attachments: [], codeFiles: [] };

  for (const chat of list) {
    const codes = chat.extractedFiles && chat.extractedFiles.length
      ? chat.extractedFiles
      : gemini.extractCodeBlocksFromChat(chat);

    codes.forEach(cf => {
      const pathInZip = `${chat.platform}_${chat.chatId}/${cf.zipPath}`;
      zip.addTextFile(pathInZip, cf.content);
      indexManifest.codeFiles.push({ chatId: chat.chatId, pathInZip, lang: cf.lang });
    });

    for (const att of (chat.attachments || [])) {
      indexManifest.attachments.push(att);
      if (att.dataUrl && att.dataUrl.includes(",")) {
        const b64 = att.dataUrl.split(",")[1];
        zip.addFile(att.zipPath, Buffer.from(b64, "base64"));
      } else {
        zip.addTextFile(att.zipPath + ".url.txt", `Original URL: ${att.originalUrl}\nAlt: ${att.alt}`);
      }
    }
  }

  zip.addTextFile("archive_manifest.json", JSON.stringify(indexManifest, null, 2));
  const zipBuf = zip.generateBuffer();
  const filename = `AI_Chats_${label}_${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}_Attachments_And_Code.zip`;
  res.setHeader("Content-Type", "application/zip");
  res.setHeader("Content-Disposition", `attachment; filename="${filename}"`);
  res.send(zipBuf);
});

app.listen(PORT, "0.0.0.0", () => {
  console.log(`🚀 Wispyte AI Cloud Archiver V8 running on http://0.0.0.0:${PORT}`);
});
  </script>

  <script>
    async function loadStats() {
      const res = await fetch('/api/status');
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.ok) {
        document.getElementById('stTotal').textContent = data.totalChats;
        document.getElementById('stGem').textContent = data.geminiChats;
        document.getElementById('stGpt').textContent = data.gptChats;
        document.getElementById('stKeys').textContent = data.configuredKeysCount + ' مفتاح';
      }
    }

    async function saveKeys() {
      const raw = document.getElementById('keysInput').value;
      const geminiKeys = raw.split(/[,\n]+/).map(k => k.trim()).filter(Boolean);
      const res = await fetch('/api/settings', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ geminiKeys })
      });
      const data = await res.json();
      alert(data.message || 'تم الحفظ');
      loadStats();
    }

    async function askArchive() {
      const question = document.getElementById('askInput').value.trim();
      if (!question) return;
      const box = document.getElementById('askAnswer');
      box.style.display = 'block';
      box.textContent = '⏳ جاري البحث في الأرشيف وتحليل الإجابة عبر Gemini...';
      const res = await fetch('/api/ask-archive', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ question })
      });
      const data = await res.json();
      box.textContent = data.ok ? data.answer : ('❌ خطأ: ' + data.error);
    }

    async function regenerateCapsule(chatId) {
      const el = document.getElementById('cap-' + chatId);
      if (el) el.textContent = '⏳ جاري قراءة المحادثة وتوليد كبسولة استعادة السياق عبر Gemini...';
      const res = await fetch(`/api/chats/${chatId}/generate-capsule`, { method: 'POST' });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (el) el.textContent = data.ok ? data.aiCapsule : ('❌ ' + data.error);
    }

    async function deleteChat(chatId) {
      if (!confirm('هل تريد حذف هذه المحادثة من السيرفر؟')) return;
      await fetch(`/api/chats/${chatId}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
      loadStats();
      loadChats();
    }

    async function loadChats() {
      const q = encodeURIComponent(document.getElementById('searchBox').value.trim());
      const platform = encodeURIComponent(document.getElementById('platformFilter').value);
      const res = await fetch(`/api/chats?q=${q}&platform=${platform}`);
      const data = await res.json();
      const container = document.getElementById('chatsList');

      if (!data.chats || !data.chats.length) {
        container.innerHTML = '<div class="panel" style="text-align:center; color:#94a3b8;">لا توجد محادثات مطابقة في السيرفر حالياً.</div>';
        return;
      }

      container.innerHTML = data.chats.map(c => `
        <div class="chat-card">
          <div class="chat-header">
            <div>
              <span class="badge ${c.platform === 'Gemini' ? 'badge-gem' : 'badge-gpt'}">${c.platform}</span>
              <strong style="font-size:15px; margin-right:6px;">${c.title}</strong>
            </div>
            <span style="color:#94a3b8; font-size:12px;">📅 ${c.date} | المعرف: ${c.chatId}</span>
          </div>
          <div style="color:#94a3b8; font-size:12px; margin-top:6px;">
            💬 الرسائل: <b>${c.messageCount}</b> | 📎 المرفقات: <b>${c.attachmentCount}</b> | 💻 الأكواد المستخرجة: <b>${c.extractedCodeCount} ملف</b>
          </div>
          <div class="capsule-box" id="cap-${c.chatId}"><strong>🧠 كبسولة استعادة السياق (Gemini AI):</strong>\n${c.aiCapsule || 'اضغط على زر (توليد كبسولة السياق) بالأسفل لتلخيص هذه المحادثة واستخراج أكوادها النهائية.'}</div>
          <div class="actions-bar">
            <button class="btn-sky" onclick="window.location.href='/api/export/txt?chatId=${c.chatId}'">📄 تحميل TXT مستقل</button>
            <button class="btn-amber" onclick="window.location.href='/api/export/zip?chatId=${c.chatId}'">📦 تحميل ZIP (المرفقات + الأكواد)</button>
            <button class="btn-blue" onclick="regenerateCapsule('${c.chatId}')">🧠 توليد/تحديث كبسولة السياق</button>
            <button class="btn-red" onclick="deleteChat('${c.chatId}')">🗑️ حذف</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      `).join('');
    }

    loadStats();
    loadChats();
  <\/script>
</body>

import os
import zipfile

base_dir = "Wispyte-AI-Cloud-Archiver-V8"
server_dir = os.path.join(base_dir, "wispyte-server")
public_dir = os.path.join(server_dir, "public")
ext_dir = os.path.join(base_dir, "browser-extension-v8")

os.makedirs(public_dir, exist_ok=True)
os.makedirs(ext_dir, exist_ok=True)

# 1. package.json
package_json = """{
  "name": "wispyte-ai-chat-archiver-cloud",
  "version": "8.0.0",
  "description": "Cloud AI Chat Archiver (Gemini & ChatGPT) with Multi-Key Gemini 2.5 Flash Router, Auto Context Capsule, Vision OCR, and Zero-Lag Chunk Streaming",
  "main": "server.js",
  "scripts": {
    "start": "node server.js"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "cors": "^2.8.5",
    "express": "^4.19.2"
  },
  "engines": {
    "node": ">=18.0.0"
  }
}
"""

# 2. zip_builder.js (Shared Pure-JS ZIP generator for Node.js & Browser)
zip_builder_js = """// Universal Pure-JS ZIP Builder (Works in Node.js & Browser without native dependencies)
class SimpleZip {
  constructor() {
    this.files = [];
    this.crcTable = this.makeCRCTable();
  }

  makeCRCTable() {
    const table = new Uint32Array(256);
    for (let n = 0; n < 256; n++) {
      let c = n;
      for (let k = 0; k < 8; k++) {
        c = (c & 1) ? (0xEDB88320 ^ (c >>> 1)) : (c >>> 1);
      }
      table[n] = c;
    }
    return table;
  }

  crc32(uint8Arr) {
    let crc = 0 ^ (-1);
    for (let i = 0; i < uint8Arr.length; i++) {
      crc = (crc >>> 8) ^ this.crcTable[(crc ^ uint8Arr[i]) & 0xFF];
    }
    return (crc ^ (-1)) >>> 0;
  }

  addFile(path, uint8Data) {
    const nameBytes = new TextEncoder().encode(path);
    const data = uint8Data instanceof Uint8Array ? uint8Data : new Uint8Array(uint8Data);
    const crc = this.crc32(data);
    this.files.push({ nameBytes, data, crc, size: data.length });
  }

  addTextFile(path, textContent) {
    this.addFile(path, new TextEncoder().encode(String(textContent || "")));
  }

  generateUint8Array() {
    let offset = 0;
    const chunks = [];
    const centralHeaders = [];
    const now = new Date();
    const dosTime = ((now.getHours() << 11) | (now.getMinutes() << 5) | (now.getSeconds() >> 1)) & 0xFFFF;
    const dosDate = (((now.getFullYear() - 1980) << 9) | ((now.getMonth() + 1) << 5) | now.getDate()) & 0xFFFF;

    for (const file of this.files) {
      const nameLen = file.nameBytes.length;
      const lh = new Uint8Array(30 + nameLen);
      const lv = new DataView(lh.buffer);
      lv.setUint32(0, 0x04034b50, true);
      lv.setUint16(4, 20, true);
      lv.setUint16(6, 0x0800, true);
      lv.setUint16(8, 0, true);
      lv.setUint16(10, dosTime, true);
      lv.setUint16(12, dosDate, true);
      lv.setUint32(14, file.crc, true);
      lv.setUint32(18, file.size, true);
      lv.setUint32(22, file.size, true);
      lv.setUint16(26, nameLen, true);
      lv.setUint16(28, 0, true);
      lh.set(file.nameBytes, 30);
      chunks.push(lh, file.data);

      const ch = new Uint8Array(46 + nameLen);
      const cv = new DataView(ch.buffer);
      cv.setUint32(0, 0x02014b50, true);
      cv.setUint16(4, 20, true);
      cv.setUint16(6, 20, true);
      cv.setUint16(8, 0x0800, true);
      cv.setUint16(10, 0, true);
      cv.setUint16(12, dosTime, true);
      cv.setUint16(14, dosDate, true);
      cv.setUint32(16, file.crc, true);
      cv.setUint32(20, file.size, true);
      cv.setUint32(24, file.size, true);
      cv.setUint16(28, nameLen, true);
      cv.setUint32(42, offset, true);
      ch.set(file.nameBytes, 46);
      centralHeaders.push(ch);

      offset += lh.length + file.size;
    }

    let centralSize = 0;
    for (const ch of centralHeaders) {
      chunks.push(ch);
      centralSize += ch.length;
    }

    const eocd = new Uint8Array(22);
    const ev = new DataView(eocd.buffer);
    ev.setUint32(0, 0x06054b50, true);
    ev.setUint16(8, this.files.length, true);
    ev.setUint16(10, this.files.length, true);
    ev.setUint32(12, centralSize, true);
    ev.setUint32(16, offset, true);
    chunks.push(eocd);

    const totalLen = chunks.reduce((acc, arr) => acc + arr.length, 0);
    const out = new Uint8Array(totalLen);
    let pos = 0;
    for (const arr of chunks) {
      out.set(arr, pos);
      pos += arr.length;
    }
    return out;
  }

  generateBuffer() {
    return Buffer.from(this.generateUint8Array());
  }

  generateBlob() {
    return new Blob([this.generateUint8Array()], { type: "application/zip" });
  }
}

if (typeof module !== "undefined" && module.exports) {
  module.exports = SimpleZip;
}
if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
  window.SimpleZip = SimpleZip;
}
"""

# 3. database.js (Zero-Crash Hybrid Storage Engine for Wispyte)
database_js = """const fs = require("fs");
const path = require("path");

const DATA_DIR = path.join(__dirname, "data");
const DB_FILE = path.join(DATA_DIR, "chats_db.json");
const SETTINGS_FILE = path.join(DATA_DIR, "settings.json");

if (!fs.existsSync(DATA_DIR)) {
  fs.mkdirSync(DATA_DIR, { recursive: true });
}

class ArchiveDatabase {
  constructor() {
    this.chats = new Map();
    this.streamBuffers = new Map();
    this.settings = {
      geminiKeys: process.env.GEMINI_API_KEYS ? process.env.GEMINI_API_KEYS.split(",").map(k => k.trim()).filter(Boolean) : [],
      apiSecret: process.env.API_SECRET || ""
    };
    this.loadFromDisk();
  }

  loadFromDisk() {
    try {
      if (fs.existsSync(DB_FILE)) {
        const raw = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(DB_FILE, "utf8"));
        (raw || []).forEach(c => this.chats.set(c.chatId, c));
      }
      if (fs.existsSync(SETTINGS_FILE)) {
        const s = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(SETTINGS_FILE, "utf8"));
        if (s.geminiKeys && s.geminiKeys.length) this.settings.geminiKeys = s.geminiKeys;
        if (s.apiSecret !== undefined) this.settings.apiSecret = s.apiSecret;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("[DB] Warning loading disk files:", e.message);
    }
  }

  persistChats() {
    try {
      const arr = Array.from(this.chats.values());
      fs.writeFileSync(DB_FILE, JSON.stringify(arr, null, 2), "utf8");
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("[DB] Persist error:", e.message);
    }
  }

  saveSettings(newSettings) {
    if (Array.isArray(newSettings.geminiKeys)) {
      this.settings.geminiKeys = newSettings.geminiKeys.map(k => k.trim()).filter(Boolean);
    }
    if (newSettings.apiSecret !== undefined) {
      this.settings.apiSecret = String(newSettings.apiSecret).trim();
    }
    fs.writeFileSync(SETTINGS_FILE, JSON.stringify(this.settings, null, 2), "utf8");
    return this.settings;
  }

  // Chunked streaming receiver (Frees Browser RAM during long chat scrolling!)
  appendStreamChunk({ chatId, platform, title, url, messagesChunk = [], attachmentsChunk = [] }) {
    if (!this.streamBuffers.has(chatId)) {
      this.streamBuffers.set(chatId, {
        chatId,
        platform: platform || "Gemini",
        title: title || "Chat",
        url: url || "",
        date: new Date().toLocaleString("ar-EG"),
        timestamp: Date.now(),
        messagesMap: new Map(),
        attachmentsMap: new Map()
      });
    }
    const buf = this.streamBuffers.get(chatId);
    if (title) buf.title = title;
    if (url) buf.url = url;

    messagesChunk.forEach(m => {
      const key = m.key || m.index || (m.role + "_" + String(m.text).slice(0, 40));
      buf.messagesMap.set(key, m);
    });

    attachmentsChunk.forEach(a => {
      if (a && a.id) buf.attachmentsMap.set(a.id, a);
    });

    return {
      chatId,
      bufferedMessages: buf.messagesMap.size,
      bufferedAttachments: buf.attachmentsMap.size
    };
  }

  finalizeStreamedChat(chatId, directChatObj = null) {
    let finalObj = directChatObj;
    if (!finalObj && this.streamBuffers.has(chatId)) {
      const buf = this.streamBuffers.get(chatId);
      const messages = Array.from(buf.messagesMap.values()).map((m, idx) => ({
        index: idx + 1,
        role: m.role,
        text: m.text
      }));
      const attachments = Array.from(buf.attachmentsMap.values());
      finalObj = {
        chatId: buf.chatId,
        platform: buf.platform,
        title: buf.title,
        url: buf.url,
        date: buf.date,
        timestamp: Date.now(),
        messageCount: messages.length,
        messages,
        attachments,
        aiCapsule: "",
        extractedFiles: []
      };
      this.streamBuffers.delete(chatId);
    }

    if (!finalObj) return null;
    const existing = this.chats.get(finalObj.chatId);
    if (existing && !finalObj.aiCapsule && existing.aiCapsule) {
      finalObj.aiCapsule = existing.aiCapsule;
    }
    this.chats.set(finalObj.chatId, finalObj);
    this.persistChats();
    return finalObj;
  }

  getChat(chatId) {
    return this.chats.get(chatId) || null;
  }

  getAllChats(platformFilter = "") {
    let list = Array.from(this.chats.values()).sort((a, b) => (b.timestamp || 0) - (a.timestamp || 0));
    if (platformFilter) {
      list = list.filter(c => c.platform.toLowerCase() === platformFilter.toLowerCase());
    }
    return list;
  }

  deleteChat(chatId) {
    const existed = this.chats.delete(chatId);
    if (existed) this.persistChats();
    return existed;
  }
}

module.exports = new ArchiveDatabase();
"""

# 4. gemini_service.js (Multi-Key Gemini Router + Context Capsule + Code Extractor + Archive Search)
gemini_service_js = """// Smart Gemini AI Service with Multi-Key Rotation, Context Capsule & Final Code Extractor
class GeminiService {
  constructor(db) {
    this.db = db;
    this.keyIndex = 0;
  }

  getNextApiKey() {
    const keys = this.db.settings.geminiKeys || [];
    if (!keys.length) return null;
    const key = keys[this.keyIndex % keys.length];
    this.keyIndex = (this.keyIndex + 1) % keys.length;
    return key;
  }

  async callGemini(promptText, inlineImageBase64 = null, mimeType = "image/png") {
    const keys = this.db.settings.geminiKeys || [];
    if (!keys.length) {
      throw new Error("لم يتم إضافة مفتاح Gemini API في الإعدادات بعد.");
    }

    let lastErr = null;
    for (let attempt = 0; attempt < keys.length; attempt++) {
      const apiKey = this.getNextApiKey();
      try {
        const parts = [{ text: promptText }];
        if (inlineImageBase64) {
          const cleanB64 = inlineImageBase64.includes(",") ? inlineImageBase64.split(",")[1] : inlineImageBase64;
          parts.push({ inline_data: { mime_type: mimeType, data: cleanB64 } });
        }

        const url = `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemini-2.5-flash:generateContent?key=${apiKey}`;
        const res = await fetch(url, {
          method: "POST",
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
          body: JSON.stringify({ contents: [{ parts }] })
        });

        const data = await res.json();
        if (!res.ok) {
          throw new Error(data.error ? data.error.message : `HTTP ${res.status}`);
        }
        const reply = data?.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts?.[0]?.text;
        if (reply) return reply.trim();
      } catch (err) {
        lastErr = err;
      }
    }
    throw lastErr || new Error("فشل الاتصال بجميع مفاتيح Gemini المتاحة.");
  }

  // 1. Generate Smart Context Capsule for instant AI memory restoration
  async generateContextCapsule(chatObj) {
    const transcript = (chatObj.messages || [])
      .map(m => `[${m.role} #${m.index}]:\n${m.text}`)
      .join("\n\n")
      .slice(-28000); // Focus on the most recent & relevant 28k chars

    const prompt = [
      "أنت مهندس برمجيات ومحلل سياق محترف. قم بتحليل هذه المحادثة وإنشاء (كبسولة استعادة السياق الفورية) باللغة العربية بحيث لو رفع المستخدم هذا الملف لنموذج ذكاء اصطناعي جديد يفهم كل شيء في ثوانٍ.",
      "يجب أن تتضمن الكبسولة الأقسام التالية بوضوح:",
      "1. 🎯 الهدف الأساسي للمشروع أو النقاش.",
      "2. ✅ أهم القرارات والمواصفات التقنية التي تم اعتمادها.",
      "3. 💻 جرد لأحدث الملفات والأكواد النهائية المعتمدة في المحادثة (تجاهل النسخ القديمة الملغاة).",
      "4. 📍 نقطة التوقف الأخيرة والخطوة المطلوبة تالياً.",
      "",
      "نص المحادثة:",
      transcript
    ].join("\n");

    return await this.callGemini(prompt);
  }

  // 2. Automatically extract code blocks from the chat into standalone files for the ZIP
  extractCodeBlocksFromChat(chatObj) {
    const codeFiles = [];
    const extMap = {
      javascript: "js", js: "js", python: "py", py: "py",
      html: "html", css: "css", json: "json", sql: "sql",
      bash: "sh", sh: "sh", typescript: "ts", ts: "ts"
    };

    const regex = /```([a-zA-Z0-9_-]*)\n([\s\S]*?)```/g;
    (chatObj.messages || []).forEach((m) => {
      let match;
      let blockIdx = 1;
      while ((match = regex.exec(m.text)) !== null) {
        const lang = (match[1] || "txt").toLowerCase();
        const code = (match[2] || "").trim();
        if (code.length < 30) continue;
        const ext = extMap[lang] || "txt";
        const fileName = `MSG${String(m.index).padStart(3, "0")}_Code${blockIdx}.${ext}`;
        codeFiles.push({
          fileName,
          zipPath: `Extracted_Code/${fileName}`,
          lang,
          msgIndex: m.index,
          content: code
        });
        blockIdx++;
      }
    });
    return codeFiles;
  }

  // 3. Ask AI across all archived chats
  async askAcrossArchive(question) {
    const allChats = this.db.getAllChats();
    if (!allChats.length) return "لا توجد محادثات في الأرشيف للبحث فيها بعد.";

    const contextDigest = allChats.slice(0, 15).map(c => {
      const lastMsgs = (c.messages || []).slice(-4).map(m => `${m.role}: ${m.text.slice(0, 400)}`).join("\n");
      return `=== محادثة: ${c.title} (${c.platform} | ID: ${c.chatId}) ===\nالملخص: ${c.aiCapsule || "لا يوجد"}\nمقتطفات:\n${lastMsgs}`;
    }).join("\n\n");

    const prompt = `بناءً على أرشيف محادثات المستخدم التالي، أجب بدقة عن سؤاله مع ذكر اسم المحادثة ومعرفها (ID):\n\nسؤال المستخدم: ${question}\n\nالأرشيف:\n${contextDigest}`;
    return await this.callGemini(prompt);
  }
}

module.exports = GeminiService;
"""

# 5. server.js (Main Wispyte Cloud Server)
server_js = """const express = require("express");
const cors = require("cors");
const path = require("path");
const db = require("./database");
const GeminiService = require("./gemini_service");
const SimpleZip = require("./zip_builder");

const app = express();
const PORT = process.env.PORT || 3000;
const gemini = new GeminiService(db);

app.use(cors());
app.use(express.json({ limit: "50mb" }));
app.use(express.static(path.join(__dirname, "public")));

// Health & Stats Endpoint
app.get("/api/status", (req, res) => {
  const chats = db.getAllChats();
  const gemCount = chats.filter(c => c.platform === "Gemini").length;
  const gptCount = chats.filter(c => c.platform === "ChatGPT").length;
  res.json({
    ok: true,
    version: "8.0.0-Wispyte-Cloud",
    totalChats: chats.length,
    geminiChats: gemCount,
    gptChats: gptCount,
    configuredKeysCount: (db.settings.geminiKeys || []).length
  });
});

// Configure Gemini API Keys (Supports up to 20 keys with automatic rotation!)
app.post("/api/settings", (req, res) => {
  const { geminiKeys, apiSecret } = req.body || {};
  const updated = db.saveSettings({ geminiKeys, apiSecret });
  res.json({
    ok: true,
    configuredKeysCount: updated.geminiKeys.length,
    message: `تم حفظ ${updated.geminiKeys.length} مفتاح Gemini API بنجاح!`
  });
});

// 1. Chunked Stream Endpoint (Zero-Lag incremental upload from Browser Extension)
app.post("/api/stream-chunk", (req, res) => {
  try {
    const result = db.appendStreamChunk(req.body || {});
    res.json({ ok: true, ...result });
  } catch (err) {
    res.status(500).json({ ok: false, error: err.message });
  }
});

// 2. Save / Finalize Chat + Auto-Run Gemini Context Capsule & Code Extractor
app.post("/api/save-chat", async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { chatId, generateAiCapsule = true, ...payload } = req.body || {};
    const finalChat = db.finalizeStreamedChat(chatId, payload.messages ? { chatId, ...payload } : null);
    if (!finalChat) {
      return res.status(400).json({ ok: false, error: "لم يتم العثور على بيانات المحادثة." });
    }

    // Extract code blocks into standalone files metadata
    finalChat.extractedFiles = gemini.extractCodeBlocksFromChat(finalChat);

    // Generate AI Context Capsule if Gemini keys are configured
    if (generateAiCapsule && (db.settings.geminiKeys || []).length > 0) {
      try {
        finalChat.aiCapsule = await gemini.generateContextCapsule(finalChat);
      } catch (aiErr) {
        finalChat.aiCapsule = `تعذر توليد الكبسولة تلقائياً: ${aiErr.message}`;
      }
    }

    db.finalizeStreamedChat(finalChat.chatId, finalChat);
    res.json({
      ok: true,
      chatId: finalChat.chatId,
      messageCount: finalChat.messageCount,
      extractedCodeCount: finalChat.extractedFiles.length,
      aiCapsule: finalChat.aiCapsule
    });
  } catch (err) {
    res.status(500).json({ ok: false, error: err.message });
  }
});

// 3. Generate/Refresh AI Context Capsule on demand
app.post("/api/chats/:chatId/generate-capsule", async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const chat = db.getChat(req.params.chatId);
    if (!chat) return res.status(404).json({ ok: false, error: "المحادثة غير موجودة" });
    chat.aiCapsule = await gemini.generateContextCapsule(chat);
    db.finalizeStreamedChat(chat.chatId, chat);
    res.json({ ok: true, aiCapsule: chat.aiCapsule });
  } catch (err) {
    res.status(500).json({ ok: false, error: err.message });
  }
});

// 4. Get All Archived Chats (Metadata + AI Capsule)
app.get("/api/chats", (req, res) => {
  const platform = req.query.platform || "";
  const q = (req.query.q || "").toLowerCase().trim();
  let chats = db.getAllChats(platform);

  if (q) {
    chats = chats.filter(c =>
      (c.title || "").toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      (c.aiCapsule || "").toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      (c.messages || []).some(m => (m.text || "").toLowerCase().includes(q))
    );
  }

  res.json({
    ok: true,
    chats: chats.map(c => ({
      chatId: c.chatId,
      platform: c.platform,
      title: c.title,
      url: c.url,
      date: c.date,
      timestamp: c.timestamp,
      messageCount: c.messageCount,
      attachmentCount: (c.attachments || []).length,
      extractedCodeCount: (c.extractedFiles || []).length,
      aiCapsule: c.aiCapsule || ""
    }))
  });
});

// 5. Delete a Chat
app.delete("/api/chats/:chatId", (req, res) => {
  db.deleteChat(req.params.chatId);
  res.json({ ok: true });
});

// 6. Ask Gemini Across Your Entire Archive
app.post("/api/ask-archive", async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const answer = await gemini.askAcrossArchive(req.body.question || "");
    res.json({ ok: true, answer });
  } catch (err) {
    res.status(500).json({ ok: false, error: err.message });
  }
});

// Helper: Format Chats into Standalone AI-Ready TXT
function buildStandaloneTxt(chatsList, label = "ARCHIVE") {
  const dateStamp = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  const zipName = `AI_Chats_${label}_${dateStamp}_Attachments.zip`;
  const gemCount = chatsList.filter(c => c.platform === "Gemini").length;
  const gptCount = chatsList.filter(c => c.platform === "ChatGPT").length;
  const totalMsgs = chatsList.reduce((a, c) => a + (c.messageCount || 0), 0);
  const totalAtts = chatsList.reduce((a, c) => a + (c.attachments ? c.attachments.length : 0), 0);

  let out = "";
  out += "================================================================================\\n";
  out += "         ☁️ أرشيف محادثات الذكاء الاصطناعي السحابي (WISPYTE AI ARCHIVE V8)\\n";
  out += "================================================================================\\n";
  out += `• تاريخ التصدير: ${new Date().toLocaleString("ar-EG")}\\n`;
  out += `• إجمالي المحادثات: ${chatsList.length} (${totalMsgs} رسالة) | Gemini: ${gemCount} | ChatGPT: ${gptCount}\\n`;
  out += `• ملف الـ ZIP المرفق للصور والأكواد المستخرجة: ${totalAtts > 0 ? zipName : "متاح عند الطلب"}\\n`;
  out += "--------------------------------------------------------------------------------\\n";
  out += "💡 [توجيه للذكاء الاصطناعي]: يحتوي هذا الملف في بداية كل محادثة على (كبسولة استعادة السياق)\\n";
  out += "التي تلخص الهدف والقرارات والأكواد النهائية، يليها النص الكامل للمحادثة وبطاقات المرفقات.\\n";
  out += "================================================================================\\n\\n";

  chatsList.forEach((chat, idx) => {
    out += `╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗\\n`;
    out += `  محادثة (#${idx + 1}) | المنصة: [${chat.platform}] | المعرف: ${chat.chatId}\\n`;
    out += `  العنوان: ${chat.title} | التاريخ: ${chat.date}\\n`;
    out += `  الرابط: ${chat.url}\\n`;
    out += `╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝\\n\\n`;

    if (chat.aiCapsule) {
      out += `┏━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🧠 [كبسولة استعادة السياق الذكية - Gemini AI] ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┓\\n`;
      out += `${chat.aiCapsule}\\n`;
      out += `┗━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┛\\n\\n`;
    }

    (chat.messages || []).forEach(m => {
      const speaker = m.role === "User"
        ? `👤 [المستخدم -> ${chat.platform}] (رسالة #${m.index})`
        : `🤖 [${m.role}] (رد #${m.index})`;
      out += `${speaker}:\\n${m.text}\\n\\n--------------------------------------------------------------------------------\\n\\n`;
    });

    out += `\\n════════════════════ [نهاية محادثة #${idx + 1} (${chat.chatId})] ════════════════════\\n\\n\\n`;
  });

  return out;
}

// 7. Download Standalone TXT (Single Chat or Filtered Archive)
app.get("/api/export/txt", (req, res) => {
  const { chatId, platform } = req.query;
  let list = [];
  let label = "ALL";

  if (chatId) {
    const c = db.getChat(chatId);
    if (c) list = [c];
    label = chatId;
  } else {
    list = db.getAllChats(platform || "");
    if (platform) label = platform.toUpperCase();
  }

  const txtContent = buildStandaloneTxt(list, label);
  const filename = `AI_Chats_${label}_${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.txt`;
  res.setHeader("Content-Type", "text/plain; charset=utf-8");
  res.setHeader("Content-Disposition", `attachment; filename="${filename}"`);
  res.send(txtContent);
});

// 8. Download Separate ZIP (Attachments + Final Extracted Code Files)
app.get("/api/export/zip", async (req, res) => {
  const { chatId, platform } = req.query;
  let list = [];
  let label = "ALL";

  if (chatId) {
    const c = db.getChat(chatId);
    if (c) list = [c];
    label = chatId;
  } else {
    list = db.getAllChats(platform || "");
    if (platform) label = platform.toUpperCase();
  }

  const zip = new SimpleZip();
  const indexManifest = { exportDate: new Date().toISOString(), chatsCount: list.length, attachments: [], codeFiles: [] };

  for (const chat of list) {
    // Add extracted code files into ZIP
    const codes = chat.extractedFiles && chat.extractedFiles.length
      ? chat.extractedFiles
      : gemini.extractCodeBlocksFromChat(chat);

    codes.forEach(cf => {
      const pathInZip = `${chat.platform}_${chat.chatId}/${cf.zipPath}`;
      zip.addTextFile(pathInZip, cf.content);
      indexManifest.codeFiles.push({ chatId: chat.chatId, pathInZip, lang: cf.lang });
    });

    // Add media attachments metadata / base64 if present
    for (const att of (chat.attachments || [])) {
      indexManifest.attachments.push(att);
      if (att.dataUrl && att.dataUrl.includes(",")) {
        const b64 = att.dataUrl.split(",")[1];
        zip.addFile(att.zipPath, Buffer.from(b64, "base64"));
      } else {
        zip.addTextFile(att.zipPath + ".url.txt", `Original URL: ${att.originalUrl}\\nAlt: ${att.alt}`);
      }
    }
  }

  zip.addTextFile("archive_manifest.json", JSON.stringify(indexManifest, null, 2));
  const zipBuf = zip.generateBuffer();
  const filename = `AI_Chats_${label}_${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}_Attachments_And_Code.zip`;
  res.setHeader("Content-Type", "application/zip");
  res.setHeader("Content-Disposition", `attachment; filename="${filename}"`);
  res.send(zipBuf);
});

app.listen(PORT, "0.0.0.0", () => {
  console.log(`🚀 Wispyte AI Cloud Archiver V8 running on http://0.0.0.0:${PORT}`);
});
"""

# 6. public/index.html (Cloud Web Dashboard UI)
dashboard_html = """<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ar" dir="rtl">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Wispyte AI Cloud Archiver V8 - لوحة التحكم السحابية</title>
  <style>
    :root {
      --bg: #090d16; --card: #131c2e; --border: #263554;
      --text: #f8fafc; --muted: #94a3b8; --accent: #38bdf8;
      --gem: #2563eb; --gpt: #10b981;
    }
    * { box-sizing: border-box; }
    body { margin: 0; padding: 20px; background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); font-family: 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; }
    .container { max-width: 1020px; margin: 0 auto; }
    .top-bar { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); padding-bottom: 14px; margin-bottom: 18px; }
    .top-bar h1 { margin: 0; font-size: 21px; color: var(--accent); }

  <script>
    async function loadStats() {
      const res = await fetch('/api/status');
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.ok) {
        document.getElementById('stTotal').textContent = data.totalChats;
        document.getElementById('stGem').textContent = data.geminiChats;
        document.getElementById('stGpt').textContent = data.gptChats;
        document.getElementById('stKeys').textContent = data.configuredKeysCount + ' مفتاح';
      }
    }

    async function saveKeys() {
      const raw = document.getElementById('keysInput').value;
      const geminiKeys = raw.split(/[,\n]+/).map(k => k.trim()).filter(Boolean);
      const res = await fetch('/api/settings', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ geminiKeys })
      });
      const data = await res.json();
      alert(data.message || 'تم الحفظ');
      loadStats();
    }

    async function askArchive() {
      const question = document.getElementById('askInput').value.trim();
      if (!question) return;
      const box = document.getElementById('askAnswer');
      box.style.display = 'block';
      box.textContent = '⏳ جاري البحث في الأرشيف وتحليل الإجابة عبر Gemini...';
      const res = await fetch('/api/ask-archive', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ question })
      });
      const data = await res.json();
      box.textContent = data.ok ? data.answer : ('❌ خطأ: ' + data.error);
    }

    async function regenerateCapsule(chatId) {
      const el = document.getElementById('cap-' + chatId);
      if (el) el.textContent = '⏳ جاري قراءة المحادثة وتوليد كبسولة استعادة السياق عبر Gemini...';
      const res = await fetch(`/api/chats/${chatId}/generate-capsule`, { method: 'POST' });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (el) el.textContent = data.ok ? data.aiCapsule : ('❌ ' + data.error);
    }

    async function deleteChat(chatId) {
      if (!confirm('هل تريد حذف هذه المحادثة من السيرفر؟')) return;
      await fetch(`/api/chats/${chatId}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
      loadStats();
      loadChats();
    }

    async function loadChats() {
      const q = encodeURIComponent(document.getElementById('searchBox').value.trim());
      const platform = encodeURIComponent(document.getElementById('platformFilter').value);
      const res = await fetch(`/api/chats?q=${q}&platform=${platform}`);
      const data = await res.json();
      const container = document.getElementById('chatsList');

      if (!data.chats || !data.chats.length) {
        container.innerHTML = '<div class="panel" style="text-align:center; color:#94a3b8;">لا توجد محادثات مطابقة في السيرفر حالياً.</div>';
        return;
      }

      container.innerHTML = data.chats.map(c => `
        <div class="chat-card">
          <div class="chat-header">
            <div>
              <span class="badge ${c.platform === 'Gemini' ? 'badge-gem' : 'badge-gpt'}">${c.platform}</span>
              <strong style="font-size:15px; margin-right:6px;">${c.title}</strong>
            </div>
            <span style="color:#94a3b8; font-size:12px;">📅 ${c.date} | المعرف: ${c.chatId}</span>
          </div>
          <div style="color:#94a3b8; font-size:12px; margin-top:6px;">
            💬 الرسائل: <b>${c.messageCount}</b> | 📎 المرفقات: <b>${c.attachmentCount}</b> | 💻 الأكواد المستخرجة: <b>${c.extractedCodeCount} ملف</b>
          </div>
          <div class="capsule-box" id="cap-${c.chatId}"><strong>🧠 كبسولة استعادة السياق (Gemini AI):</strong>\n${c.aiCapsule || 'اضغط على زر (توليد كبسولة السياق) بالأسفل لتلخيص هذه المحادثة واستخراج أكوادها النهائية.'}</div>
          <div class="actions-bar">
            <button class="btn-sky" onclick="window.location.href='/api/export/txt?chatId=${c.chatId}'">📄 تحميل TXT مستقل</button>
            <button class="btn-amber" onclick="window.location.href='/api/export/zip?chatId=${c.chatId}'">📦 تحميل ZIP (المرفقات + الأكواد)</button>
            <button class="btn-blue" onclick="regenerateCapsule('${c.chatId}')">🧠 توليد/تحديث كبسولة السياق</button>
            <button class="btn-red" onclick="deleteChat('${c.chatId}')">🗑️ حذف</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      `).join('');
    }

    loadStats();
    loadChats();
  </script>
</body>

لقد قمت بإعادة هندسة وبناء مشروع السيرفر السحابي بالكامل من الصفر (Wispyte AI Cloud Archiver - V8)، وصممته خصيصاً ليتوافق مع حاويات Wispyte (Node.js) بدون أي أخطاء بناء (Zero-Native Build Errors)، مع دعم نظام تدوير مفاتيح Gemini API (حتى 20 مفتاحاً)، وتوليد كبسولة استعادة السياق، واستخراج الأكواد النهائية تلقائياً في ملفات مستقلة داخل الـ ZIP.

🗺️ خطوات رفع وتشغيل المشروع على استضافة Wispyte بالتفصيل

  1. إنشاء السيرفر على Wispyte:
    • ادخل إلى لوحة تحكم Wispyte وأنشئ سيرفر جديد ببيئة Node.js (يفضل الإصدار 18 أو أحدث).
  2. رفع الملفات:
    • اذهب إلى تبويب Files (مدير الملفات) في لوحة تحكم Wispyte.
    • ارفع ملف Wispyte-Cloud-Server-V8.zip (المرفق بالأعلى أو المتولد من كود الـ HTML بالأسفل)، ثم اضغط عليه كليك يمين واختر Unarchive / فك الضغط في المجلد الرئيسي للسيرفر.
  3. ضبط إعدادات التشغيل (Startup):
    • اذهب إلى تبويب Startup / Settings وتأكد أن ملف التشغيل الرئيسي (Main File / Entrypoint) مكتوب فيه: server.js.
    • سيقوم السيرفر تلقائياً بقراءة رقم البورت المخصص لك من Wispyte عبر المتغير process.env.PORT.
  4. تشغيل السيرفر وفتح لوحة التحكم السحابية:
    • اضغط على زر Start في تبويب Console؛ سيقوم السيرفر بتثبيت حزمتي express و cors في ثوانٍ وتشغيل النظام.
    • انسخ عنوان السيرفر والـ Port الخاص بك (مثلاً [http://123.45.67.89:25565](http://123.45.67.89:25565)) وافتحه في المتصفح؛ ستفتح لك لوحة التحكم السحابية (Cloud Dashboard) حيث يمكنك وضع مفاتيح Gemini API الخاصة بك وتصفح وتحميل محادثاتك.

📂 أولاً: جميع ملفات مشروع السيرفر (مكتوبة ومنسقة بالكامل)

2. ملف database.js (محرك قاعدة البيانات الذري + مستقبل التمرير المتدفق Chunked Stream)

const fs = require("fs");
const path = require("path");

const DATA_DIR = path.join(__dirname, "data");
const DB_FILE = path.join(DATA_DIR, "chats_db.json");
const SETTINGS_FILE = path.join(DATA_DIR, "settings.json");

if (!fs.existsSync(DATA_DIR)) {
  fs.mkdirSync(DATA_DIR, { recursive: true });
}

class ArchiveDatabase {
  constructor() {
    this.chats = new Map();
    this.streamBuffers = new Map();
    this.settings = {
      geminiKeys: process.env.GEMINI_API_KEYS
        ? process.env.GEMINI_API_KEYS.split(",").map(k => k.trim()).filter(Boolean)
        : [],
      apiSecret: process.env.API_SECRET || ""
    };
    this.loadFromDisk();
  }

  loadFromDisk() {
    try {
      if (fs.existsSync(DB_FILE)) {
        const raw = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(DB_FILE, "utf8"));
        (raw || []).forEach(c => this.chats.set(c.chatId, c));
      }
      if (fs.existsSync(SETTINGS_FILE)) {
        const s = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(SETTINGS_FILE, "utf8"));
        if (s.geminiKeys && s.geminiKeys.length) this.settings.geminiKeys = s.geminiKeys;
        if (s.apiSecret !== undefined) this.settings.apiSecret = s.apiSecret;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("[DB] Warning loading disk files:", e.message);
    }
  }

  persistChats() {
    try {
      const arr = Array.from(this.chats.values());
      fs.writeFileSync(DB_FILE, JSON.stringify(arr, null, 2), "utf8");
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("[DB] Persist error:", e.message);
    }
  }

  saveSettings(newSettings) {
    if (Array.isArray(newSettings.geminiKeys)) {
      this.settings.geminiKeys = newSettings.geminiKeys.map(k => k.trim()).filter(Boolean);
    }
    if (newSettings.apiSecret !== undefined) {
      this.settings.apiSecret = String(newSettings.apiSecret).trim();
    }
    fs.writeFileSync(SETTINGS_FILE, JSON.stringify(this.settings, null, 2), "utf8");
    return this.settings;
  }

  // يستقبل دفعات الرسائل أثناء التمرير ليفرغ رامات المتصفح فوراً
  appendStreamChunk({ chatId, platform, title, url, messagesChunk = [], attachmentsChunk = [] }) {
    if (!this.streamBuffers.has(chatId)) {
      this.streamBuffers.set(chatId, {
        chatId,
        platform: platform || "Gemini",
        title: title || "Chat",
        url: url || "",
        date: new Date().toLocaleString("ar-EG"),
        timestamp: Date.now(),
        messagesMap: new Map(),
        attachmentsMap: new Map()
      });
    }
    const buf = this.streamBuffers.get(chatId);
    if (title) buf.title = title;
    if (url) buf.url = url;

    messagesChunk.forEach(m => {
      const key = m.key || m.index || (m.role + "_" + String(m.text).slice(0, 40));
      buf.messagesMap.set(key, m);
    });

    attachmentsChunk.forEach(a => {
      if (a && a.id) buf.attachmentsMap.set(a.id, a);
    });

    return {
      chatId,
      bufferedMessages: buf.messagesMap.size,
      bufferedAttachments: buf.attachmentsMap.size
    };
  }

  finalizeStreamedChat(chatId, directChatObj = null) {
    let finalObj = directChatObj;
    if (!finalObj && this.streamBuffers.has(chatId)) {
      const buf = this.streamBuffers.get(chatId);
      const messages = Array.from(buf.messagesMap.values()).map((m, idx) => ({
        index: idx + 1,
        role: m.role,
        text: m.text
      }));
      const attachments = Array.from(buf.attachmentsMap.values());
      finalObj = {
        chatId: buf.chatId,
        platform: buf.platform,
        title: buf.title,
        url: buf.url,
        date: buf.date,
        timestamp: Date.now(),
        messageCount: messages.length,
        messages,
        attachments,
        aiCapsule: "",
        extractedFiles: []
      };
      this.streamBuffers.delete(chatId);
    }

    if (!finalObj) return null;
    const existing = this.chats.get(finalObj.chatId);
    if (existing && !finalObj.aiCapsule && existing.aiCapsule) {
      finalObj.aiCapsule = existing.aiCapsule;
    }
    this.chats.set(finalObj.chatId, finalObj);
    this.persistChats();
    return finalObj;
  }

  getChat(chatId) {
    return this.chats.get(chatId) || null;
  }

  getAllChats(platformFilter = "") {
    let list = Array.from(this.chats.values()).sort((a, b) => (b.timestamp || 0) - (a.timestamp || 0));
    if (platformFilter) {
      list = list.filter(c => c.platform.toLowerCase() === platformFilter.toLowerCase());
    }
    return list;
  }

  deleteChat(chatId) {
    const existed = this.chats.delete(chatId);
    if (existed) this.persistChats();
    return existed;
  }
}

module.exports = new ArchiveDatabase();

3. ملف gemini_service.js (موزع مفاتيح Gemini + كبسولة السياق + مستخرج الأكواد)

class GeminiService {
  constructor(db) {
    this.db = db;
    this.keyIndex = 0;
  }

  getNextApiKey() {
    const keys = this.db.settings.geminiKeys || [];
    if (!keys.length) return null;
    const key = keys[this.keyIndex % keys.length];
    this.keyIndex = (this.keyIndex + 1) % keys.length;
    return key;
  }

  async callGemini(promptText, inlineImageBase64 = null, mimeType = "image/png") {
    const keys = this.db.settings.geminiKeys || [];
    if (!keys.length) {
      throw new Error("لم يتم إضافة مفتاح Gemini API في الإعدادات بعد.");
    }

    let lastErr = null;
    for (let attempt = 0; attempt < keys.length; attempt++) {
      const apiKey = this.getNextApiKey();
      try {
        const parts = [{ text: promptText }];
        if (inlineImageBase64) {
          const cleanB64 = inlineImageBase64.includes(",") ? inlineImageBase64.split(",")[1] : inlineImageBase64;
          parts.push({ inline_data: { mime_type: mimeType, data: cleanB64 } });
        }

        const url = `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemini-2.5-flash:generateContent?key=${apiKey}`;
        const res = await fetch(url, {
          method: "POST",
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
          body: JSON.stringify({ contents: [{ parts }] })
        });

        const data = await res.json();
        if (!res.ok) {
          throw new Error(data.error ? data.error.message : `HTTP ${res.status}`);
        }
        const reply = data?.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts?.[0]?.text;
        if (reply) return reply.trim();
      } catch (err) {
        lastErr = err;
      }
    }
    throw lastErr || new Error("فشل الاتصال بجميع مفاتيح Gemini المتاحة.");
  }

  async generateContextCapsule(chatObj) {
    const transcript = (chatObj.messages || [])
      .map(m => `[${m.role} #${m.index}]:\n${m.text}`)
      .join("\n\n")
      .slice(-28000);

    const prompt = [
      "أنت مهندس برمجيات ومحلل سياق محترف. قم بتحليل هذه المحادثة وإنشاء (كبسولة استعادة السياق الفورية) باللغة العربية بحيث لو رفع المستخدم هذا الملف لنموذج ذكاء اصطناعي جديد يفهم كل شيء في ثوانٍ.",
      "يجب أن تتضمن الكبسولة الأقسام التالية بوضوح:",
      "1. 🎯 الهدف الأساسي للمشروع أو النقاش.",
      "2. ✅ أهم القرارات والمواصفات التقنية التي تم اعتمادها.",
      "3. 💻 جرد لأحدث الملفات والأكواد النهائية المعتمدة في المحادثة (تجاهل النسخ القديمة الملغاة).",
      "4. 📍 نقطة التوقف الأخيرة والخطوة المطلوبة تالياً.",
      "",
      "نص المحادثة:",
      transcript
    ].join("\n");

    return await this.callGemini(prompt);
  }

  extractCodeBlocksFromChat(chatObj) {
    const codeFiles = [];
    const extMap = {
      javascript: "js", js: "js", python: "py", py: "py",
      html: "html", css: "css", json: "json", sql: "sql",
      bash: "sh", sh: "sh", typescript: "ts", ts: "ts"
    };

    const regex = /```([a-zA-Z0-9_-]*)\n([\s\S]*?)```/g;
    (chatObj.messages || []).forEach((m) => {
      let match;
      let blockIdx = 1;
      while ((match = regex.exec(m.text)) !== null) {
        const lang = (match[1] || "txt").toLowerCase();
        const code = (match[2] || "").trim();
        if (code.length < 30) continue;
        const ext = extMap[lang] || "txt";
        const fileName = `MSG${String(m.index).padStart(3, "0")}_Code${blockIdx}.${ext}`;
        codeFiles.push({
          fileName,
          zipPath: `Extracted_Code/${fileName}`,
          lang,
          msgIndex: m.index,
          content: code
        });
        blockIdx++;
      }
    });
    return codeFiles;
  }

  async askAcrossArchive(question) {
    const allChats = this.db.getAllChats();
    if (!allChats.length) return "لا توجد محادثات في الأرشيف للبحث فيها بعد.";

    const contextDigest = allChats.slice(0, 15).map(c => {
      const lastMsgs = (c.messages || []).slice(-4).map(m => `${m.role}: ${m.text.slice(0, 400)}`).join("\n");
      return `=== محادثة: ${c.title} (${c.platform} | ID: ${c.chatId}) ===\nالملخص: ${c.aiCapsule || "لا يوجد"}\nمقتطفات:\n${lastMsgs}`;
    }).join("\n\n");

    const prompt = `بناءً على أرشيف محادثات المستخدم التالي، أجب بدقة عن سؤاله مع ذكر اسم المحادثة ومعرفها (ID):\n\nسؤال المستخدم: ${question}\n\nالأرشيف:\n${contextDigest}`;
    return await this.callGemini(prompt);
  }
}

module.exports = GeminiService;

4. ملف zip_builder.js (محرك ضغط ملفات الـ ZIP على السيرفر والمتصفح)

class SimpleZip {
  constructor() {
    this.files = [];
    this.crcTable = this.makeCRCTable();
  }

  makeCRCTable() {
    const table = new Uint32Array(256);
    for (let n = 0; n < 256; n++) {
      let c = n;
      for (let k = 0; k < 8; k++) c = (c & 1) ? (0xEDB88320 ^ (c >>> 1)) : (c >>> 1);
      table[n] = c;
    }
    return table;
  }

  crc32(uint8Arr) {
    let crc = 0 ^ (-1);
    for (let i = 0; i < uint8Arr.length; i++) {
      crc = (crc >>> 8) ^ this.crcTable[(crc ^ uint8Arr[i]) & 0xFF];
    }
    return (crc ^ (-1)) >>> 0;
  }

  addFile(path, uint8Data) {
    const nameBytes = new TextEncoder().encode(path);
    const data = uint8Data instanceof Uint8Array ? uint8Data : new Uint8Array(uint8Data);
    const crc = this.crc32(data);
    this.files.push({ nameBytes, data, crc, size: data.length });
  }

  addTextFile(path, textContent) {
    this.addFile(path, new TextEncoder().encode(String(textContent || "")));
  }

  generateUint8Array() {
    let offset = 0;
    const chunks = [];
    const centralHeaders = [];
    const now = new Date();
    const dosTime = ((now.getHours() << 11) | (now.getMinutes() << 5) | (now.getSeconds() >> 1)) & 0xFFFF;
    const dosDate = (((now.getFullYear() - 1980) << 9) | ((now.getMonth() + 1) << 5) | now.getDate()) & 0xFFFF;

    for (const file of this.files) {
      const nameLen = file.nameBytes.length;
      const lh = new Uint8Array(30 + nameLen);
      const lv = new DataView(lh.buffer);
      lv.setUint32(0, 0x04034b50, true);
      lv.setUint16(4, 20, true);
      lv.setUint16(6, 0x0800, true);
      lv.setUint16(8, 0, true);
      lv.setUint16(10, dosTime, true);
      lv.setUint16(12, dosDate, true);
      lv.setUint32(14, file.crc, true);
      lv.setUint32(18, file.size, true);
      lv.setUint32(22, file.size, true);
      lv.setUint16(26, nameLen, true);
      lv.setUint16(28, 0, true);
      lh.set(file.nameBytes, 30);
      chunks.push(lh, file.data);

      const ch = new Uint8Array(46 + nameLen);
      const cv = new DataView(ch.buffer);
      cv.setUint32(0, 0x02014b50, true);
      cv.setUint16(4, 20, true);
      cv.setUint16(6, 20, true);
      cv.setUint16(8, 0x0800, true);
      cv.setUint16(10, 0, true);
      cv.setUint16(12, dosTime, true);
      cv.setUint16(14, dosDate, true);
      cv.setUint32(16, file.crc, true);
      cv.setUint32(20, file.size, true);
      cv.setUint32(24, file.size, true);
      cv.setUint16(28, nameLen, true);
      cv.setUint32(42, offset, true);
      ch.set(file.nameBytes, 46);
      centralHeaders.push(ch);

      offset += lh.length + file.size;
    }

    let centralSize = 0;
    for (const ch of centralHeaders) {
      chunks.push(ch);
      centralSize += ch.length;
    }

    const eocd = new Uint8Array(22);
    const ev = new DataView(eocd.buffer);
    ev.setUint32(0, 0x06054b50, true);
    ev.setUint16(8, this.files.length, true);
    ev.setUint16(10, this.files.length, true);
    ev.setUint32(12, centralSize, true);
    ev.setUint32(16, offset, true);
    chunks.push(eocd);

    const totalLen = chunks.reduce((acc, arr) => acc + arr.length, 0);
    const out = new Uint8Array(totalLen);
    let pos = 0;
    for (const arr of chunks) {
      out.set(arr, pos);
      pos += arr.length;
    }
    return out;
  }

  generateBuffer() {
    return Buffer.from(this.generateUint8Array());
  }

  generateBlob() {
    return new Blob([this.generateUint8Array()], { type: "application/zip" });
  }
}

if (typeof module !== "undefined" && module.exports) module.exports = SimpleZip;
if (typeof window !== "undefined") window.SimpleZip = SimpleZip;

5. ملف server.js (الخادم السحابي الرئيسي)

const express = require("express");
const cors = require("cors");
const path = require("path");
const db = require("./database");
const GeminiService = require("./gemini_service");
const SimpleZip = require("./zip_builder");

const app = express();
const PORT = process.env.PORT || 3000;
const gemini = new GeminiService(db);

app.use(cors());
app.use(express.json({ limit: "50mb" }));
app.use(express.static(path.join(__dirname, "public")));

app.get("/api/status", (req, res) => {
  const chats = db.getAllChats();
  res.json({
    ok: true,
    version: "8.0.0-Wispyte-Cloud",
    totalChats: chats.length,
    geminiChats: chats.filter(c => c.platform === "Gemini").length,
    gptChats: chats.filter(c => c.platform === "ChatGPT").length,
    configuredKeysCount: (db.settings.geminiKeys || []).length
  });
});

app.post("/api/settings", (req, res) => {
  const { geminiKeys, apiSecret } = req.body || {};
  const updated = db.saveSettings({ geminiKeys, apiSecret });
  res.json({
    ok: true,
    configuredKeysCount: updated.geminiKeys.length,
    message: `تم حفظ ${updated.geminiKeys.length} مفتاح Gemini API بنجاح!`
  });
});

app.post("/api/stream-chunk", (req, res) => {
  try {
    const result = db.appendStreamChunk(req.body || {});
    res.json({ ok: true, ...result });
  } catch (err) {
    res.status(500).json({ ok: false, error: err.message });
  }
});

app.post("/api/save-chat", async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { chatId, generateAiCapsule = true, ...payload } = req.body || {};
    const finalChat = db.finalizeStreamedChat(chatId, payload.messages ? { chatId, ...payload } : null);
    if (!finalChat) {
      return res.status(400).json({ ok: false, error: "لم يتم العثور على بيانات المحادثة." });
    }

    finalChat.extractedFiles = gemini.extractCodeBlocksFromChat(finalChat);

    if (generateAiCapsule && (db.settings.geminiKeys || []).length > 0) {
      try {
        finalChat.aiCapsule = await gemini.generateContextCapsule(finalChat);
      } catch (aiErr) {
        finalChat.aiCapsule = `تعذر توليد الكبسولة تلقائياً: ${aiErr.message}`;
      }
    }

    db.finalizeStreamedChat(finalChat.chatId, finalChat);
    res.json({
      ok: true,
      chatId: finalChat.chatId,
      messageCount: finalChat.messageCount,
      extractedCodeCount: finalChat.extractedFiles.length,
      aiCapsule: finalChat.aiCapsule
    });
  } catch (err) {
    res.status(500).json({ ok: false, error: err.message });
  }
});

app.post("/api/chats/:chatId/generate-capsule", async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const chat = db.getChat(req.params.chatId);
    if (!chat) return res.status(404).json({ ok: false, error: "المحادثة غير موجودة" });
    chat.aiCapsule = await gemini.generateContextCapsule(chat);
    db.finalizeStreamedChat(chat.chatId, chat);
    res.json({ ok: true, aiCapsule: chat.aiCapsule });
  } catch (err) {
    res.status(500).json({ ok: false, error: err.message });
  }
});

app.get("/api/chats", (req, res) => {
  const platform = req.query.platform || "";
  const q = (req.query.q || "").toLowerCase().trim();
  let chats = db.getAllChats(platform);

  if (q) {
    chats = chats.filter(c =>
      (c.title || "").toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      (c.aiCapsule || "").toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      (c.messages || []).some(m => (m.text || "").toLowerCase().includes(q))
    );
  }

  res.json({
    ok: true,
    chats: chats.map(c => ({
      chatId: c.chatId,
      platform: c.platform,
      title: c.title,
      url: c.url,
      date: c.date,
      timestamp: c.timestamp,
      messageCount: c.messageCount,
      attachmentCount: (c.attachments || []).length,
      extractedCodeCount: (c.extractedFiles || []).length,
      aiCapsule: c.aiCapsule || ""
    }))
  });
});

app.delete("/api/chats/:chatId", (req, res) => {
  db.deleteChat(req.params.chatId);
  res.json({ ok: true });
});

app.post("/api/ask-archive", async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const answer = await gemini.askAcrossArchive(req.body.question || "");
    res.json({ ok: true, answer });
  } catch (err) {
    res.status(500).json({ ok: false, error: err.message });
  }
});

function buildStandaloneTxt(chatsList, label = "ARCHIVE") {
  const dateStamp = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  const zipName = `AI_Chats_${label}_${dateStamp}_Attachments.zip`;
  const gemCount = chatsList.filter(c => c.platform === "Gemini").length;
  const gptCount = chatsList.filter(c => c.platform === "ChatGPT").length;
  const totalMsgs = chatsList.reduce((a, c) => a + (c.messageCount || 0), 0);
  const totalAtts = chatsList.reduce((a, c) => a + (c.attachments ? c.attachments.length : 0), 0);

  let out = "================================================================================\n";
  out += "         ☁️ أرشيف محادثات الذكاء الاصطناعي السحابي (WISPYTE AI ARCHIVE V8)\n";
  out += "================================================================================\n";
  out += `• تاريخ التصدير: ${new Date().toLocaleString("ar-EG")}\n`;
  out += `• إجمالي المحادثات: ${chatsList.length} (${totalMsgs} رسالة) | Gemini: ${gemCount} | ChatGPT: ${gptCount}\n`;
  out += `• ملف الـ ZIP المرفق للصور والأكواد المستخرجة: ${totalAtts > 0 ? zipName : "متاح عند الطلب"}\n`;
  out += "================================================================================\n\n";

  chatsList.forEach((chat, idx) => {
    out += `╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗\n`;
    out += `  محادثة (#${idx + 1}) | المنصة: [${chat.platform}] | المعرف: ${chat.chatId}\n`;
    out += `  العنوان: ${chat.title} | التاريخ: ${chat.date}\n`;
    out += `  الرابط: ${chat.url}\n`;
    out += `╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝\n\n`;

    if (chat.aiCapsule) {
      out += `┏━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🧠 [كبسولة استعادة السياق الذكية - Gemini AI] ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┓\n`;
      out += `${chat.aiCapsule}\n`;
      out += `┗━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┛\n\n`;
    }

    (chat.messages || []).forEach(m => {
      const speaker = m.role === "User"
        ? `👤 [المستخدم -> ${chat.platform}] (رسالة #${m.index})`
        : `🤖 [${m.role}] (رد #${m.index})`;
      out += `${speaker}:\n${m.text}\n\n--------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n`;
    });
  });

  return out;
}

app.get("/api/export/txt", (req, res) => {
  const { chatId, platform } = req.query;
  const list = chatId ? [db.getChat(chatId)].filter(Boolean) : db.getAllChats(platform || "");
  const label = chatId || (platform ? platform.toUpperCase() : "ALL");
  const txtContent = buildStandaloneTxt(list, label);
  res.setHeader("Content-Type", "text/plain; charset=utf-8");
  res.setHeader("Content-Disposition", `attachment; filename="AI_Chats_${label}.txt"`);
  res.send(txtContent);
});

app.get("/api/export/zip", (req, res) => {
  const { chatId, platform } = req.query;
  const list = chatId ? [db.getChat(chatId)].filter(Boolean) : db.getAllChats(platform || "");
  const label = chatId || (platform ? platform.toUpperCase() : "ALL");
  const zip = new SimpleZip();

  for (const chat of list) {
    const codes = (chat.extractedFiles && chat.extractedFiles.length)
      ? chat.extractedFiles
      : gemini.extractCodeBlocksFromChat(chat);

    codes.forEach(cf => {
      zip.addTextFile(`${chat.platform}_${chat.chatId}/${cf.zipPath}`, cf.content);
    });

    for (const att of (chat.attachments || [])) {
      if (att.dataUrl && att.dataUrl.includes(",")) {
        zip.addFile(att.zipPath, Buffer.from(att.dataUrl.split(",")[1], "base64"));
      } else {
        zip.addTextFile(att.zipPath + ".url.txt", `Original URL: ${att.originalUrl}\nAlt: ${att.alt}`);
      }
    }
  }

  res.setHeader("Content-Type", "application/zip");
  res.setHeader("Content-Disposition", `attachment; filename="AI_Chats_${label}_Attachments_Code.zip"`);
  res.send(zip.generateBuffer());
});

app.listen(PORT, "0.0.0.0", () => {
  console.log(`🚀 Wispyte AI Cloud Archiver V8 running on http://0.0.0.0:${PORT}`);
});
