  <script id="code-exporter" type="text/plain">
// Shared Dual Exporter (Generates Standalone AI-Ready TXT + Separate Attachments ZIP)
window.AIArchiverExporter = {
  dataUrlToUint8Array(dataUrl) {
    const parts = dataUrl.split(",");
    const byteString = atob(parts[1]);
    const arr = new Uint8Array(byteString.length);
    for (let i = 0; i < byteString.length; i++) {
      arr[i] = byteString.charCodeAt(i);
    }
    return arr;
  },

  exportChatsDual(chatsToExport, exportLabel = "ALL") {
    if (!chatsToExport || chatsToExport.length === 0) {
      return { ok: false, message: "⚠️ لا توجد محادثات محفوظة لتصديرها!" };
    }

    const dateStamp = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    const baseFilename = `AI_Chats_${exportLabel}_${dateStamp}`;
    const zipFilename = `${baseFilename}_Attachments.zip`;

    const geminiChats = chatsToExport.filter((c) => c.platform === "Gemini");
    const gptChats = chatsToExport.filter((c) => c.platform === "ChatGPT");
    const totalMessages = chatsToExport.reduce((acc, c) => acc + (c.messageCount || 0), 0);
    const totalAttachments = chatsToExport.reduce((acc, c) => acc + (c.attachments ? c.attachments.length : 0), 0);

    let txt = "";
    txt += "================================================================================\n";
    txt += "                 📚 أرشيف محادثات الذكاء الاصطناعي الموحّد (AI CONTEXT ARCHIVE)\n";
    txt += "================================================================================\n";
    txt += `• تاريخ التصدير: ${new Date().toLocaleString("ar-EG")}\n`;
    txt += `• إجمالي المحادثات: ${chatsToExport.length} محادثة (${totalMessages} رسالة إجمالية)\n`;
    txt += `  ├─ 🟦 محادثات Google Gemini : ${geminiChats.length} محادثة\n`;
    txt += `  └─ 🟩 محادثات OpenAI ChatGPT: ${gptChats.length} محادثة\n`;
    txt += `• إجمالي الصور والملفات المرفقة: ${totalAttachments} مرفق\n`;
    txt += `• ملف المرفقات المضغوط المرتبط بهذا النص: ${totalAttachments > 0 ? zipFilename : "لا توجد مرفقات"}\n`;
    txt += "--------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n";
    txt += "💡 [ملاحظة توجيهية للذكاء الاصطناعي عند قراءة هذا الملف]:\n";
    txt += "هذا الملف يحتوي على النص الكامل للمحادثات مقسماً بوضوح بين منصتي (Gemini) و (ChatGPT)،\n";
    txt += "بما في ذلك خطوات التفكير العميق (High Thinking / Reasoning) والأكواد والجداول.\n";
    txt += "تم فصل الصور والملفات في ملف ZIP مستقل لسرعة قراءتك للنص بدون الحاجة لفك الضغط.\n";
    txt += "ستجد مكان كل صورة أو ملف بطاقة تعريفية تحتوي على (معرّف المرفق ID + المسار داخل الـ ZIP + الوصف).\n";
    txt += "إذا احتجت لفحص أي صورة أو ملف برمجي أثناء النقاش، اطلب من المستخدم رفع الملف المذكور بالاسم.\n";
    txt += "================================================================================\n\n";

    txt += "📑 [فهرس المحادثات المضمنة في هذا الملف]:\n";
    chatsToExport.forEach((c, idx) => {
      const icon = c.platform === "Gemini" ? "🟦 [GEMINI]" : "🟩 [CHATGPT]";
      const attCount = c.attachments ? c.attachments.length : 0;
      txt += `  ${idx + 1}. ${icon} | المعرف: (${c.chatId}) | العنوان: ${c.title} | الرسائل: ${c.messageCount} | المرفقات: ${attCount}\n`;
    });
    txt += "\n================================================================================\n\n";

    chatsToExport.forEach((chat, idx) => {
      const banner = chat.platform === "Gemini"
        ? "🟦 🌐 [منصة المحادثة: GOOGLE GEMINI]"
        : "🟩 🤖 [منصة المحادثة: OPENAI CHATGPT]";

      txt += `╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗\n`;
      txt += `  محادثة رقم (#${idx + 1}) | ${banner}\n`;
      txt += `  • معرف المحادثة (Chat ID) : ${chat.chatId}\n`;
      txt += `  • عنوان المحادثة          : ${chat.title}\n`;
      txt += `  • تاريخ الحفظ             : ${chat.date}\n`;
      txt += `  • الرابط الأصلي           : ${chat.url}\n`;
      txt += `  • عدد الرسائل             : ${chat.messageCount} | عدد المرفقات: ${chat.attachments ? chat.attachments.length : 0}\n`;
      txt += `╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝\n\n`;

      (chat.messages || []).forEach((m) => {
        const speakerTag = m.role === "User"
          ? `👤 [المستخدم -> موجه إلى ${chat.platform}] (رسالة #${m.index})`
          : `🤖 [${m.role}] (رد #${m.index})`;

        txt += `${speakerTag}:\n${m.text}\n\n`;
        txt += `--------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n`;
      });

      txt += `\n════════════════════ [نهاية محادثة #${idx + 1} (${chat.platform} - ${chat.chatId})] ════════════════════\n\n\n`;
    });

    // 1. Download Standalone TXT
    const txtBlob = new Blob([txt], { type: "text/plain;charset=utf-8" });
    const txtUrl = URL.createObjectURL(txtBlob);
    const aTxt = document.createElement("a");
    aTxt.href = txtUrl;
    aTxt.download = `${baseFilename}.txt`;
    document.body.appendChild(aTxt);
    aTxt.click();
    aTxt.remove();
    setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(txtUrl), 6000);

    // 2. Download Separate Attachments ZIP (if any)
    if (totalAttachments > 0 && window.SimpleZip) {
      const zip = new window.SimpleZip();
      const manifestJson = {
        exportDate: new Date().toISOString(),
        linkedTextFile: `${baseFilename}.txt`,
        totalAttachments,
        files: []
      };

      chatsToExport.forEach((chat) => {
        (chat.attachments || []).forEach((att) => {
          manifestJson.files.push({
            id: att.id,
            chatId: chat.chatId,
            platform: chat.platform,
            chatTitle: chat.title,
            zipPath: att.zipPath,
            role: att.role,
            type: att.type,
            mimeType: att.mimeType,
            sizeBytes: att.sizeBytes,
            alt: att.alt,
            originalUrl: att.originalUrl
          });

          if (att.dataUrl) {
            try {
              zip.addFile(att.zipPath, this.dataUrlToUint8Array(att.dataUrl));
            } catch (e) {
              zip.addTextFile(att.zipPath + ".url.txt", `Original URL: ${att.originalUrl}\nDescription: ${att.alt}`);
            }
          } else {
            zip.addTextFile(att.zipPath + ".url.txt", `Original URL: ${att.originalUrl}\nDescription: ${att.alt}`);
          }
        });
      });

      zip.addTextFile("attachments_index.json", JSON.stringify(manifestJson, null, 2));
      const zipBlob = zip.generateBlob();
      const zipUrl = URL.createObjectURL(zipBlob);
      setTimeout(() => {
        const aZip = document.createElement("a");
        aZip.href = zipUrl;
        aZip.download = zipFilename;
        document.body.appendChild(aZip);
        aZip.click();
        aZip.remove();
        setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(zipUrl), 6000);
      }, 550);

      return { ok: true, message: `✅ تم تنزيل الـ TXT المستقل + ملف الـ ZIP (${totalAttachments} مرفق)!` };
    }

    return { ok: true, message: `✅ تم تنزيل ملف الـ TXT بنجاح (${totalMessages} رسالة)!` };
  }
};
  </script>

  <!-- ================= 3. FILE: content.js ================= -->
  <script id="code-content" type="text/plain">
// AI Chat Archiver Pro V5.0 - Refactored Unified Engine (Desktop & Mobile + High Thinking Support)
if (!window.__AI_ARCHIVER_V5__) {
  window.__AI_ARCHIVER_V5__ = true;

  const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));

  const SPEED_PROFILES = {
    slow:   { label: "🐢 بطيء (آمن للنت الضعيف)", upWait: 820, downWait: 620, stepRatio: 0.58 },
    medium: { label: "⚖️ متوسط (متوازن)",         upWait: 450, downWait: 300, stepRatio: 0.78 },
    fast:   { label: "🚀 سريع (تيربو)",           upWait: 210, downWait: 140, stepRatio: 0.95 }
  };

  const state = {
    url: "",
    platform: "",
    chatPrefix: "",
    isRunning: false,
    isPaused: false,
    forceFinish: false,
    speedMode: "medium",
    phase: "IDLE",
    statusText: "جاهز للعمل",
    progressPct: 0,
    lastScrollTop: 0,
    elapsedSeconds: 0,
    timerInterval: null,
    capturedMap: new Map(),
    mediaMap: new Map(),
    orderCounter: 0
  };

  function detectPlatform() {
    return window.location.hostname.includes("gemini.google.com") ? "Gemini" : "ChatGPT";
  }

  function getSpeedConfig() {
    return SPEED_PROFILES[state.speedMode] || SPEED_PROFILES.medium;
  }

  function formatTime(sec) {
    const m = String(Math.floor(sec / 60)).padStart(2, "0");
    const s = String(sec % 60).padStart(2, "0");
    return `${m}:${s}`;
  }

  function getPublicStatus() {
    return {
      isRunning: state.isRunning,
      isPaused: state.isPaused,
      speedMode: state.speedMode,
      phase: state.phase,
      statusText: state.statusText,
      progressPct: state.progressPct,
      elapsedSeconds: state.elapsedSeconds,
      formattedTime: formatTime(state.elapsedSeconds),
      messageCount: state.capturedMap.size,
      attachmentCount: state.mediaMap.size,
      canResume: state.capturedMap.size > 0 && state.url === window.location.href && !state.isRunning
    };
  }

  function resetSession() {
    clearInterval(state.timerInterval);
    state.url = window.location.href;
    state.platform = detectPlatform();
    state.chatPrefix = (state.platform === "Gemini" ? "GEM" : "GPT") + "_" + Date.now().toString().slice(-5);
    state.isRunning = false;
    state.isPaused = false;
    state.forceFinish = false;
    state.phase = "UP";
    state.statusText = "بدء الفحص...";
    state.progressPct = 5;
    state.lastScrollTop = 0;
    state.elapsedSeconds = 0;
    state.capturedMap.clear();
    state.mediaMap.clear();
    state.orderCounter = 0;
  }

  // Storage Helpers
  function getStoredChats() {
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      chrome.storage.local.get(["archivedChats"], (res) => resolve(res.archivedChats || []));
    });
  }

  async function saveStoredChat(chatObj) {
    const chats = await getStoredChats();
    const idx = chats.findIndex((c) => c.chatId === chatObj.chatId || c.url === chatObj.url);
    if (idx >= 0) chats[idx] = chatObj;
    else chats.push(chatObj);
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      chrome.storage.local.set({ archivedChats: chats }, () => resolve(chats));
    });
  }

  async function saveCheckpoint() {
    if (state.capturedMap.size === 0) return;
    const snapshot = buildChatObject();
    await saveStoredChat(snapshot);
  }

  // ---------------- DOM & High-Thinking Parser ----------------
  function expandHighThinkingBlocks() {
    try {
      // Open standard details tags
      document.querySelectorAll("details:not([open])").forEach((d) => d.setAttribute("open", "true"));

      // Expand Gemini & ChatGPT High Thinking / Reasoning toggles safely
      const toggleCandidates = document.querySelectorAll(
        'button[aria-expanded="false"], [role="button"][aria-expanded="false"], model-thoughts button'
      );
      toggleCandidates.forEach((btn) => {
        const label = ((btn.innerText || "") + " " + (btn.getAttribute("aria-label") || "")).toLowerCase();
        if (
          label.includes("thought") ||
          label.includes("thinking") ||
          label.includes("reason") ||
          label.includes("تفكير") ||
          label.includes("عرض التفكير") ||
          label.includes("خطوات التفكير")
        ) {
          try { btn.click(); } catch (e) {}
        }
      });
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  function parseTableToMarkdown(tableEl) {
    const rows = Array.from(tableEl.querySelectorAll("tr"));
    if (!rows.length) return "";
    const matrix = rows.map((row) =>
      Array.from(row.querySelectorAll("th, td")).map((cell) => cell.innerText.replace(/\n+/g, " ").trim())
    );
    let out = "\n[جدول بيانات]:\n";
    matrix.forEach((r, idx) => {
      out += "| " + r.join(" | ") + " |\n";
      if (idx === 0) out += "| " + r.map(() => "---").join(" | ") + " |\n";
    });
    return out + "\n";
  }

  function sanitizeAndExtractNode(rootEl, role) {
    const clone = rootEl.cloneNode(true);
    const msgMediaIds = [];

    // 1. Extract High Thinking / Reasoning blocks BEFORE stripping buttons
    clone.querySelectorAll('model-thoughts, details, [data-testid*="thought"], [class*="thought-"], [class*="reasoning"]').forEach((thinkEl) => {
      const rawThink = (thinkEl.innerText || "").trim();
      if (rawThink.length > 5) {
        const box = document.createElement("div");
        box.innerText = `\n--- 🧠 [بداية خطوات التفكير العميق / High Thinking] ---\n${rawThink}\n--- [نهاية خطوات التفكير العميق] ---\n`;
        thinkEl.replaceWith(box);
      }
    });

    // 2. Remove UI clutter buttons (while keeping attachment cards)
    clone.querySelectorAll("button, nav, .sr-only, svg, style, script").forEach((el) => {
      const txt = (el.innerText || "").trim();
      const isFileCard = /\.(pdf|zip|txt|py|js|ts|json|csv|docx|xlsx|png|jpg|webp|html|css)/i.test(txt);
      if (!isFileCard) el.remove();
    });

    // 3. Extract Images
    const liveImgs = Array.from(rootEl.querySelectorAll("img"));
    const cloneImgs = Array.from(clone.querySelectorAll("img"));

    liveImgs.forEach((img, idx) => {
      const src = img.currentSrc || img.src || "";
      const w = img.naturalWidth || img.width || 0;
      const h = img.naturalHeight || img.height || 0;
      const alt = (img.alt || "").trim();

      if (!src || (w > 0 && w < 42 && h > 0 && h < 42) || /avatar|profile|icon|emoji/i.test(src)) {
        if (cloneImgs[idx]) cloneImgs[idx].remove();
        return;
      }

      let mediaId = null;
      for (const [id, item] of state.mediaMap.entries()) {
        if (item.src === src) { mediaId = id; break; }
      }
      if (!mediaId) {
        const num = String(state.mediaMap.size + 1).padStart(3, "0");
        mediaId = `ATT_${state.chatPrefix}_IMG${num}`;
        state.mediaMap.set(mediaId, {
          id: mediaId,
          type: "image",
          role,
          src,
          alt: alt || "صورة مرفقة في المحادثة",
          fetched: false,
          dataUrl: null,
          mimeType: "image/png",
          sizeBytes: 0
        });
      }
      msgMediaIds.push(mediaId);

      if (cloneImgs[idx]) {
        const marker = document.createElement("div");
        marker.innerText = `\n[[__MEDIA_REF_${mediaId}__]]\n`;
        cloneImgs[idx].replaceWith(marker);
      }
    });

    // 4. Extract Downloadable Files & Attachments
    clone.querySelectorAll('a[href], [data-testid*="attachment"], [class*="attachment"], [class*="file"]').forEach((fl) => {
      const href = fl.getAttribute ? (fl.getAttribute("href") || "") : "";
      const text = (fl.innerText || "").trim();
      const isAttachment = fl.hasAttribute("download") || href.includes("blob:") || href.includes("oaiusercontent") || href.includes("googleusercontent");

      if (isAttachment && href && !href.startsWith("javascript:")) {
        let mediaId = null;
        for (const [id, item] of state.mediaMap.entries()) {
          if (item.src === href) { mediaId = id; break; }
        }
        if (!mediaId) {
          const num = String(state.mediaMap.size + 1).padStart(3, "0");
          mediaId = `ATT_${state.chatPrefix}_FILE${num}`;
          state.mediaMap.set(mediaId, {
            id: mediaId,
            type: "file",
            role,
            src: href,
            alt: text || "ملف مرفق",
            fetched: false,
            dataUrl: null,
            mimeType: "application/octet-stream",
            sizeBytes: 0
          });
        }
        msgMediaIds.push(mediaId);

        const marker = document.createElement("div");
        marker.innerText = `\n[[__MEDIA_REF_${mediaId}__]]\n`;
        fl.replaceWith(marker);
      } else if (href && href.startsWith("http") && text && !text.includes(href)) {
        fl.innerText = `${text} (${href})`;
      }
    });

    // 5. Format Code Blocks
    clone.querySelectorAll("pre").forEach((pre) => {
      const codeEl = pre.querySelector("code");
      let lang = "";
      if (codeEl && codeEl.className) {
        const m = codeEl.className.match(/language-([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)/);
        if (m) lang = m[1];
      }
      const codeContent = (codeEl ? codeEl.innerText : pre.innerText).trim();
      const box = document.createElement("div");
      box.innerText = `\n\`\`\`${lang}\n${codeContent}\n\`\`\`\n`;
      pre.replaceWith(box);
    });

    // 6. Format Tables
    clone.querySelectorAll("table").forEach((tbl) => {
      const box = document.createElement("div");
      box.innerText = parseTableToMarkdown(tbl);
      tbl.replaceWith(box);
    });

    const cleanText = (clone.innerText || "").replace(/\n{3,}/g, "\n\n").trim();
    return { cleanText, msgMediaIds };
  }

  function scanVisibleMessagesRealtime() {
    expandHighThinkingBlocks();
    const platform = state.platform;

    if (platform === "ChatGPT") {
      const turns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('article[data-testid^="conversation-turn-"], [data-message-author-role]'));
      turns.forEach((el, idx) => {
        if (el.tagName !== "ARTICLE" && el.closest('article[data-testid^="conversation-turn-"]')) return;
        const rawText = (el.innerText || "").trim();
        if (!rawText && !el.querySelector("img")) return;

        const attrId = el.getAttribute("data-testid") || el.getAttribute("data-message-id");
        const key = attrId || ("gpt_" + rawText.slice(0, 50).replace(/\s+/g, "_"));

        const roleNode = el.hasAttribute("data-message-author-role") ? el : el.querySelector("[data-message-author-role]");
        const rawRole = roleNode ? roleNode.getAttribute("data-message-author-role") : (idx % 2 === 0 ? "user" : "assistant");
        const role = rawRole === "user" ? "User" : "ChatGPT";

        const prev = state.capturedMap.get(key);
        if (!prev || rawText.length > prev.rawLength) {
          const { cleanText, msgMediaIds } = sanitizeAndExtractNode(el, role);
          if (cleanText) {
            state.capturedMap.set(key, {
              key,
              role,
              parsedText: cleanText,
              mediaIds: msgMediaIds,
              rawLength: rawText.length,
              order: prev ? prev.order : ++state.orderCounter
            });
          }
        }
      });
    } else {
      // Gemini Selectors
      let nodes = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll("user-query, model-response, .query-content, .response-content, message-content"));
      nodes = nodes.filter((el) => {
        const parentWrap = el.parentElement ? el.parentElement.closest("user-query, model-response") : null;
        return !parentWrap;
      });

      nodes.forEach((el) => {
        const tag = el.tagName.toLowerCase();
        const isUser = tag === "user-query" || el.classList.contains("query-content") || Boolean(el.closest("user-query"));
        const role = isUser ? "User" : "Gemini";
        const rawText = (el.innerText || "").trim();
        if (!rawText && !el.querySelector("img")) return;

        const attrId = el.id || el.getAttribute("data-message-id");
        const key = attrId || (role + "_" + rawText.slice(0, 55).replace(/\s+/g, "_"));

        const prev = state.capturedMap.get(key);
        if (!prev || rawText.length > prev.rawLength) {
          const { cleanText, msgMediaIds } = sanitizeAndExtractNode(el, role);
          if (cleanText) {
            state.capturedMap.set(key, {
              key,
              role,
              parsedText: cleanText,
              mediaIds: msgMediaIds,
              rawLength: rawText.length,
              order: prev ? prev.order : ++state.orderCounter
            });
          }
        }
      });
    }

    refreshHUD();
  }

  async function fetchBinaryAsDataUrl(url) {
    if (!url || url.startsWith("javascript:")) return null;
    if (url.startsWith("data:")) {
      return {
        dataUrl: url,
        mimeType: url.substring(5, url.indexOf(";")) || "image/png",
        size: Math.round(url.length * 0.75)
      };
    }
    const controller = new AbortController();
    const timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 4500);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(url, { credentials: "include", signal: controller.signal });
      clearTimeout(timer);
      if (!res.ok) return null;
      const blob = await res.blob();
      if (blob.size > 15 * 1024 * 1024) return null;
      return await new Promise((resolve) => {
        const reader = new FileReader();
        reader.onloadend = () => resolve({
          dataUrl: reader.result,
          mimeType: blob.type || "application/octet-stream",
          size: blob.size
        });
        reader.onerror = () => resolve(null);
        reader.readAsDataURL(blob);
      });
    } catch (e) {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      return null;
    }
  }

  function guessExt(mimeType, url) {
    if (mimeType) {
      if (mimeType.includes("png")) return "png";
      if (mimeType.includes("jpeg") || mimeType.includes("jpg")) return "jpg";
      if (mimeType.includes("webp")) return "webp";
      if (mimeType.includes("gif")) return "gif";
      if (mimeType.includes("svg")) return "svg";
      if (mimeType.includes("pdf")) return "pdf";
      if (mimeType.includes("json")) return "json";
      if (mimeType.includes("csv")) return "csv";
      if (mimeType.includes("plain")) return "txt";
    }
    const clean = (url || "").split("?")[0];
    const parts = clean.split(".");
    if (parts.length > 1) {
      const ext = parts.pop().toLowerCase();
      if (ext.length <= 5 && /^[a-z0-9]+$/.test(ext)) return ext;
    }
    return "bin";
  }

  function buildChatObject() {
    const platform = state.platform || detectPlatform();
    const folder = platform === "Gemini" ? "Gemini_Attachments" : "ChatGPT_Attachments";
    const sortedMsgs = Array.from(state.capturedMap.values()).sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order);
    const finalAttachments = [];

    for (const m of state.mediaMap.values()) {
      const ext = guessExt(m.mimeType, m.src);
      const fileName = `${m.id}.${ext}`;
      const zipPath = `${folder}/${fileName}`;
      finalAttachments.push({
        id: m.id,
        fileName,
        zipPath,
        platform,
        role: m.role,
        type: m.type,
        mimeType: m.mimeType,
        sizeBytes: m.sizeBytes,
        alt: m.alt,
        originalUrl: m.src,
        dataUrl: m.dataUrl
      });
    }

    const messages = sortedMsgs.map((item, idx) => {
      let textOut = item.parsedText;
      (item.mediaIds || []).forEach((mid) => {
        const att = finalAttachments.find((a) => a.id === mid);
        if (att) {
          const sizeKB = att.sizeBytes ? (att.sizeBytes / 1024).toFixed(1) + " KB" : "رابط مباشر";
          const card = [
            `--- 📎 [بطاقة مرفق | معرّف: ${att.id}] ---`,
            `• اسم الملف المرجعي: ${att.fileName}`,
            `• المسار داخل ملف الـ ZIP: ${att.zipPath}`,
            `• النوع: ${att.type === "image" ? "صورة" : "ملف"} (${att.mimeType}) | الحجم: ${sizeKB}`,
            `• المرسل: ${att.role === "User" ? "المستخدم" : platform}`,
            `• الوصف: ${att.alt}`,
            `• الرابط الأصلي: ${att.originalUrl.startsWith("data:") ? "[مدمج داخل الـ ZIP]" : att.originalUrl}`,
            `---------------------------------------------------`
          ].join("\n");
          textOut = textOut.replace(`[[__MEDIA_REF_${mid}__]]`, "\n" + card + "\n");
        }
      });
      return { index: idx + 1, role: item.role, text: textOut };
    });

    // Check for any open Canvas / Immersive Editor side-panel
    const canvasEl = document.querySelector('[class*="canvas"], [data-testid*="canvas"], immersive-editor, code-block-viewer');
    if (canvasEl && (canvasEl.innerText || "").trim().length > 25) {
      messages.push({
        index: messages.length + 1,
        role: `${platform} (Canvas / مساحة العمل)`,
        text: `[محتوى نافذة العمل الجانبية المفتوحة (Canvas)]:\n\`\`\`\n${canvasEl.innerText.trim()}\n\`\`\``
      });
    }

    const title = (document.title || `${platform} Chat`).replace(/[\\/:*?"<>|]/g, "_").trim();
    return {
      chatId: state.chatPrefix || ((platform === "Gemini" ? "GEM_" : "GPT_") + Date.now().toString().slice(-5)),
      platform,
      title,
      url: window.location.href,
      date: new Date().toLocaleString("ar-EG"),
      timestamp: Date.now(),
      messageCount: messages.length,
      messages,
      attachments: finalAttachments
    };
  }

  function findScrollableContainer() {
    const selectors = [
      "infinite-scroller",
      "main div.overflow-y-auto",
      '[class*="react-scroll-to-bottom"] > div',
      "main"
    ];
    for (const s of selectors) {
      const el = document.querySelector(s);
      if (el && el.scrollHeight > el.clientHeight + 40) return el;
    }
    let best = document.scrollingElement || document.documentElement;
    let maxH = best ? best.scrollHeight : 0;
    document.querySelectorAll("div, main, infinite-scroller").forEach((el) => {
      const st = window.getComputedStyle(el);
      if ((st.overflowY === "auto" || st.overflowY === "scroll") && el.scrollHeight > el.clientHeight + 40) {
        if (el.scrollHeight > maxH) { maxH = el.scrollHeight; best = el; }
      }
    });
    return best;
  }

  async function waitIfPaused() {
    while (state.isPaused && !state.forceFinish) {
      await sleep(250);
    }
  }

  // ---------------- Core Extraction Loop ----------------
  async function startOrResumeExtraction({ autoScroll = true, resume = false, downloadAfter = false }) {
    if (state.isRunning) return buildChatObject();

    if (!resume || state.url !== window.location.href || state.capturedMap.size === 0) {
      resetSession();
    }

    state.isRunning = true;
    state.isPaused = false;
    state.forceFinish = false;

    showHUD();

    clearInterval(state.timerInterval);
    state.timerInterval = setInterval(() => {
      if (!state.isPaused) {
        state.elapsedSeconds++;
        refreshHUD();
      }
    }, 1000);

    const container = findScrollableContainer();
    scanVisibleMessagesRealtime();

    try {
      if (autoScroll && container) {
        // Phase 1: Scroll UP to load history
        if (state.phase === "UP") {
          setHUDState("⬆️ جاري الصعود لأعلى المحادثة لتحميل الأرشيف...", 15);
          let stagnantTicks = 0;
          let prevCount = state.capturedMap.size;
          let prevHeight = container.scrollHeight;

          for (let step = 0; step < 100; step++) {
            await waitIfPaused();
            if (state.forceFinish) break;

            const spd = getSpeedConfig();
            container.scrollTop = 0;
            window.scrollTo(0, 0);
            await sleep(spd.upWait);
            scanVisibleMessagesRealtime();

            const curHeight = container.scrollHeight;
            const curCount = state.capturedMap.size;
            setHUDState(`⬆️ تحميل الرسائل القديمة... (تم جمع ${curCount} رسالة)`, Math.min(40, 15 + step));

            if (step % 10 === 0) await saveCheckpoint();

            if (curHeight === prevHeight && curCount === prevCount && container.scrollTop <= 10) {
              stagnantTicks++;
              if (stagnantTicks >= 4) break;
            } else {
              stagnantTicks = 0;
            }
            prevHeight = curHeight;
            prevCount = curCount;
          }
          state.phase = "DOWN";
          state.lastScrollTop = 0;
        }

        // Phase 2: Scroll DOWN step-by-step
        if (state.phase === "DOWN" && !state.forceFinish) {
          let pos = state.lastScrollTop || 0;
          let bottomTicks = 0;
          let lastTop = -1;

          for (let step = 0; step < 600; step++) {
            await waitIfPaused();
            if (state.forceFinish) break;

            const spd = getSpeedConfig();
            const delta = Math.max(window.innerHeight * spd.stepRatio, 420);

            container.scrollTop = pos;
            window.scrollTo(0, pos);
            state.lastScrollTop = pos;

            await sleep(spd.downWait);
            scanVisibleMessagesRealtime();

            const maxScroll = Math.max(container.scrollHeight - container.clientHeight, 1);
            const ratio = Math.min(1, pos / maxScroll);
            setHUDState(`⬇️ مسح المحادثة بالكامل... (${Math.round(ratio * 100)}%)`, 40 + Math.round(ratio * 42));

            if (step % 12 === 0) await saveCheckpoint();

            if (pos >= container.scrollHeight - container.clientHeight - 25) {
              bottomTicks++;
              if (bottomTicks >= 3) break;
            } else if (Math.abs(container.scrollTop - lastTop) < 4 && pos > container.scrollHeight) {
              break;
            } else {
              bottomTicks = 0;
            }

            lastTop = container.scrollTop;
            pos += delta;
          }

          container.scrollTop = container.scrollHeight;
          await sleep(300);
          scanVisibleMessagesRealtime();
        }
      }

      // Phase 3: Download Media Blobs
      state.phase = "MEDIA";
      const mediaArr = Array.from(state.mediaMap.values());
      for (let i = 0; i < mediaArr.length; i++) {
        await waitIfPaused();
        if (state.forceFinish) break;

        const m = mediaArr[i];
        if (!m.fetched) {
          setHUDState(`📎 سحب المرفقات (${i + 1} من ${mediaArr.length})...`, 84 + Math.round(((i + 1) / mediaArr.length) * 14));
          const res = await fetchBinaryAsDataUrl(m.src);
          if (res) {
            m.dataUrl = res.dataUrl;
            m.mimeType = res.mimeType;
            m.sizeBytes = res.size;
          }
          m.fetched = true;
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("AI Archiver V5 safe interruption:", e);
    }

    const finalChat = buildChatObject();
    if (finalChat.messageCount > 0) {
      await saveStoredChat(finalChat);
      setHUDState(`🎉 اكتمل الحفظ! (${finalChat.messageCount} رسالة، ${finalChat.attachments.length} مرفق)`, 100);
      if (downloadAfter && window.AIArchiverExporter) {
        window.AIArchiverExporter.exportChatsDual([finalChat], finalChat.platform.toUpperCase() + "_SINGLE");
      }
    } else {
      setHUDState("❌ لم يتم العثور على رسائل في هذه الصفحة.", 100);
    }

    state.isRunning = false;
    state.phase = "DONE";
    hideHUD(3000);
    updateMiniPanelResumeBtn();
    return finalChat;
  }

  // ---------------- In-Page HUD & Draggable Floating Widget ----------------
  function setHUDState(text, pct) {
    if (text) state.statusText = text;
    if (pct !== undefined) state.progressPct = Math.min(100, Math.max(5, pct));
    refreshHUD();
  }

  function refreshHUD() {
    const msgEl = document.getElementById("v5-hud-msgs");
    const attEl = document.getElementById("v5-hud-atts");
    const timeEl = document.getElementById("v5-hud-time");
    const statusEl = document.getElementById("v5-hud-status");
    const barEl = document.getElementById("v5-hud-bar");

    if (msgEl) msgEl.innerText = state.capturedMap.size;
    if (attEl) attEl.innerText = state.mediaMap.size;
    if (timeEl) timeEl.innerText = formatTime(state.elapsedSeconds);
    if (statusEl) statusEl.innerText = state.statusText;
    if (barEl) barEl.style.width = state.progressPct + "%";
  }

  function showHUD() {
    let hud = document.getElementById("ai-archiver-v5-hud");
    if (hud) hud.remove();

    hud = document.createElement("div");
    hud.id = "ai-archiver-v5-hud";
    hud.style.cssText = `
      position: fixed; top: 14px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
      z-index: 2147483647; background: #0f172a; color: #f8fafc;
      padding: 13px 15px; border-radius: 13px; width: 94%; max-width: 385px;
      box-shadow: 0 15px 35px rgba(0,0,0,0.8); border: 1.5px solid #38bdf8;
      font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; direction: rtl;
    `;

    hud.innerHTML = `
      <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; margin-bottom:8px;">
        <strong style="color:#38bdf8; font-size:13px;" id="v5-hud-title">⏳ جاري التجميع الذكي (V5)...</strong>
        <span style="background:#1e293b; color:#fbbf24; padding:2px 9px; border-radius:99px; font-weight:bold;">
          ⏱️ <span id="v5-hud-time">00:00</span>
        </span>
      </div>

      <div style="display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:6px; margin-bottom:8px; background:#1e293b; padding:7px; border-radius:8px; text-align:center;">
        <div style="border-left:1px solid #334155;">
          <div style="color:#94a3b8; font-size:10.5px;">💬 الرسائل المجمعة</div>
          <div style="color:#4ade80; font-weight:bold; font-size:14.5px;" id="v5-hud-msgs">0</div>
        </div>
        <div>
          <div style="color:#94a3b8; font-size:10.5px;">📎 الصور والملفات</div>
          <div style="color:#38bdf8; font-weight:bold; font-size:14.5px;" id="v5-hud-atts">0</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; margin-bottom:8px; background:#1e293b; padding:4px 8px; border-radius:6px;">
        <span style="font-size:11px; color:#94a3b8;">سرعة التمرير:</span>
        <div style="display:flex; gap:4px;">
          <button class="v5-spd" data-spd="slow" style="padding:3px 8px; border:none; border-radius:4px; font-size:10.5px; cursor:pointer; font-weight:bold;">🐢 بطيء</button>
          <button class="v5-spd" data-spd="medium" style="padding:3px 8px; border:none; border-radius:4px; font-size:10.5px; cursor:pointer; font-weight:bold;">⚖️ متوسط</button>
          <button class="v5-spd" data-spd="fast" style="padding:3px 8px; border:none; border-radius:4px; font-size:10.5px; cursor:pointer; font-weight:bold;">🚀 سريع</button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div id="v5-hud-status" style="margin-bottom:7px; color:#cbd5e1; font-size:11.5px; white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis;">جاري الفحص...</div>

      <div style="width:100%; background:#1e293b; height:7px; border-radius:4px; overflow:hidden; margin-bottom:10px;">
        <div id="v5-hud-bar" style="width:10%; background:linear-gradient(90deg,#2563eb,#38bdf8); height:100%; transition:width 0.25s;"></div>
      </div>

      <div style="display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:6px;">
        <button id="v5-hud-pause" style="padding:7px; border:none; border-radius:6px; background:#f59e0b; color:#0f172a; font-weight:bold; font-size:11.5px; cursor:pointer;">⏸️ إيقاف مؤقت / استكمال</button>
        <button id="v5-hud-finish" style="padding:7px; border:none; border-radius:6px; background:#10b981; color:#052e16; font-weight:bold; font-size:11.5px; cursor:pointer;">✅ اكتفاء وحفظ الآن</button>
      </div>
    `;

    document.body.appendChild(hud);

    const syncSpeedButtons = () => {
      hud.querySelectorAll(".v5-spd").forEach((b) => {
        const active = b.getAttribute("data-spd") === state.speedMode;
        b.style.background = active ? "#38bdf8" : "#334155";
        b.style.color = active ? "#0f172a" : "#cbd5e1";
      });
    };
    syncSpeedButtons();

    hud.querySelectorAll(".v5-spd").forEach((b) => {
      b.addEventListener("click", () => {
        state.speedMode = b.getAttribute("data-spd");
        chrome.storage.local.set({ preferredScrollSpeed: state.speedMode });
        const sel = document.getElementById("v5-mini-speed");
        if (sel) sel.value = state.speedMode;
        syncSpeedButtons();
      });
    });

    hud.querySelector("#v5-hud-pause").addEventListener("click", () => {
      togglePauseState();
    });

    hud.querySelector("#v5-hud-finish").addEventListener("click", () => {
      triggerForceFinish();
    });
  }

  function togglePauseState() {
    state.isPaused = !state.isPaused;
    const pauseBtn = document.getElementById("v5-hud-pause");
    const titleEl = document.getElementById("v5-hud-title");
    if (state.isPaused) {
      if (pauseBtn) { pauseBtn.style.background = "#38bdf8"; pauseBtn.innerText = "▶️ استكمال التجميع"; }
      if (titleEl) titleEl.innerText = "⏸️ متوقف مؤقتاً (تم حفظ النقطة)";
      setHUDState("تم حفظ نقطة التوقف! اضغط استكمال للمتابعة.");
      saveCheckpoint();
    } else {
      if (pauseBtn) { pauseBtn.style.background = "#f59e0b"; pauseBtn.innerText = "⏸️ إيقاف مؤقت / استكمال"; }
      if (titleEl) titleEl.innerText = "⏳ جاري استكمال التجميع...";
    }
  }

  function triggerForceFinish() {
    state.forceFinish = true;
    state.isPaused = false;
    setHUDState("⚡ جاري إنهاء التمرير وحفظ جميع الرسائل الملتقطة فوراً...", 95);
  }

  function hideHUD(delay = 2500) {
    clearInterval(state.timerInterval);
    setTimeout(() => {
      const hud = document.getElementById("ai-archiver-v5-hud");
      if (hud) hud.remove();
    }, delay);
  }

  function updateMiniPanelResumeBtn() {
    const btn = document.getElementById("v5-mini-resume");
    if (!btn) return;
    if (state.capturedMap.size > 0 && state.url === window.location.href) {
      btn.style.display = "block";
      btn.innerText = `▶️ استكمال من نقطة التوقف (${state.capturedMap.size} رسالة)`;
    } else {
      btn.style.display = "none";
    }
  }

  function injectFloatingWidget() {
    if (document.getElementById("ai-archiver-v5-fab")) return;

    const fab = document.createElement("div");
    fab.id = "ai-archiver-v5-fab";
    fab.style.cssText = `
      position: fixed; bottom: 85px; left: 16px; z-index: 2147483646;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2563eb, #0ea5e9); color: #fff;
      width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 50%; display: flex;
      align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 21px;
      box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,0.55); cursor: pointer;
      user-select: none; border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
    `;
    fab.title = "مُجمّع المحادثات V5 (اسحب لتغيير المكان)";
    fab.innerText = "🗂️";

    const panel = document.createElement("div");
    panel.id = "ai-archiver-v5-panel";
    panel.style.cssText = `
      position: fixed; bottom: 144px; left: 16px; z-index: 2147483646;
      background: #0f172a; color: #f8fafc; width: 295px; padding: 13px;
      border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.75);
      border: 1px solid #334155; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif;
      font-size: 12.5px; direction: rtl; display: none;
    `;

    panel.innerHTML = `
      <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; margin-bottom:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #334155; padding-bottom:6px;">
        <strong style="color:#38bdf8; font-size:13px;">🗂️ أرشيف المحادثات (V5 PC & Mobile)</strong>
        <span id="v5-mini-close" style="cursor:pointer; color:#94a3b8; font-size:15px; padding:0 4px;">✖</span>
      </div>
      <label style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; margin-bottom:8px; font-size:11.5px; color:#cbd5e1;">
        <input type="checkbox" id="v5-mini-scroll" checked>
        <span>تمرير تلقائي شامل (يدعم High Thinking)</span>
      </label>
      <div style="margin-bottom:10px; background:#1e293b; padding:7px 9px; border-radius:8px; border:1px solid #334155;">
        <div style="font-size:11px; color:#94a3b8; margin-bottom:4px;">⚡ سرعة التمرير التلقائي:</div>
        <select id="v5-mini-speed" style="width:100%; background:#0f172a; color:#f8fafc; border:1px solid #475569; border-radius:6px; padding:6px; font-size:12px;">
          <option value="slow">🐢 بطيء (للنت الضعيف والمحادثات الضخمة)</option>
          <option value="medium" selected>⚖️ متوسط (متوازن وموصى به)</option>
          <option value="fast">🚀 سريع (تيربو)</option>
        </select>
      </div>
      <button id="v5-mini-start" style="width:100%; padding:9px; margin-bottom:6px; border:none; border-radius:7px; background:#2563eb; color:#fff; font-weight:bold; cursor:pointer;">🚀 بدء سحب المحادثة للأرشيف</button>
      <button id="v5-mini-resume" style="width:100%; padding:9px; margin-bottom:6px; border:none; border-radius:7px; background:#f59e0b; color:#0f172a; font-weight:bold; cursor:pointer; display:none;">▶️ استكمال من نقطة التوقف</button>
      <button id="v5-mini-export" style="width:100%; padding:9px; border:none; border-radius:7px; background:#10b981; color:#052e16; font-weight:bold; cursor:pointer;">⚡ تحميل هذه المحادثة فوراً (TXT+ZIP)</button>
    `;

    document.body.appendChild(fab);
    document.body.appendChild(panel);

    const speedSel = panel.querySelector("#v5-mini-speed");
    chrome.storage.local.get(["preferredScrollSpeed"], (res) => {
      if (res.preferredScrollSpeed && SPEED_PROFILES[res.preferredScrollSpeed]) {
        state.speedMode = res.preferredScrollSpeed;
        speedSel.value = res.preferredScrollSpeed;
      }
    });

    speedSel.addEventListener("change", (e) => {
      state.speedMode = e.target.value;
      chrome.storage.local.set({ preferredScrollSpeed: state.speedMode });
    });

    fab.addEventListener("click", () => {
      panel.style.display = panel.style.display === "none" ? "block" : "none";
      updateMiniPanelResumeBtn();
    });

    panel.querySelector("#v5-mini-close").addEventListener("click", () => {
      panel.style.display = "none";
    });

    panel.querySelector("#v5-mini-start").addEventListener("click", () => {
      state.speedMode = speedSel.value;
      const autoScroll = panel.querySelector("#v5-mini-scroll").checked;
      panel.style.display = "none";
      startOrResumeExtraction({ autoScroll, resume: false, downloadAfter: false });
    });

    panel.querySelector("#v5-mini-resume").addEventListener("click", () => {
      state.speedMode = speedSel.value;
      panel.style.display = "none";
      if (state.isRunning) { state.isPaused = false; return; }
      startOrResumeExtraction({ autoScroll: true, resume: true, downloadAfter: false });
    });

    panel.querySelector("#v5-mini-export").addEventListener("click", async () => {
      state.speedMode = speedSel.value;
      panel.style.display = "none";
      if (state.capturedMap.size > 0 && !state.isRunning) {
        const chatObj = buildChatObject();
        await saveStoredChat(chatObj);
        window.AIArchiverExporter.exportChatsDual([chatObj], chatObj.platform.toUpperCase() + "_SINGLE");
        return;
      }
      const autoScroll = panel.querySelector("#v5-mini-scroll").checked;
      startOrResumeExtraction({ autoScroll, resume: false, downloadAfter: true });
    });
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", injectFloatingWidget);
  } else {
    injectFloatingWidget();
  }

  // ---------------- Desktop & Mobile Popup Message Bus ----------------
  chrome.runtime.onMessage.addListener((req, sender, sendResponse) => {
    if (req.action === "GET_LIVE_STATUS") {
      sendResponse({ ok: true, status: getPublicStatus() });
      return true;
    }

    if (req.action === "SET_SPEED") {
      if (req.speedMode && SPEED_PROFILES[req.speedMode]) {
        state.speedMode = req.speedMode;
        chrome.storage.local.set({ preferredScrollSpeed: state.speedMode });
      }
      sendResponse({ ok: true, status: getPublicStatus() });
      return true;
    }

    if (req.action === "TOGGLE_PAUSE") {
      if (state.isRunning) togglePauseState();
      sendResponse({ ok: true, status: getPublicStatus() });
      return true;
    }

    if (req.action === "FORCE_FINISH") {
      if (state.isRunning) triggerForceFinish();
      sendResponse({ ok: true, status: getPublicStatus() });
      return true;
    }

    if (req.action === "START_EXTRACTION") {
      if (req.speedMode) state.speedMode = req.speedMode;
      const isKiwiExtTab = req.fromPopup && document.visibilityState !== "visible";
      const shouldScroll = req.autoScroll !== false && !isKiwiExtTab;

      // Run asynchronously so Desktop Popup can poll live progress smoothly!
      startOrResumeExtraction({
        autoScroll: shouldScroll,
        resume: Boolean(req.resume),
        downloadAfter: Boolean(req.downloadAfter)
      });

      sendResponse({ ok: true, started: true, status: getPublicStatus() });
      return true;
    }
  });
}
  </script>

  <!-- ================= 4. FILE: popup.html ================= -->
  <script id="code-popup-html" type="text/plain">
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ar" dir="rtl">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>AI Chat Archiver Pro V5.0</title>
  <style>
    :root {
      --bg: #0f172a; --card: #1e293b; --border: #334155;
      --text: #f8fafc; --muted: #94a3b8; --accent: #38bdf8;
      --gemini: #2563eb; --gpt: #10b981;
    }
    * { box-sizing: border-box; }
    body {
      width: 390px; max-width: 100%; margin: 0 auto; padding: 14px;
      background: var(--bg); color: var(--text);

    }
    .header {
      display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
      margin-bottom: 10px; padding-bottom: 9px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    }
    .header h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 14.5px; }
    .badge { background: #0284c7; color: #fff; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 99px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: bold; }
    .control-card {
      background: var(--card); border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px; margin-bottom: 10px;
    }
    .row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 8px; }
    select {
      background: #0f172a; color: #fff; border: 1px solid #475569;
      border-radius: 6px; padding: 5px 8px; font-family: inherit; font-size: 11.5px;
    }
    button {
      border: none; border-radius: 7px; padding: 9px 10px;
      font-family: inherit; font-weight: 600; font-size: 12px;
      cursor: pointer; color: #fff; width: 100%; margin-bottom: 6px;
      transition: filter 0.15s;
    }
    button:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); }
    .btn-start { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2563eb, #1d4ed8); }
    .btn-resume { background: #f59e0b; color: #0f172a; display: none; }
    .btn-now { background: #334155; margin-bottom: 0; }
    .live-monitor {
      background: #090d16; border: 1px solid #38bdf8; border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 10px; margin-bottom: 10px; display: none;
    }
    .live-counters {
      display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr; gap: 6px;
      background: #1e293b; padding: 6px; border-radius: 7px; text-align: center; margin-bottom: 8px;
    }
    .progress-track { width: 100%; background: #1e293b; height: 6px; border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden; margin: 6px 0 8px 0; }
    .progress-fill { width: 10%; background: #38bdf8; height: 100%; transition: width 0.25s; }
    .stats-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 10px; }
    .stat-box { padding: 8px 10px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--card); }
    .chat-list {
      max-height: 145px; overflow-y: auto; background: var(--card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; padding: 6px; margin-bottom: 10px;
    }
    .chat-item {
      display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
      padding: 6px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); font-size: 11.5px;
    }
    .chat-item:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
    .tag { padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: bold; margin-left: 5px; }
    .tag-gem { background: var(--gemini); }
    .tag-gpt { background: var(--gpt); color: #052e16; }
    .del-btn { background: transparent; color: #f87171; width: auto; padding: 2px 6px; margin: 0; }
    .btn-exp-all { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0ea5e9, #0284c7); }
    .btn-exp-gem { background: var(--gemini); }
    .btn-exp-gpt { background: var(--gpt); color: #052e16; }
    .btn-clear { background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.15); color: #fca5a5; border: 1px solid rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.3); margin-bottom: 0; }
    #statusBox {
      margin-top: 8px; padding: 8px; border-radius: 6px;
      background: #020617; color: #38bdf8; font-size: 11.5px; text-align: center;
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="header">
    <h2>🗂️ مُجمّع محادثات Gemini & GPT</h2>

  </div>

  <!-- Desktop & Mobile Control Card -->
  <div class="control-card">

      <div><div style="color:#94a3b8; font-size:10px;">📎 المرفقات</div><b id="liveAtts" style="color:#38bdf8;">0</b></div>

    <div style="display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:6px;">
      <button id="livePauseBtn" style="background:#f59e0b; color:#0f172a; margin:0; padding:6px;">⏸️ إيقاف مؤقت / استكمال</button>
      <button id="liveFinishBtn" style="background:#10b981; color:#052e16; margin:0; padding:6px;">✅ اكتفاء وحفظ الآن</button>

  <div class="stats-grid">

  <div class="chat-list" id="chatList"></div>

  <button id="exportAllBtn" class="btn-exp-all">📦 تصدير الأرشيف المجمّع بالكامل (TXT + ZIP)</button>

    <button id="exportGemBtn" class="btn-exp-gem">🟦 تصدير Gemini فقط</button>
    <button id="exportGptBtn" class="btn-exp-gpt">🟩 تصدير ChatGPT فقط</button>
  </div>
  <button id="clearBtn" class="btn-clear">🗑️ مسح الأرشيف بالكامل</button>

  <div id="statusBox">جاهز للاستخراج والتصدير على الكمبيوتر والموبايل</div>

  <script src="zip_builder.js"></script>

  <script src="popup.js"></script>
</body>
</html>
  </script>

  <!-- ================= 5. FILE: popup.js ================= -->
  <script id="code-popup-js" type="text/plain">
let pollTimer = null;

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", async () => {
  await loadSpeedPreference();
  await refreshArchiveList();
  await syncWithActiveTab();
  pollTimer = setInterval(syncWithActiveTab, 800);
});

chrome.storage.onChanged.addListener((changes) => {
  if (changes.archivedChats) refreshArchiveList();
});

function setStatus(text, color = "#38bdf8") {
  const el = document.getElementById("statusBox");
  el.style.color = color;
  el.innerText = text;
}

function getStoredChats() {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    chrome.storage.local.get(["archivedChats"], (res) => resolve(res.archivedChats || []));
  });
}

function setStoredChats(chats) {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    chrome.storage.local.set({ archivedChats: chats }, () => resolve());
  });
}

async function loadSpeedPreference() {
  const sel = document.getElementById("speedSelect");
  chrome.storage.local.get(["preferredScrollSpeed"], (res) => {
    if (res.preferredScrollSpeed) sel.value = res.preferredScrollSpeed;
  });
  sel.addEventListener("change", async () => {
    const speedMode = sel.value;
    chrome.storage.local.set({ preferredScrollSpeed: speedMode });
    const tab = await findTargetAIChatTab();
    if (tab) chrome.tabs.sendMessage(tab.id, { action: "SET_SPEED", speedMode }, () => {});
  });
}

async function findTargetAIChatTab() {
  const allTabs = await chrome.tabs.query({});
  const aiTabs = allTabs.filter((t) =>
    t.url && (t.url.includes("gemini.google.com") || t.url.includes("chatgpt.com") || t.url.includes("chat.openai.com"))
  );
  if (!aiTabs.length) return null;
  const activeOne = aiTabs.find((t) => t.active);
  if (activeOne) return activeOne;
  aiTabs.sort((a, b) => (b.lastAccessed || b.index || 0) - (a.lastAccessed || a.index || 0));
  return aiTabs[0];
}

async function ensureContentScriptsInjected(tabId) {
  try {
    await chrome.scripting.executeScript({
      target: { tabId },
      files: ["zip_builder.js", "exporter.js", "content.js"]
    });
  } catch (e) {}
}

async function syncWithActiveTab() {
  const tab = await findTargetAIChatTab();
  if (!tab) return;

  chrome.tabs.sendMessage(tab.id, { action: "GET_LIVE_STATUS" }, (res) => {
    if (chrome.runtime.lastError || !res || !res.ok) return;
    const st = res.status;
    const monitor = document.getElementById("liveMonitor");
    const resumeBtn = document.getElementById("resumeExtractBtn");

    if (st.isRunning) {
      monitor.style.display = "block";
      document.getElementById("liveTime").innerText = st.formattedTime;
      document.getElementById("liveMsgs").innerText = st.messageCount;
      document.getElementById("liveAtts").innerText = st.attachmentCount;
      document.getElementById("liveStatusText").innerText = st.statusText;
      document.getElementById("liveBar").style.width = st.progressPct + "%";
      document.getElementById("livePauseBtn").innerText = st.isPaused ? "▶️ استكمال التجميع" : "⏸️ إيقاف مؤقت";
    } else {
      monitor.style.display = "none";
    }

    if (st.canResume) {
      resumeBtn.style.display = "block";
      resumeBtn.innerText = `▶️ استكمال من نقطة التوقف (${st.messageCount} رسالة محفوظة)`;
    } else {
      resumeBtn.style.display = "none";
    }
  });
}

async function refreshArchiveList() {
  const chats = await getStoredChats();
  chats.sort((a, b) => a.timestamp - b.timestamp);

  const gem = chats.filter((c) => c.platform === "Gemini");
  const gpt = chats.filter((c) => c.platform === "ChatGPT");

  const gemAtt = gem.reduce((a, c) => a + (c.attachments ? c.attachments.length : 0), 0);
  const gptAtt = gpt.reduce((a, c) => a + (c.attachments ? c.attachments.length : 0), 0);

  document.getElementById("geminiCount").innerText = `${gem.length} محادثة (${gemAtt} مرفق)`;
  document.getElementById("gptCount").innerText = `${gpt.length} محادثة (${gptAtt} مرفق)`;

  const listEl = document.getElementById("chatList");
  if (!chats.length) {
    listEl.innerHTML = `<div style="text-align:center; color:#64748b; padding:12px;">لا توجد محادثات محفوظة في الأرشيف بعد</div>`;
    return;
  }

  listEl.innerHTML = "";
  chats.forEach((c) => {
    const row = document.createElement("div");
    row.className = "chat-item";
    const isGem = c.platform === "Gemini";
    const attCount = c.attachments ? c.attachments.length : 0;

    row.innerHTML = `
      <div style="overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; max-width:280px;">
        <span class="tag ${isGem ? 'tag-gem' : 'tag-gpt'}">${c.platform}</span>
        <strong title="${c.title}">${c.title}</strong>
        <div style="color:#94a3b8; font-size:10.5px; margin-top:2px;">الرسائل: ${c.messageCount} | المرفقات: ${attCount} | المعرف: ${c.chatId}</div>
      </div>
      <button class="del-btn" data-id="${c.chatId}" title="حذف">✖</button>
    `;
    listEl.appendChild(row);
  });

  listEl.querySelectorAll(".del-btn").forEach((btn) => {
    btn.addEventListener("click", async (e) => {
      const id = e.currentTarget.getAttribute("data-id");
      const all = await getStoredChats();
      await setStoredChats(all.filter((x) => x.chatId !== id));
      refreshArchiveList();
      setStatus("🗑️ تم حذف المحادثة من الأرشيف.", "#f87171");
    });
  });
}

async function triggerExtraction({ resume = false, downloadAfter = false }) {
  const tab = await findTargetAIChatTab();
  if (!tab) {
    setStatus("⚠️ افتح صفحة محادثة على Gemini أو ChatGPT أولاً!", "#fbbf24");
    return;
  }

  await ensureContentScriptsInjected(tab.id);
  const autoScroll = document.getElementById("autoScrollChk").checked;
  const speedMode = document.getElementById("speedSelect").value;

  chrome.tabs.sendMessage(
    tab.id,
    { action: "START_EXTRACTION", autoScroll, speedMode, resume, downloadAfter, fromPopup: true },
    (res) => {
      if (chrome.runtime.lastError || !res) {
        setStatus("⚠️ يرجى تحديث صفحة الدردشة (Refresh) مرة واحدة لتفعيل المحرك.", "#fbbf24");
      } else {
        setStatus("⏳ بدأ التجميع الذكي... تابع العداد الحي بالأعلى!", "#38bdf8");
        syncWithActiveTab();
      }
    }
  );
}

document.getElementById("startExtractBtn").addEventListener("click", () => triggerExtraction({ resume: false, downloadAfter: false }));
document.getElementById("resumeExtractBtn").addEventListener("click", () => triggerExtraction({ resume: true, downloadAfter: false }));
document.getElementById("exportCurrentBtn").addEventListener("click", () => triggerExtraction({ resume: false, downloadAfter: true }));

document.getElementById("livePauseBtn").addEventListener("click", async () => {
  const tab = await findTargetAIChatTab();
  if (tab) chrome.tabs.sendMessage(tab.id, { action: "TOGGLE_PAUSE" }, () => syncWithActiveTab());
});

document.getElementById("liveFinishBtn").addEventListener("click", async () => {
  const tab = await findTargetAIChatTab();
  if (tab) chrome.tabs.sendMessage(tab.id, { action: "FORCE_FINISH" }, () => syncWithActiveTab());
});

document.getElementById("exportAllBtn").addEventListener("click", async () => {
  const chats = await getStoredChats();
  const res = window.AIArchiverExporter.exportChatsDual(chats, "GEMINI_AND_CHATGPT");
  setStatus(res.message, res.ok ? "#4ade80" : "#fbbf24");
});

document.getElementById("exportGemBtn").addEventListener("click", async () => {
  const chats = (await getStoredChats()).filter((c) => c.platform === "Gemini");
  const res = window.AIArchiverExporter.exportChatsDual(chats, "GEMINI_ONLY");
  setStatus(res.message, res.ok ? "#4ade80" : "#fbbf24");
});

document.getElementById("exportGptBtn").addEventListener("click", async () => {
  const chats = (await getStoredChats()).filter((c) => c.platform === "ChatGPT");
  const res = window.AIArchiverExporter.exportChatsDual(chats, "CHATGPT_ONLY");
  setStatus(res.message, res.ok ? "#4ade80" : "#fbbf24");
});

document.getElementById("clearBtn").addEventListener("click", async () => {
  await setStoredChats([]);
  refreshArchiveList();
  setStatus("🗑️ تم مسح الأرشيف بالكامل.", "#f87171");
});

      "manifest_version": 3,
      "name": "AI Chat Archiver Pro (V5.0 - PC & Mobile)",
      "version": "5.0.0",
      "description": "أداة موحدة للكمبيوتر والموبايل لاستخراج وأرشفة محادثات Gemini و ChatGPT الضخمة (مع دعم High Thinking، التحكم بالسرعة، والعداد الحي).",
      "permissions": [
        "activeTab",
        "tabs",
        "scripting",
        "storage",
        "unlimitedStorage",
        "downloads"
      ],
      "host_permissions": [
        "https://gemini.google.com/*",
        "https://chatgpt.com/*",
        "https://chat.openai.com/*",
        "https://*.googleusercontent.com/*",
        "https://*.oaiusercontent.com/*",
        "https://*.openai.com/*"
      ],
      "content_scripts": [
        {
          "matches": [
            "https://gemini.google.com/*",
            "https://chatgpt.com/*",
            "https://chat.openai.com/*"
          ],
          "js": ["zip_builder.js", "exporter.js", "content.js"],
          "run_at": "document_idle"
        }
      ],
      "action": {
        "default_popup": "popup.html",
        "default_title": "AI Chat Archiver Pro V5.0"
      }
    };

    document.getElementById("generateZipBtn").addEventListener("click", () => {
      const zip = new window.SimpleZip();
      zip.addTextFile("manifest.json", JSON.stringify(manifestObj, null, 2));
      zip.addTextFile("zip_builder.js", document.getElementById("code-zip-builder").textContent.trim());
      zip.addTextFile("exporter.js", document.getElementById("code-exporter").textContent.trim());
      zip.addTextFile("content.js", document.getElementById("code-content").textContent.trim());
      zip.addTextFile("popup.html", document.getElementById("code-popup-html").textContent.trim());
      zip.addTextFile("popup.js", document.getElementById("code-popup-js").textContent.trim());

      const blob = zip.generateBlob();
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = url;
      a.download = "AI-Chat-Archiver-Pro-V5.zip";
      document.body.appendChild(a);
      a.click();
      a.remove();
    });
  </script>

    medium: { label: "⚖️ متوسط (متوازن)",     upWait: 450, downWait: 300, stepRatio: 0.80 },
    fast:   { label: "🚀 سريع (تيربو)",       upWait: 220, downWait: 140, stepRatio: 0.95 }

    orderCounter: 0
  };

  function getSpeedConfig() {
    return SPEED_PROFILES[sessionState.speedMode] || SPEED_PROFILES.medium;
  }

  function resetSession(platform) {
    clearInterval(sessionState.timerInterval);
    sessionState.url = window.location.href;
    sessionState.isRunning = false;
    sessionState.isPaused = false;
    sessionState.forceFinish = false;
    sessionState.phase = "UP";
    sessionState.lastScrollTop = 0;
    sessionState.elapsedSeconds = 0;
    sessionState.platform = platform;
    sessionState.chatPrefix = (platform === "Gemini" ? "GEM" : "GPT") + "_" + Date.now().toString().slice(-5);
    sessionState.capturedMap.clear();
    sessionState.mediaMap.clear();
    sessionState.orderCounter = 0;
  }

  function formatTime(sec) {
    const m = String(Math.floor(sec / 60)).padStart(2, "0");
    const s = String(sec % 60).padStart(2, "0");
    return `${m}:${s}`;
  }

  function getStoredChats() {
    return new Promise((resolve) => {

  }

  function saveStoredChat(chatObj) {
    return new Promise(async (resolve) => {
      const chats = await getStoredChats();
      const idx = chats.findIndex((c) => c.chatId === chatObj.chatId || c.url === chatObj.url);
      if (idx >= 0) {
        chats[idx] = chatObj;
      } else {
        chats.push(chatObj);
      }
      chrome.storage.local.set({ archivedChats: chats }, () => resolve(chats));
    });
  }
