1. ملف content.js (محرك التجميع اللحظي + الاستكمال + العداد الحي)

استبدل محتوى ملف content.js بالكامل بهذا الكود:

// AI Chat Archiver Pro V4 - Checkpoint/Resume Engine & Live HUD Counters for Huge Chats
if (!window.__AI_ARCHIVER_V4__) {
  window.__AI_ARCHIVER_V4__ = true;

  const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));

  // Global Extraction Session State (Allows Pause / Resume / Force Save at any point!)
  const sessionState = {
    url: "",
    isRunning: false,
    isPaused: false,
    forceFinish: false,
    phase: "INIT", // "UP", "DOWN", "MEDIA"
    lastScrollTop: 0,
    elapsedSeconds: 0,
    timerInterval: null,
    chatPrefix: "",
    platform: "",
    capturedMap: new Map(), // key -> { role, parsedText, mediaItems, rawLength, order }
    mediaMap: new Map(),    // mediaId -> mediaMetadata & base64
    orderCounter: 0
  };

  function resetSession(platform) {
    clearInterval(sessionState.timerInterval);
    sessionState.url = window.location.href;
    sessionState.isRunning = false;
    sessionState.isPaused = false;
    sessionState.forceFinish = false;
    sessionState.phase = "UP";
    sessionState.lastScrollTop = 0;
    sessionState.elapsedSeconds = 0;
    sessionState.platform = platform;
    sessionState.chatPrefix = (platform === "Gemini" ? "GEM" : "GPT") + "_" + Date.now().toString().slice(-5);
    sessionState.capturedMap.clear();
    sessionState.mediaMap.clear();
    sessionState.orderCounter = 0;
  }

  function formatTime(sec) {
    const m = String(Math.floor(sec / 60)).padStart(2, "0");
    const s = String(sec % 60).padStart(2, "0");
    return `${m}:${s}`;
  }

  function getStoredChats() {
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      chrome.storage.local.get(["archivedChats"], (res) => {
        resolve(res.archivedChats || []);
      });
    });
  }

  function saveStoredChat(chatObj) {
    return new Promise(async (resolve) => {
      const chats = await getStoredChats();
      const idx = chats.findIndex((c) => c.chatId === chatObj.chatId || c.url === chatObj.url);
      if (idx >= 0) {
        chats[idx] = chatObj;
      } else {
        chats.push(chatObj);
      }
      chrome.storage.local.set({ archivedChats: chats }, () => resolve(chats));
    });
  }

  // Save checkpoint in storage so even if page reloads, progress is safe
  async function saveCheckpointSnapshot() {
    if (sessionState.capturedMap.size === 0) return;
    const partialChat = buildChatObjectFromSession();
    await saveStoredChat(partialChat);
  }

  // Floating Action Button & Mini Control Panel
  function injectFloatingWidget() {
    if (document.getElementById("ai-archiver-fab")) return;

    const fab = document.createElement("div");
    fab.id = "ai-archiver-fab";
    fab.style.cssText = `
      position: fixed;
      bottom: 85px;
      left: 14px;
      z-index: 2147483646;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2563eb, #0ea5e9);
      color: #fff;
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 21px;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
      cursor: pointer;
      user-select: none;
      border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
    `;
    fab.title = "مُجمّع المحادثات الاحترافي V4";
    fab.innerText = "🗂️";

    const panel = document.createElement("div");
    panel.id = "ai-archiver-mini-panel";
    panel.style.cssText = `
      position: fixed;
      bottom: 142px;
      left: 14px;
      z-index: 2147483646;
      background: #0f172a;
      color: #f8fafc;
      width: 285px;
      padding: 13px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.7);
      border: 1px solid #334155;
      font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
      font-size: 12.5px;
      direction: rtl;
      display: none;
    `;

    panel.innerHTML = `
      <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; margin-bottom:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #334155; padding-bottom:6px;">
        <strong style="color:#38bdf8; font-size:13px;">🗂️ أرشيف المحادثات الضخمة (V4)</strong>
        <span id="ai-arch-close" style="cursor:pointer; color:#94a3b8; font-size:15px; padding:0 4px;">✖</span>
      </div>
      <label style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; margin-bottom:9px; font-size:11.5px; color:#cbd5e1;">
        <input type="checkbox" id="ai-arch-scroll-chk" checked>
        <span>تمرير تلقائي شامل (مع حفظ لحظي)</span>
      </label>
      <button id="ai-arch-btn-save" style="width:100%; padding:9px; margin-bottom:6px; border:none; border-radius:7px; background:#2563eb; color:#fff; font-weight:bold; cursor:pointer;">🚀 بدء سحب المحادثة من البداية</button>
      <button id="ai-arch-btn-resume" style="width:100%; padding:9px; margin-bottom:6px; border:none; border-radius:7px; background:#f59e0b; color:#0f172a; font-weight:bold; cursor:pointer; display:none;">▶️ استكمال التجميع من نقطة التوقف</button>
      <button id="ai-arch-btn-now" style="width:100%; padding:9px; margin-bottom:6px; border:none; border-radius:7px; background:#10b981; color:#052e16; font-weight:bold; cursor:pointer;">⚡ تحميل المجمّع فوراً (TXT + ZIP)</button>
      <div id="ai-arch-mini-status" style="font-size:11px; color:#94a3b8; text-align:center; margin-top:4px;">يدعم التوقف والاستكمال في المحادثات الطويلة</div>
    `;

    document.body.appendChild(fab);
    document.body.appendChild(panel);

    fab.addEventListener("click", () => {
      panel.style.display = panel.style.display === "none" ? "block" : "none";
      updateResumeButtonVisibility();
    });

    panel.querySelector("#ai-arch-close").addEventListener("click", () => {
      panel.style.display = "none";
    });

    // Start fresh extraction
    panel.querySelector("#ai-arch-btn-save").addEventListener("click", async () => {
      if (sessionState.isRunning) return;
      const autoScroll = panel.querySelector("#ai-arch-scroll-chk").checked;
      panel.style.display = "none";
      await runExtractionEngine({ autoScroll, resume: false, downloadAfter: false });
      updateResumeButtonVisibility();
    });

    // Resume from last point
    panel.querySelector("#ai-arch-btn-resume").addEventListener("click", async () => {
      if (sessionState.isRunning) {
        sessionState.isPaused = false;
        return;
      }
      panel.style.display = "none";
      await runExtractionEngine({ autoScroll: true, resume: true, downloadAfter: false });
      updateResumeButtonVisibility();
    });

    // Export immediately (either what was already collected or start & download)
    panel.querySelector("#ai-arch-btn-now").addEventListener("click", async () => {
      if (sessionState.capturedMap.size > 0 && !sessionState.isRunning) {
        const chatObj = buildChatObjectFromSession();
        await saveStoredChat(chatObj);
        exportDualInPage([chatObj], chatObj.platform.toUpperCase() + "_SINGLE");
        const st = panel.querySelector("#ai-arch-mini-status");
        st.style.color = "#4ade80";
        st.innerText = `✅ تم تصدير ${chatObj.messageCount} رسالة و ${chatObj.attachments.length} مرفق!`;
        return;
      }
      const autoScroll = panel.querySelector("#ai-arch-scroll-chk").checked;
      panel.style.display = "none";
      await runExtractionEngine({ autoScroll, resume: false, downloadAfter: true });
      updateResumeButtonVisibility();
    });
  }

  function updateResumeButtonVisibility() {
    const resumeBtn = document.getElementById("ai-arch-btn-resume");
    if (!resumeBtn) return;
    if (sessionState.capturedMap.size > 0 && sessionState.url === window.location.href) {
      resumeBtn.style.display = "block";
      resumeBtn.innerText = `▶️ استكمال من النقطة السابقة (${sessionState.capturedMap.size} رسالة محفوظة)`;
    } else {
      resumeBtn.style.display = "none";
    }
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", injectFloatingWidget);
  } else {
    injectFloatingWidget();
  }

  // Live HUD Overlay with Counters (Messages, Files, Elapsed Time) + Pause/Resume/Save Controls
  function createLiveHUD() {
    let hud = document.getElementById("ai-archiver-hud");
    if (hud) hud.remove();

    hud = document.createElement("div");
    hud.id = "ai-archiver-hud";
    hud.style.cssText = `
      position: fixed;
      top: 12px;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      z-index: 2147483647;
      background: #0f172a;
      color: #f8fafc;
      padding: 12px 14px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.75);
      font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
      font-size: 12px;
      direction: rtl;
      width: 94%;
      max-width: 375px;
      border: 1.5px solid #38bdf8;
    `;

    hud.innerHTML = `
      <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; margin-bottom:8px;">
        <span style="font-weight:bold; color:#38bdf8; font-size:13px;" id="hud-title">⏳ جاري التجميع الذكي...</span>
        <span style="background:#1e293b; color:#fbbf24; padding:2px 8px; border-radius:99px; font-weight:bold; font-size:11.5px;">
          ⏱️ <span id="hud-timer">00:00</span>
        </span>
      </div>

      <!-- Live Counters Bar -->
      <div style="display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:6px; margin-bottom:8px; background:#1e293b; padding:7px; border-radius:8px; text-align:center;">
        <div style="border-left:1px solid #334155;">
          <div style="color:#94a3b8; font-size:10.5px;">💬 الرسائل المجمعة</div>
          <div style="color:#4ade80; font-weight:bold; font-size:14px;" id="hud-msg-count">0</div>
        </div>
        <div>
          <div style="color:#94a3b8; font-size:10.5px;">📎 الصور والملفات</div>
          <div style="color:#38bdf8; font-weight:bold; font-size:14px;" id="hud-att-count">0</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div id="hud-status" style="margin-bottom:7px; color:#cbd5e1; font-size:11.5px; white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis;">
        جاري الفحص...
      </div>

      <div style="width:100%; background:#1e293b; height:7px; border-radius:4px; overflow:hidden; margin-bottom:10px;">
        <div id="hud-bar" style="width:10%; background:linear-gradient(90deg, #2563eb, #38bdf8); height:100%; transition:width 0.25s;"></div>
      </div>

      <!-- Control Buttons Inside HUD -->
      <div style="display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:6px;">
        <button id="hud-btn-pause" style="padding:7px; border:none; border-radius:6px; background:#f59e0b; color:#0f172a; font-weight:bold; font-size:11.5px; cursor:pointer;">
          ⏸️ إيقاف مؤقت / استكمال
        </button>
        <button id="hud-btn-finish" style="padding:7px; border:none; border-radius:6px; background:#10b981; color:#052e16; font-weight:bold; font-size:11.5px; cursor:pointer;">
          ✅ اكتفاء وحفظ المجمّع الآن
        </button>
      </div>
    `;

    document.body.appendChild(hud);

    hud.querySelector("#hud-btn-pause").addEventListener("click", () => {
      sessionState.isPaused = !sessionState.isPaused;
      const pauseBtn = hud.querySelector("#hud-btn-pause");
      const titleEl = hud.querySelector("#hud-title");
      if (sessionState.isPaused) {
        pauseBtn.style.background = "#38bdf8";
        pauseBtn.innerText = "▶️ استكمال التجميع من هنا";
        titleEl.innerText = "⏸️ متوقف مؤقتاً (محفوظ)";
        updateHUDStatus("تم حفظ نقطة التوقف! اضغط استكمال للمتابعة.");
        saveCheckpointSnapshot();
      } else {
        pauseBtn.style.background = "#f59e0b";
        pauseBtn.innerText = "⏸️ إيقاف مؤقت / استكمال";
        titleEl.innerText = "⏳ جاري استكمال التجميع...";
      }
    });

    hud.querySelector("#hud-btn-finish").addEventListener("click", () => {
      sessionState.forceFinish = true;
      sessionState.isPaused = false;
      updateHUDStatus("⚡ جاري إنهاء السكرول وحفظ كل ما تم جمعه فوراً...", 95);
    });
  }

  function updateHUDCounters() {
    const msgEl = document.getElementById("hud-msg-count");
    const attEl = document.getElementById("hud-att-count");
    const timerEl = document.getElementById("hud-timer");
    if (msgEl) msgEl.innerText = sessionState.capturedMap.size;
    if (attEl) attEl.innerText = sessionState.mediaMap.size;
    if (timerEl) timerEl.innerText = formatTime(sessionState.elapsedSeconds);
  }

  function updateHUDStatus(text, percent) {
    const statusEl = document.getElementById("hud-status");
    const barEl = document.getElementById("hud-bar");
    if (statusEl && text) statusEl.innerText = text;
    if (barEl && percent !== undefined) barEl.style.width = Math.min(100, Math.max(5, percent)) + "%";
    updateHUDCounters();
  }

  function closeHUD(delay = 2500) {
    clearInterval(sessionState.timerInterval);
    setTimeout(() => {
      const hud = document.getElementById("ai-archiver-hud");
      if (hud) hud.remove();
    }, delay);
  }

  async function waitWhilePaused() {
    while (sessionState.isPaused && !sessionState.forceFinish) {
      await sleep(300);
    }
  }

  function getScrollContainer() {
    const candidates = [
      document.querySelector("infinite-scroller"),
      document.querySelector("main div.overflow-y-auto"),
      document.querySelector('[class*="react-scroll-to-bottom"] > div'),
      document.querySelector("main")
    ];
    for (const c of candidates) {
      if (c && c.scrollHeight > c.clientHeight + 40) return c;
    }
    let best = document.scrollingElement || document.documentElement;
    let maxScroll = best ? best.scrollHeight : 0;
    document.querySelectorAll("div, main, infinite-scroller").forEach((el) => {
      const style = window.getComputedStyle(el);
      if ((style.overflowY === "auto" || style.overflowY === "scroll") && el.scrollHeight > el.clientHeight + 40) {
        if (el.scrollHeight > maxScroll) {
          maxScroll = el.scrollHeight;
          best = el;
        }
      }
    });
    return best;
  }

  function parseTableToText(tableEl) {
    const rows = Array.from(tableEl.querySelectorAll("tr"));
    if (rows.length === 0) return "";
    const matrix = rows.map((row) =>
      Array.from(row.querySelectorAll("th, td")).map((cell) => cell.innerText.replace(/\n+/g, " ").trim())
    );
    let out = "\n[جدول بيانات]:\n";
    matrix.forEach((r, idx) => {
      out += "| " + r.join(" | ") + " |\n";
      if (idx === 0) {
        out += "| " + r.map(() => "---").join(" | ") + " |\n";
      }
    });
    return out + "\n";
  }

  function expandThinkingBlocksSync() {
    try {
      document.querySelectorAll("details:not([open])").forEach((d) => d.setAttribute("open", "true"));
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  // Parse a message node immediately into lightweight text + media descriptors (Saves RAM in huge chats!)
  function extractNodeLightweight(rootEl, platform, role, msgKey) {
    const clone = rootEl.cloneNode(true);
    const msgMediaIds = [];

    clone.querySelectorAll("button, nav, .sr-only, svg").forEach((el) => {
      const txt = (el.innerText || "").trim();
      const hasFile = /\.(pdf|zip|txt|py|js|json|csv|docx|xlsx|png|jpg|webp)/i.test(txt);
      if (!hasFile) el.remove();
    });

    const imgs = Array.from(rootEl.querySelectorAll("img"));
    const cloneImgs = Array.from(clone.querySelectorAll("img"));

    imgs.forEach((img, idx) => {
      const src = img.currentSrc || img.src || "";
      const width = img.naturalWidth || img.width || 0;
      const height = img.naturalHeight || img.height || 0;
      const alt = (img.alt || "").trim();

      if (!src || (width > 0 && width < 40 && height > 0 && height < 40) || src.includes("avatar") || src.includes("profile") || src.includes("icon")) {
        if (cloneImgs[idx]) cloneImgs[idx].remove();
        return;
      }

      // Unique deterministic ID per image URL or position
      let mediaId = null;
      for (const [k, v] of sessionState.mediaMap.entries()) {
        if (v.src === src) {
          mediaId = k;
          break;
        }
      }
      if (!mediaId) {
        const attNum = String(sessionState.mediaMap.size + 1).padStart(3, "0");
        mediaId = `ATT_${sessionState.chatPrefix}_IMG${attNum}`;
        sessionState.mediaMap.set(mediaId, {
          id: mediaId,
          type: "image",
          role,
          src,
          alt: alt || "صورة مرفقة في المحادثة",
          fetched: false,
          dataUrl: null,
          mimeType: "image/png",
          sizeBytes: 0
        });
      }
      msgMediaIds.push(mediaId);

      if (cloneImgs[idx]) {
        const placeholder = document.createElement("div");
        placeholder.innerText = `\n[[__MEDIA_PLACEHOLDER_${mediaId}__]]\n`;
        cloneImgs[idx].replaceWith(placeholder);
      }
    });

    const fileLinks = Array.from(clone.querySelectorAll('a[href], [data-testid*="attachment"], [class*="attachment"], [class*="file"]'));
    fileLinks.forEach((fl) => {
      const href = fl.getAttribute ? (fl.getAttribute("href") || "") : "";
      const text = (fl.innerText || "").trim();
      const isDownload = fl.hasAttribute("download") || href.includes("blob:") || href.includes("oaiusercontent") || href.includes("googleusercontent");

      if (isDownload && href && !href.startsWith("javascript:")) {
        let mediaId = null;
        for (const [k, v] of sessionState.mediaMap.entries()) {
          if (v.src === href) {
            mediaId = k;
            break;
          }
        }
        if (!mediaId) {
          const attNum = String(sessionState.mediaMap.size + 1).padStart(3, "0");
          mediaId = `ATT_${sessionState.chatPrefix}_FILE${attNum}`;
          sessionState.mediaMap.set(mediaId, {
            id: mediaId,
            type: "file",
            role,
            src: href,
            alt: text || "ملف مرفق",
            fetched: false,
            dataUrl: null,
            mimeType: "application/octet-stream",
            sizeBytes: 0
          });
        }
        msgMediaIds.push(mediaId);

        const placeholder = document.createElement("div");
        placeholder.innerText = `\n[[__MEDIA_PLACEHOLDER_${mediaId}__]]\n`;
        fl.replaceWith(placeholder);
      }
    });

    clone.querySelectorAll('details, [class*="thought"], [class*="reasoning"], model-thoughts').forEach((thinkEl) => {
      const tText = (thinkEl.innerText || "").trim();
      if (tText) {
        const replacement = document.createElement("div");
        replacement.innerText = `\n--- 🧠 [بداية خطوات التفكير / Reasoning] ---\n${tText}\n--- [نهاية خطوات التفكير] ---\n`;
        thinkEl.replaceWith(replacement);
      }
    });

    clone.querySelectorAll("pre").forEach((pre) => {
      const codeEl = pre.querySelector("code");
      let lang = "";
      if (codeEl && codeEl.className) {
        const match = codeEl.className.match(/language-([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)/);
        if (match) lang = match[1];
      }
      const codeText = (codeEl ? codeEl.innerText : pre.innerText).trim();
      const replacement = document.createElement("div");
      replacement.innerText = `\n\`\`\`${lang}\n${codeText}\n\`\`\`\n`;
      pre.replaceWith(replacement);
    });

    clone.querySelectorAll("table").forEach((tbl) => {
      const asciiTable = parseTableToText(tbl);
      const replacement = document.createElement("div");
      replacement.innerText = asciiTable;
      tbl.replaceWith(replacement);
    });

    const finalText = (clone.innerText || "").replace(/\n{3,}/g, "\n\n").trim();
    return { finalText, msgMediaIds };
  }

  // Real-time capture of visible messages without storing heavy DOM clones in RAM
  function captureVisibleRealtime() {
    expandThinkingBlocksSync();
    const platform = sessionState.platform;

    if (platform === "ChatGPT") {
      const turns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('article[data-testid^="conversation-turn-"], [data-message-author-role]'));
      turns.forEach((el, idx) => {
        if (el.tagName !== "ARTICLE" && el.closest('article[data-testid^="conversation-turn-"]')) return;
        const rawText = (el.innerText || "").trim();
        if (!rawText && el.querySelectorAll("img").length === 0) return;

        const testId = el.getAttribute("data-testid") || el.getAttribute("data-message-id");
        const key = testId || ("gpt_" + rawText.slice(0, 48).replace(/\s+/g, "_"));

        const roleEl = el.hasAttribute("data-message-author-role") ? el : el.querySelector("[data-message-author-role]");
        const rawRole = roleEl ? roleEl.getAttribute("data-message-author-role") : (idx % 2 === 0 ? "user" : "assistant");
        const role = rawRole === "user" ? "User" : "ChatGPT";

        const existing = sessionState.capturedMap.get(key);
        if (!existing || rawText.length > existing.rawLength) {
          const { finalText, msgMediaIds } = extractNodeLightweight(el, platform, role, key);
          if (finalText) {
            sessionState.capturedMap.set(key, {
              key,
              role,
              parsedText: finalText,
              mediaIds: msgMediaIds,
              rawLength: rawText.length,
              order: existing ? existing.order : ++sessionState.orderCounter
            });
          }
        }
      });
    } else {
      // Gemini selectors (Resilient across desktop & mobile web)
      let nodes = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll("user-query, model-response, .query-content, .response-content, message-content"));
      nodes = nodes.filter((el) => {
        const parentMatch = el.parentElement ? el.parentElement.closest("user-query, model-response") : null;
        return !parentMatch;
      });

      nodes.forEach((el) => {
        const tag = el.tagName.toLowerCase();
        const isUser = tag === "user-query" || el.classList.contains("query-content") || Boolean(el.closest("user-query"));
        const role = isUser ? "User" : "Gemini";
        const rawText = (el.innerText || "").trim();
        if (!rawText && el.querySelectorAll("img").length === 0) return;

        const idAttr = el.id || el.getAttribute("data-message-id");
        const key = idAttr || (role + "_" + rawText.slice(0, 55).replace(/\s+/g, "_"));

        const existing = sessionState.capturedMap.get(key);
        if (!existing || rawText.length > existing.rawLength) {
          const { finalText, msgMediaIds } = extractNodeLightweight(el, platform, role, key);
          if (finalText) {
            sessionState.capturedMap.set(key, {
              key,
              role,
              parsedText: finalText,
              mediaIds: msgMediaIds,
              rawLength: rawText.length,
              order: existing ? existing.order : ++sessionState.orderCounter
            });
          }
        }
      });
    }
    updateHUDCounters();
  }

  async function fetchMediaAsBase64(url) {
    if (!url || url.startsWith("javascript:")) return null;
    if (url.startsWith("data:")) {
      return {
        dataUrl: url,
        mimeType: url.substring(5, url.indexOf(";")) || "image/png",
        size: Math.round(url.length * 0.75)
      };
    }
    const controller = new AbortController();
    const timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 4000);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(url, { credentials: "include", signal: controller.signal });
      clearTimeout(timer);
      if (!res.ok) return null;
      const blob = await res.blob();
      if (blob.size > 15 * 1024 * 1024) return null;
      return await new Promise((resolve) => {
        const reader = new FileReader();
        reader.onloadend = () =>
          resolve({
            dataUrl: reader.result,
            mimeType: blob.type || "application/octet-stream",
            size: blob.size
          });
        reader.onerror = () => resolve(null);
        reader.readAsDataURL(blob);
      });
    } catch (e) {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      return null;
    }
  }

  function guessExtension(mimeType, url) {
    if (mimeType) {
      if (mimeType.includes("png")) return "png";
      if (mimeType.includes("jpeg") || mimeType.includes("jpg")) return "jpg";
      if (mimeType.includes("webp")) return "webp";
      if (mimeType.includes("gif")) return "gif";
      if (mimeType.includes("svg")) return "svg";
      if (mimeType.includes("pdf")) return "pdf";
      if (mimeType.includes("json")) return "json";
      if (mimeType.includes("csv")) return "csv";
      if (mimeType.includes("plain")) return "txt";
    }
    const cleanUrl = (url || "").split("?")[0];
    const parts = cleanUrl.split(".");
    if (parts.length > 1) {
      const ext = parts.pop().toLowerCase();
      if (ext.length <= 5 && /^[a-z0-9]+$/.test(ext)) return ext;
    }
    return "bin";
  }

  // Build final Chat Object from whatever is in sessionState right now (Never loses collected messages!)
  function buildChatObjectFromSession() {
    const platform = sessionState.platform;
    const folderName = platform === "Gemini" ? "Gemini_Attachments" : "ChatGPT_Attachments";

    const sortedEntries = Array.from(sessionState.capturedMap.values()).sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order);
    const finalAttachments = [];

    for (const m of sessionState.mediaMap.values()) {
      const ext = guessExtension(m.mimeType, m.src);
      const fileName = `${m.id}.${ext}`;
      const zipPath = `${folderName}/${fileName}`;
      finalAttachments.push({
        id: m.id,
        fileName,
        zipPath,
        platform,
        role: m.role,
        type: m.type,
        mimeType: m.mimeType,
        sizeBytes: m.sizeBytes,
        alt: m.alt,
        originalUrl: m.src,
        dataUrl: m.dataUrl
      });
    }

    const parsedMessages = sortedEntries.map((item, idx) => {
      let textWithCards = item.parsedText;
      (item.mediaIds || []).forEach((mid) => {
        const attRecord = finalAttachments.find((a) => a.id === mid);
        if (attRecord) {
          const sizeKB = attRecord.sizeBytes ? (attRecord.sizeBytes / 1024).toFixed(1) + " KB" : "رابط مباشر";
          const metaCard = [
            `--- 📎 [بطاقة مرفق | معرّف: ${attRecord.id}] ---`,
            `• اسم الملف: ${attRecord.fileName}`,
            `• المسار داخل الـ ZIP: ${attRecord.zipPath}`,
            `• النوع: ${attRecord.type === "image" ? "صورة" : "ملف"} (${attRecord.mimeType}) | الحجم: ${sizeKB}`,
            `• المرسل: ${attRecord.role === "User" ? "المستخدم" : platform}`,
            `• الوصف: ${attRecord.alt}`,
            `• الرابط الأصلي: ${attRecord.originalUrl.startsWith("data:") ? "[مدمج بالـ ZIP]" : attRecord.originalUrl}`,
            `---------------------------------------------------`
          ].join("\n");
          textWithCards = textWithCards.replace(`[[__MEDIA_PLACEHOLDER_${mid}__]]`, "\n" + metaCard + "\n");
        }
      });

      return {
        index: idx + 1,
        role: item.role,
        text: textWithCards
      };
    });

    const chatTitle = (document.title || `${platform} Chat`).replace(/[\\/:*?"<>|]/g, "_").trim();
    return {
      chatId: sessionState.chatPrefix,
      platform,
      title: chatTitle,
      url: window.location.href,
      date: new Date().toLocaleString("ar-EG"),
      timestamp: Date.now(),
      messageCount: parsedMessages.length,
      messages: parsedMessages,
      attachments: finalAttachments
    };
  }

  // Main Smart Extraction Engine with Stagnation Detection & Resume Support
  async function runExtractionEngine({ autoScroll = true, resume = false, downloadAfter = false }) {
    const host = window.location.hostname;
    const platform = host.includes("gemini.google.com") ? "Gemini" : "ChatGPT";

    if (!resume || sessionState.url !== window.location.href || sessionState.capturedMap.size === 0) {
      resetSession(platform);
    }

    sessionState.isRunning = true;
    sessionState.isPaused = false;
    sessionState.forceFinish = false;

    createLiveHUD();

    clearInterval(sessionState.timerInterval);
    sessionState.timerInterval = setInterval(() => {
      if (!sessionState.isPaused) {
        sessionState.elapsedSeconds++;
        updateHUDCounters();
      }
    }, 1000);

    const container = getScrollContainer();
    const isTabVisible = document.visibilityState === "visible";

    // Always capture currently visible screen first!
    captureVisibleRealtime();

    try {
      if (autoScroll && container && isTabVisible) {
        // Phase 1: Climb up to load older lazy history (only if not resuming from downward scan)
        if (sessionState.phase === "UP") {
          updateHUDStatus("⬆️ جاري الصعود لتحميل الرسائل القديمة...", 15);
          let unchangedTopTicks = 0;
          let lastCount = sessionState.capturedMap.size;
          let lastScrollHeight = container.scrollHeight;

          for (let upStep = 0; upStep < 80; upStep++) {
            await waitWhilePaused();
            if (sessionState.forceFinish) break;

            container.scrollTop = 0;
            window.scrollTo(0, 0);
            await sleep(420);
            captureVisibleRealtime();

            const newHeight = container.scrollHeight;
            const newCount = sessionState.capturedMap.size;

            updateHUDStatus(`⬆️ تحميل الأرشيف العلوي... (تم صيد ${newCount} رسالة)`, Math.min(40, 15 + upStep));

            // Checkpoint every 10 steps
            if (upStep % 10 === 0) await saveCheckpointSnapshot();

            if (newHeight === lastScrollHeight && newCount === lastCount && container.scrollTop <= 10) {
              unchangedTopTicks++;
              if (unchangedTopTicks >= 4) break; // Reached the true top of the conversation!
            } else {
              unchangedTopTicks = 0;
            }
            lastScrollHeight = newHeight;
            lastCount = newCount;
          }
          sessionState.phase = "DOWN";
          sessionState.lastScrollTop = 0;
        }

        // Phase 2: Step down smoothly from lastScrollTop to the bottom
        if (sessionState.phase === "DOWN" && !sessionState.forceFinish) {
          let currentPos = sessionState.lastScrollTop || 0;
          const stepSize = Math.max(window.innerHeight * 0.8, 500);
          let stuckBottomTicks = 0;
          let prevScrollTop = -1;

          for (let downStep = 0; downStep < 400; downStep++) {
            await waitWhilePaused();
            if (sessionState.forceFinish) break;

            container.scrollTop = currentPos;
            window.scrollTo(0, currentPos);
            sessionState.lastScrollTop = currentPos;

            await sleep(280);
            captureVisibleRealtime();

            const maxScroll = Math.max(container.scrollHeight - container.clientHeight, 1);
            const pct = 40 + Math.round(Math.min(1, currentPos / maxScroll) * 40);
            updateHUDStatus(`⬇️ مسح المحادثة... (${Math.min(100, Math.round((currentPos / maxScroll) * 100))}%)`, pct);

            if (downStep % 12 === 0) await saveCheckpointSnapshot();

            if (currentPos >= container.scrollHeight - container.clientHeight - 20) {
              stuckBottomTicks++;
              if (stuckBottomTicks >= 3) break; // Reached bottom!
            } else if (Math.abs(container.scrollTop - prevScrollTop) < 5 && currentPos > container.scrollHeight) {
              break;
            } else {
              stuckBottomTicks = 0;
            }

            prevScrollTop = container.scrollTop;
            currentPos += stepSize;
          }

          container.scrollTop = container.scrollHeight;
          await sleep(300);
          captureVisibleRealtime();
        }
      }

      // Phase 3: Fetch binary data for collected attachments (with timeout protection)
      const mediaEntries = Array.from(sessionState.mediaMap.values());
      for (let i = 0; i < mediaEntries.length; i++) {
        await waitWhilePaused();
        if (sessionState.forceFinish) break;

        const m = mediaEntries[i];
        if (!m.fetched && isTabVisible) {
          updateHUDStatus(`📎 جاري تحميل المرفق (${i + 1} من ${mediaEntries.length})...`, 82 + Math.round(((i + 1) / mediaEntries.length) * 15));
          const fetched = await fetchMediaAsBase64(m.src);
          if (fetched) {
            m.dataUrl = fetched.dataUrl;
            m.mimeType = fetched.mimeType;
            m.sizeBytes = fetched.size;
          }
          m.fetched = true;
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn("AI Archiver partial interruption, saving collected messages anyway:", err);
    }

    // Finalize & Save to chrome.storage.local
    const finalChatObj = buildChatObjectFromSession();
    if (finalChatObj.messageCount > 0) {
      await saveStoredChat(finalChatObj);
      updateHUDStatus(`🎉 اكتمل الحفظ! (${finalChatObj.messageCount} رسالة و ${finalChatObj.attachments.length} مرفق)`, 100);
      if (downloadAfter) {
        exportDualInPage([finalChatObj], finalChatObj.platform.toUpperCase() + "_SINGLE");
      }
    } else {
      updateHUDStatus("❌ لم يتم رصد رسائل في هذه الصفحة.", 100);
    }

    sessionState.isRunning = false;
    closeHUD(2800);
    return finalChatObj;
  }

  function dataUrlToUint8Array(dataUrl) {
    const parts = dataUrl.split(",");
    const byteString = atob(parts[1]);
    const arr = new Uint8Array(byteString.length);
    for (let i = 0; i < byteString.length; i++) arr[i] = byteString.charCodeAt(i);
    return arr;
  }

  function exportDualInPage(chatsToExport, label = "SINGLE") {
    const dateStamp = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    const baseFilename = `AI_Chats_${label}_${dateStamp}`;
    const zipFilename = `${baseFilename}_Attachments.zip`;
    const totalAttachments = chatsToExport.reduce((acc, c) => acc + (c.attachments ? c.attachments.length : 0), 0);

    let txt = "================================================================================\n";
    txt += "                 📚 أرشيف محادثات الذكاء الاصطناعي الموحّد (AI CONTEXT ARCHIVE)\n";
    txt += "================================================================================\n";
    txt += `• تاريخ التصدير: ${new Date().toLocaleString("ar-EG")}\n`;
    txt += `• إجمالي الرسائل المستخرجة: ${chatsToExport.reduce((a, c) => a + c.messageCount, 0)} رسالة\n`;
    txt += `• إجمالي المرفقات: ${totalAttachments} مرفق\n`;
    txt += `• ملف المرفقات المضغوط المرتبط: ${totalAttachments > 0 ? zipFilename : "لا توجد مرفقات"}\n`;
    txt += "================================================================================\n\n";

    chatsToExport.forEach((chat, idx) => {
      txt += `╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗\n`;
      txt += `  محادثة (#${idx + 1}) | المنصة: [${chat.platform}] | المعرف: ${chat.chatId}\n`;
      txt += `  العنوان: ${chat.title} | التاريخ: ${chat.date}\n`;
      txt += `  الرابط: ${chat.url}\n`;
      txt += `╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝\n\n`;
      chat.messages.forEach((m) => {
        const speaker = m.role === "User" ? `👤 [المستخدم -> ${chat.platform}] (#${m.index})` : `🤖 [${m.role}] (#${m.index})`;
        txt += `${speaker}:\n${m.text}\n\n--------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n`;
      });
    });

    const txtBlob = new Blob([txt], { type: "text/plain;charset=utf-8" });
    const txtUrl = URL.createObjectURL(txtBlob);
    const aTxt = document.createElement("a");
    aTxt.href = txtUrl;
    aTxt.download = `${baseFilename}.txt`;
    aTxt.click();

    if (totalAttachments > 0 && window.SimpleZip) {
      const zip = new window.SimpleZip();
      chatsToExport.forEach((chat) => {
        (chat.attachments || []).forEach((att) => {
          if (att.dataUrl) {
            try {
              zip.addFile(att.zipPath, dataUrlToUint8Array(att.dataUrl));
            } catch (e) {
              zip.addTextFile(att.zipPath + ".url.txt", att.originalUrl);
            }
          } else {
            zip.addTextFile(att.zipPath + ".url.txt", att.originalUrl);
          }
        });
      });
      const zipBlob = zip.generateBlob();
      const zipUrl = URL.createObjectURL(zipBlob);
      setTimeout(() => {
        const aZip = document.createElement("a");
        aZip.href = zipUrl;
        aZip.download = zipFilename;
        aZip.click();
      }, 650);
    }
  }

  chrome.runtime.onMessage.addListener((request, sender, sendResponse) => {
    if (request.action === "EXTRACT_FULL_CHAT") {
      const shouldScroll = request.autoScroll && document.visibilityState === "visible";
      runExtractionEngine({ autoScroll: shouldScroll, resume: Boolean(request.resume), downloadAfter: false })
        .then((data) => sendResponse({ ok: true, data }))
        .catch((err) => sendResponse({ ok: false, error: String(err) }));
      return true;
    }
  });
}

2. تعديل سريع في popup.js (لإزالة حد الـ 10 ثوانٍ القديم في المحادثات الضخمة)

في ملف popup.js الخاص بالنسخة السابقة، قم فقط بتبديل دالة extractFromTargetTab بهذا التحديث (أو اترك اعتمادك الأساسي على الزر العائم 🗂️ داخل صفحة المحادثة نفسها لأنه أسرع بـ 10 أضعاف في المحادثات الطويلة على الموبايل):

async function extractFromTargetTab() {
  const targetTab = await findTargetAIChatTab();
  if (!targetTab) {
    setStatus("⚠️ لم يتم العثور على تبويب مفتوح لـ Gemini أو ChatGPT!", "#fbbf24");
    return null;
  }

  setStatus(`⏳ جاري سحب الرسائل الظاهرة من تبويب (${targetTab.title.slice(0, 25)})...`, "#38bdf8");

  try {
    await chrome.scripting.executeScript({
      target: { tabId: targetTab.id },
      files: ["zip_builder.js", "content.js"]
    });
  } catch (e) {}

  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    chrome.tabs.sendMessage(targetTab.id, { action: "EXTRACT_FULL_CHAT", autoScroll: false }, (res) => {
      if (chrome.runtime.lastError || !res || !res.ok) {
        setStatus("⚠️ للمحادثات الضخمة: افتح تبويب الدردشة واضغط على الزر العائم 🗂️ أسفل يسار الشاشة!", "#fbbf24");
        resolve(null);
      } else {
        resolve(res.data);
      }
    });
  });
}

# 2. zip_builder.js
zip_builder_content = """// Minimal Pure-JS ZIP Builder (STORE method with CRC32)
class SimpleZip {
  constructor() {
    this.files = [];
    this.crcTable = this.makeCRCTable();
  }

  makeCRCTable() {
    let c;
    const crcTable = [];
    for (let n = 0; n < 256; n++) {
      c = n;
      for (let k = 0; k < 8; k++) {
        c = ((c & 1) ? (0xEDB88320 ^ (c >>> 1)) : (c >>> 1));
      }
      crcTable[n] = c;
    }
    return crcTable;
  }

  crc32(uint8Arr) {
    let crc = 0 ^ (-1);
    for (let i = 0; i < uint8Arr.length; i++) {
      crc = (crc >>> 8) ^ this.crcTable[(crc ^ uint8Arr[i]) & 0xFF];
    }
    return (crc ^ (-1)) >>> 0;
  }

  addFile(path, uint8Data) {
    const nameBytes = new TextEncoder().encode(path);
    const crc = this.crc32(uint8Data);
    this.files.push({
      nameBytes,
      data: uint8Data,
      crc,
      size: uint8Data.length
    });
  }

  addTextFile(path, textContent) {
    const data = new TextEncoder().encode(textContent);
    this.addFile(path, data);
  }

  generateBlob() {
    let offset = 0;
    const localHeaders = [];
    const centralHeaders = [];

    const now = new Date();
    const dosTime = ((now.getHours() << 11) | (now.getMinutes() << 5) | (now.getSeconds() >> 1)) & 0xFFFF;
    const dosDate = (((now.getFullYear() - 1980) << 9) | ((now.getMonth() + 1) << 5) | now.getDate()) & 0xFFFF;

    for (const file of this.files) {
      const nameLen = file.nameBytes.length;
      const localHeader = new Uint8Array(30 + nameLen);
      const lv = new DataView(localHeader.buffer);
      lv.setUint32(0, 0x04034b50, true);
      lv.setUint16(4, 20, true);
      lv.setUint16(6, 0x0800, true);
      lv.setUint16(8, 0, true);
      lv.setUint16(10, dosTime, true);
      lv.setUint16(12, dosDate, true);
      lv.setUint32(14, file.crc, true);
      lv.setUint32(18, file.size, true);
      lv.setUint32(22, file.size, true);
      lv.setUint16(26, nameLen, true);
      lv.setUint16(28, 0, true);
      localHeader.set(file.nameBytes, 30);

      localHeaders.push(localHeader);
      localHeaders.push(file.data);

      const centralHeader = new Uint8Array(46 + nameLen);
      const cv = new DataView(centralHeader.buffer);
      cv.setUint32(0, 0x02014b50, true);
      cv.setUint16(4, 20, true);
      cv.setUint16(6, 20, true);
      cv.setUint16(8, 0x0800, true);
      cv.setUint16(10, 0, true);
      cv.setUint16(12, dosTime, true);
      cv.setUint16(14, dosDate, true);
      cv.setUint32(16, file.crc, true);
      cv.setUint32(20, file.size, true);
      cv.setUint32(24, file.size, true);
      cv.setUint16(28, nameLen, true);
      cv.setUint16(30, 0, true);
      cv.setUint16(32, 0, true);
      cv.setUint16(34, 0, true);
      cv.setUint16(36, 0, true);
      cv.setUint32(38, 0, true);
      cv.setUint32(42, offset, true);
      centralHeader.set(file.nameBytes, 46);

      centralHeaders.push(centralHeader);
      offset += localHeader.length + file.size;
    }

    let centralSize = 0;
    for (const ch of centralHeaders) centralSize += ch.length;

    const eocd = new Uint8Array(22);
    const ev = new DataView(eocd.buffer);
    ev.setUint32(0, 0x06054b50, true);
    ev.setUint16(4, 0, true);
    ev.setUint16(6, 0, true);
    ev.setUint16(8, this.files.length, true);
    ev.setUint16(10, this.files.length, true);
    ev.setUint32(12, centralSize, true);
    ev.setUint32(16, offset, true);
    ev.setUint16(20, 0, true);

    return new Blob([...localHeaders, ...centralHeaders, eocd], { type: "application/zip" });
  }
}
window.SimpleZip = SimpleZip;
"""

      </div>
      <div id="ai-archiver-status" style="margin-bottom:8px; color:#cbd5e1; font-size:11.5px;">جاري فحص الرسائل...</div>
      <div style="width:100%; background:#1e293b; height:6px; border-radius:4px; overflow:hidden;">
        <div id="ai-archiver-bar" style="width:15%; background:#38bdf8; height:100%; transition:width 0.25s;"></div>
      </div>
    `;
    document.body.appendChild(overlay);
  }

  function updateOverlay(text, percent, step = "") {
    const statusEl = document.getElementById("ai-archiver-status");
    const barEl = document.getElementById("ai-archiver-bar");
    const stepEl = document.getElementById("ai-archiver-step");
    if (statusEl) statusEl.innerText = text;
    if (barEl && percent !== undefined) barEl.style.width = percent + "%";
    if (stepEl && step) stepEl.innerText = step;
  }

  function removeOverlay(delay = 1400) {
    setTimeout(() => {
      const overlay = document.getElementById("ai-archiver-overlay");
      if (overlay) overlay.remove();
    }, delay);
  }

  function getScrollContainer() {
    const candidates = [
      document.querySelector("infinite-scroller"),
      document.querySelector("main div.overflow-y-auto"),
      document.querySelector('[class*="react-scroll-to-bottom"] > div'),
      document.querySelector("main")
    ];
    for (const c of candidates) {
      if (c && c.scrollHeight > c.clientHeight + 40) return c;
    }
    let best = document.scrollingElement || document.documentElement;
    let maxScroll = best ? best.scrollHeight : 0;
    document.querySelectorAll("div, main, infinite-scroller").forEach((el) => {
      const style = window.getComputedStyle(el);
      if ((style.overflowY === "auto" || style.overflowY === "scroll") && el.scrollHeight > el.clientHeight + 40) {
        if (el.scrollHeight > maxScroll) {
          maxScroll = el.scrollHeight;
          best = el;
        }
      }
    });
    return best;
  }

  function parseTableToText(tableEl) {
    const rows = Array.from(tableEl.querySelectorAll("tr"));
    if (rows.length === 0) return "";
    const matrix = rows.map((row) =>
      Array.from(row.querySelectorAll("th, td")).map((cell) => cell.innerText.replace(/\\n+/g, " ").trim())
    );
    let out = "\\n[جدول بيانات]:\\n";
    matrix.forEach((r, idx) => {
      out += "| " + r.join(" | ") + " |\\n";
      if (idx === 0) {
        out += "| " + r.map(() => "---").join(" | ") + " |\\n";
      }
    });
    return out + "\\n";
  }

  async function expandThinkingBlocks() {
    document.querySelectorAll("details:not([open])").forEach((d) => d.setAttribute("open", "true"));
    document.querySelectorAll('button[aria-expanded="false"]').forEach((btn) => {
      const txt = (btn.innerText || "").toLowerCase();
      if (txt.includes("thought") || txt.includes("thinking") || txt.includes("تفكير")) {
        try { btn.click(); } catch (e) {}
      }
    });
  }

  // Safe fetch with 4-second timeout so it NEVER hangs forever on mobile!
  async function fetchMediaAsBase64(url) {
    if (!url || url.startsWith("javascript:")) return null;
    if (url.startsWith("data:")) {
      return {
        dataUrl: url,
        mimeType: url.substring(5, url.indexOf(";")) || "image/png",
        size: Math.round(url.length * 0.75)
      };
    }
    const controller = new AbortController();
    const timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 4500);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(url, { credentials: "include", signal: controller.signal });
      clearTimeout(timer);
      if (!res.ok) return null;
      const blob = await res.blob();
      // Skip huge files > 15MB in storage to prevent mobile crash
      if (blob.size > 15 * 1024 * 1024) return null;
      return await new Promise((resolve) => {
        const reader = new FileReader();
        reader.onloadend = () =>
          resolve({
            dataUrl: reader.result,
            mimeType: blob.type || "application/octet-stream",
            size: blob.size
          });
        reader.onerror = () => resolve(null);
        reader.readAsDataURL(blob);
      });
    } catch (e) {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      return null;
    }
  }

  function guessExtension(mimeType, url) {
    if (mimeType) {
      if (mimeType.includes("png")) return "png";
      if (mimeType.includes("jpeg") || mimeType.includes("jpg")) return "jpg";
      if (mimeType.includes("webp")) return "webp";
      if (mimeType.includes("gif")) return "gif";
      if (mimeType.includes("svg")) return "svg";
      if (mimeType.includes("pdf")) return "pdf";
      if (mimeType.includes("json")) return "json";
      if (mimeType.includes("csv")) return "csv";
      if (mimeType.includes("plain")) return "txt";
    }
    const cleanUrl = (url || "").split("?")[0];
    const parts = cleanUrl.split(".");
    if (parts.length > 1) {
      const ext = parts.pop().toLowerCase();
      if (ext.length <= 5 && /^[a-z0-9]+$/.test(ext)) return ext;
    }
    return "bin";
  }

  function parseRichMessageNode(rootEl, platform, role, msgIndex, chatPrefix, mediaList) {
    const clone = rootEl.cloneNode(true);

    clone.querySelectorAll("button, nav, .sr-only, svg").forEach((el) => {
      const txt = (el.innerText || "").trim();
      const hasFile = /\\.(pdf|zip|txt|py|js|json|csv|docx|xlsx|png|jpg|webp)/i.test(txt);
      if (!hasFile) el.remove();
    });

    const imgs = Array.from(rootEl.querySelectorAll("img"));
    const cloneImgs = Array.from(clone.querySelectorAll("img"));

    imgs.forEach((img, idx) => {
      const src = img.currentSrc || img.src || "";
      const width = img.naturalWidth || img.width || 0;
      const height = img.naturalHeight || img.height || 0;
      const alt = (img.alt || "").trim();

      if (!src || (width > 0 && width < 40 && height > 0 && height < 40) || src.includes("avatar") || src.includes("profile") || src.includes("icon")) {
        if (cloneImgs[idx]) cloneImgs[idx].remove();
        return;
      }

      const attNum = String(mediaList.length + 1).padStart(3, "0");
      const fileBaseId = `ATT_${chatPrefix}_MSG${msgIndex}_IMG${attNum}`;
      mediaList.push({
        id: fileBaseId,
        type: "image",
        role: role,
        src: src,
        alt: alt || "صورة مرفقة في المحادثة",
        msgIndex: msgIndex
      });

      if (cloneImgs[idx]) {
        const placeholder = document.createElement("div");
        placeholder.innerText = `\\n[[__MEDIA_PLACEHOLDER_${fileBaseId}__]]\\n`;
        cloneImgs[idx].replaceWith(placeholder);
      }
    });

    const fileLinks = Array.from(clone.querySelectorAll('a[href], [data-testid*="attachment"], [class*="attachment"], [class*="file"]'));
    fileLinks.forEach((fl) => {
      const href = fl.getAttribute ? (fl.getAttribute("href") || "") : "";
      const text = (fl.innerText || "").trim();
      const isDownload = fl.hasAttribute("download") || href.includes("blob:") || href.includes("oaiusercontent") || href.includes("googleusercontent");

      if (isDownload && href && !href.startsWith("javascript:")) {
        const attNum = String(mediaList.length + 1).padStart(3, "0");
        const fileBaseId = `ATT_${chatPrefix}_MSG${msgIndex}_FILE${attNum}`;
        mediaList.push({
          id: fileBaseId,
          type: "file",
          role: role,
          src: href,
          alt: text || "ملف مرفق",
          msgIndex: msgIndex
        });
        const placeholder = document.createElement("div");
        placeholder.innerText = `\\n[[__MEDIA_PLACEHOLDER_${fileBaseId}__]]\\n`;
        fl.replaceWith(placeholder);
      }
    });

    clone.querySelectorAll('details, [class*="thought"], [class*="reasoning"], model-thoughts').forEach((thinkEl) => {
      const tText = (thinkEl.innerText || "").trim();
      if (tText) {
        const replacement = document.createElement("div");
        replacement.innerText = `\\n--- 🧠 [بداية خطوات التفكير / Reasoning] ---\\n${tText}\\n--- [نهاية خطوات التفكير] ---\\n`;
        thinkEl.replaceWith(replacement);
      }
    });

    clone.querySelectorAll("pre").forEach((pre) => {
      const codeEl = pre.querySelector("code");
      let lang = "";
      if (codeEl && codeEl.className) {
        const match = codeEl.className.match(/language-([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)/);
        if (match) lang = match[1];
      }
      const codeText = (codeEl ? codeEl.innerText : pre.innerText).trim();
      const replacement = document.createElement("div");
      replacement.innerText = `\\n\`\`\`${lang}\\n${codeText}\\n\`\`\`\\n`;
      pre.replaceWith(replacement);
    });

    clone.querySelectorAll("table").forEach((tbl) => {
      const asciiTable = parseTableToText(tbl);
      const replacement = document.createElement("div");
      replacement.innerText = asciiTable;
      tbl.replaceWith(replacement);
    });

    let finalText = clone.innerText || "";
    return finalText.replace(/\\n{3,}/g, "\\n\\n").trim();
  }

  async function captureVisibleNodes(platform, capturedMap) {
    await expandThinkingBlocks();

    if (platform === "ChatGPT") {
      let turns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('article[data-testid^="conversation-turn-"], [data-message-author-role]'));
      turns.forEach((el, idx) => {
        if (el.tagName !== "ARTICLE" && el.closest('article[data-testid^="conversation-turn-"]')) return;
        const textSample = (el.innerText || "").trim();
        if (!textSample && el.querySelectorAll("img").length === 0) return;

        const key = el.getAttribute("data-testid") || el.getAttribute("data-message-id") || ("gpt_" + idx + "_" + textSample.slice(0, 32));
        const roleEl = el.hasAttribute("data-message-author-role") ? el : el.querySelector("[data-message-author-role]");
        const rawRole = roleEl ? roleEl.getAttribute("data-message-author-role") : (idx % 2 === 0 ? "user" : "assistant");
        const role = rawRole === "user" ? "User" : "ChatGPT";

        if (!capturedMap.has(key) || textSample.length >= (capturedMap.get(key).rawLength || 0)) {
          capturedMap.set(key, {
            role,
            node: el.cloneNode(true),
            liveNode: el,
            rawLength: textSample.length
          });
        }
      });
    } else {
      // Gemini (Desktop & Mobile web selectors)
      let nodes = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll("user-query, model-response, .query-content, .response-content, [data-message-id]"));
      // Filter out child duplicates if parent user-query/model-response is matched
      nodes = nodes.filter((el) => {
        const parentMatch = el.parentElement ? el.parentElement.closest("user-query, model-response") : null;
        return !parentMatch;
      });

      nodes.forEach((el, idx) => {
        const tag = el.tagName.toLowerCase();
        const isUser = tag === "user-query" || el.classList.contains("query-content") || el.matches('[data-message-author-role="user"]');
        const role = isUser ? "User" : "Gemini";
        const textSample = (el.innerText || "").trim();
        if (!textSample && el.querySelectorAll("img").length === 0) return;

        const key = el.id || el.getAttribute("data-message-id") || ("gem_" + idx + "_" + textSample.slice(0, 32));
        if (!capturedMap.has(key) || textSample.length >= (capturedMap.get(key).rawLength || 0)) {
          capturedMap.set(key, {
            role,
            node: el.cloneNode(true),
            liveNode: el,
            rawLength: textSample.length
          });
        }
      });
    }
  }

  async function performFullChatExtraction(options = { autoScroll: true }) {
    createOverlay();
    const host = window.location.hostname;
    const platform = host.includes("gemini.google.com") ? "Gemini" : "ChatGPT";
    const chatPrefix = (platform === "Gemini" ? "GEM" : "GPT") + "_" + Date.now().toString().slice(-5);

    const container = getScrollContainer();
    const capturedMap = new Map();

    // Only scroll if this tab is visible (in Kiwi, background tabs freeze setTimeout!)
    const isTabVisible = document.visibilityState === "visible";

    if (options.autoScroll && container && isTabVisible) {
      updateOverlay("جاري الصعود لأعلى المحادثة...", 20, "1/3");
      let prevHeight = container.scrollHeight;
      for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 10; attempt++) {
        container.scrollTop = 0;
        window.scrollTo(0, 0);
        await sleep(300);
        await captureVisibleNodes(platform, capturedMap);
        const newHeight = container.scrollHeight;
        if (newHeight === prevHeight && container.scrollTop === 0) break;
        prevHeight = newHeight;
      }

      updateOverlay("جاري المسح السريع للرسائل...", 50, "2/3");
      let currentPos = 0;
      const stepSize = Math.max(window.innerHeight * 0.85, 450);
      let steps = 0;
      while (currentPos < container.scrollHeight && steps < 60) {
        container.scrollTop = currentPos;
        window.scrollTo(0, currentPos);
        await sleep(220);
        await captureVisibleNodes(platform, capturedMap);
        currentPos += stepSize;
        steps++;
      }
      container.scrollTop = container.scrollHeight;
      await sleep(250);
    }

    await captureVisibleNodes(platform, capturedMap);

    updateOverlay("جاري معالجة النصوص والمرفقات...", 80, "3/3");
    const mediaList = [];
    const parsedMessages = [];
    let msgIdx = 1;

    for (const [, item] of capturedMap.entries()) {
      const sourceNode = item.liveNode && document.body.contains(item.liveNode) ? item.liveNode : item.node;
      const parsedText = parseRichMessageNode(sourceNode, platform, item.role, msgIdx, chatPrefix, mediaList);
      if (parsedText) {
        parsedMessages.push({
          index: msgIdx,
          role: item.role,
          text: parsedText
        });
        msgIdx++;
      }
    }

    const finalAttachments = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < mediaList.length; i++) {
      const m = mediaList[i];
      updateOverlay(`حفظ المرفق (${i + 1}/${mediaList.length})...`, 85, "3/3");
      const fetched = isTabVisible ? await fetchMediaAsBase64(m.src) : null;
      const ext = guessExtension(fetched ? fetched.mimeType : "", m.src);
      const fileName = `${m.id}.${ext}`;
      const folderName = platform === "Gemini" ? "Gemini_Attachments" : "ChatGPT_Attachments";
      const zipPath = `${folderName}/${fileName}`;

      const attRecord = {
        id: m.id,
        fileName,
        zipPath,
        platform,
        role: m.role,
        type: m.type,
        mimeType: fetched ? fetched.mimeType : "unknown",
        sizeBytes: fetched ? fetched.size : 0,
        alt: m.alt,
        originalUrl: m.src,
        dataUrl: fetched ? fetched.dataUrl : null,
        msgIndex: m.msgIndex
      };
      finalAttachments.push(attRecord);

      const targetMsg = parsedMessages.find((pm) => pm.index === m.msgIndex);
      if (targetMsg) {
        const sizeKB = attRecord.sizeBytes ? (attRecord.sizeBytes / 1024).toFixed(1) + " KB" : "رابط مباشر";
        const metaCard = [
          `--- 📎 [بطاقة مرفق | معرّف: ${attRecord.id}] ---`,
          `• اسم الملف: ${attRecord.fileName}`,
          `• المسار داخل الـ ZIP: ${attRecord.zipPath}`,
          `• النوع: ${attRecord.type === "image" ? "صورة" : "ملف"} (${attRecord.mimeType}) | الحجم: ${sizeKB}`,
          `• المرسل: ${attRecord.role === "User" ? "المستخدم" : platform}`,
          `• الوصف: ${attRecord.alt}`,
          `• الرابط الأصلي: ${attRecord.originalUrl.startsWith("data:") ? "[مدمج بالـ ZIP]" : attRecord.originalUrl}`,
          `---------------------------------------------------`
        ].join("\\n");
        targetMsg.text = targetMsg.text.replace(`[[__MEDIA_PLACEHOLDER_${m.id}__]]`, "\\n" + metaCard + "\\n");
      }
    }

    updateOverlay(`✅ تم السحب بنجاح! (${parsedMessages.length} رسالة)`, 100, "تم");
    removeOverlay(1200);

    const chatTitle = (document.title || `${platform} Chat`).replace(/[\\\\/:*?"<>|]/g, "_").trim();
    return {
      chatId: chatPrefix,
      platform,
      title: chatTitle,
      url: window.location.href,
      date: new Date().toLocaleString("ar-EG"),
      timestamp: Date.now(),
      messageCount: parsedMessages.length,
      messages: parsedMessages,
      attachments: finalAttachments
    };
  }

  function dataUrlToUint8Array(dataUrl) {
    const parts = dataUrl.split(",");
    const byteString = atob(parts[1]);
    const arr = new Uint8Array(byteString.length);
    for (let i = 0; i < byteString.length; i++) arr[i] = byteString.charCodeAt(i);
    return arr;
  }

  function exportDualInPage(chatsToExport, label = "SINGLE") {
    const dateStamp = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    const baseFilename = `AI_Chats_${label}_${dateStamp}`;
    const zipFilename = `${baseFilename}_Attachments.zip`;
    const totalAttachments = chatsToExport.reduce((acc, c) => acc + (c.attachments ? c.attachments.length : 0), 0);

    let txt = "================================================================================\\n";
    txt += "                 📚 أرشيف محادثات الذكاء الاصطناعي الموحّد (AI CONTEXT ARCHIVE)\\n";
    txt += "================================================================================\\n";
    txt += `• تاريخ التصدير: ${new Date().toLocaleString("ar-EG")}\\n`;
    txt += `• ملف المرفقات المضغوط المرتبط: ${totalAttachments > 0 ? zipFilename : "لا توجد مرفقات"}\\n`;
    txt += "================================================================================\\n\\n";

    chatsToExport.forEach((chat, idx) => {
      txt += `╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗\\n`;
      txt += `  محادثة (#${idx + 1}) | المنصة: [${chat.platform}] | المعرف: ${chat.chatId}\\n`;
      txt += `  العنوان: ${chat.title} | التاريخ: ${chat.date}\\n`;
      txt += `  الرابط: ${chat.url}\\n`;
      txt += `╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝\\n\\n`;
      chat.messages.forEach((m) => {
        const speaker = m.role === "User" ? `👤 [المستخدم -> ${chat.platform}] (#${m.index})` : `🤖 [${m.role}] (#${m.index})`;
        txt += `${speaker}:\\n${m.text}\\n\\n--------------------------------------------------------------------------------\\n\\n`;
      });
    });

    const txtBlob = new Blob([txt], { type: "text/plain;charset=utf-8" });
    const txtUrl = URL.createObjectURL(txtBlob);
    const aTxt = document.createElement("a");
    aTxt.href = txtUrl;
    aTxt.download = `${baseFilename}.txt`;
    aTxt.click();

    if (totalAttachments > 0 && window.SimpleZip) {
      const zip = new window.SimpleZip();
      chatsToExport.forEach((chat) => {
        (chat.attachments || []).forEach((att) => {
          if (att.dataUrl) {
            try {
              zip.addFile(att.zipPath, dataUrlToUint8Array(att.dataUrl));
            } catch (e) {
              zip.addTextFile(att.zipPath + ".url.txt", att.originalUrl);
            }
          } else {
            zip.addTextFile(att.zipPath + ".url.txt", att.originalUrl);
          }
        });
      });
      const zipBlob = zip.generateBlob();
      const zipUrl = URL.createObjectURL(zipBlob);
      setTimeout(() => {
        const aZip = document.createElement("a");
        aZip.href = zipUrl;
        aZip.download = zipFilename;
        aZip.click();
      }, 600);
    }
  }

  chrome.runtime.onMessage.addListener((request, sender, sendResponse) => {
    if (request.action === "EXTRACT_FULL_CHAT") {
      // Notice: If triggered from Kiwi's separate extension tab, disable slow scroll loop so background tab doesn't freeze!
      const shouldScroll = request.autoScroll && document.visibilityState === "visible";
      performFullChatExtraction({ autoScroll: shouldScroll })
        .then(async (data) => {
          if (data && data.messageCount > 0) {
            await saveStoredChat(data);
          }
          sendResponse({ ok: true, data });
        })
        .catch((err) => sendResponse({ ok: false, error: String(err) }));
      return true;
    }
  });
}
"""

with open(os.path.join(project_dir, "content.js"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write(content_js)

# 5. popup.js - Smart Tab Finder that ignores `kiwi-extension://` tab and finds the actual Gemini/ChatGPT tab!
popup_js = """document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", refreshUI);

// Auto-update UI if a chat is saved from the in-page floating button
chrome.storage.onChanged.addListener((changes) => {
  if (changes.archivedChats) refreshUI();
});

function setStatus(msg, color = "#38bdf8") {
  const box = document.getElementById("statusBox");
  box.style.color = color;
  box.innerText = msg;
}

function getStoredChats() {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    chrome.storage.local.get(["archivedChats"], (res) => {
      resolve(res.archivedChats || []);
    });
  });
}

function setStoredChats(chats) {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    chrome.storage.local.set({ archivedChats: chats }, () => resolve());
  });
}

async function refreshUI() {
  const chats = await getStoredChats();
  chats.sort((a, b) => a.timestamp - b.timestamp);

  const geminiChats = chats.filter((c) => c.platform === "Gemini");
  const gptChats = chats.filter((c) => c.platform === "ChatGPT");

  const geminiAtt = geminiChats.reduce((acc, c) => acc + (c.attachments ? c.attachments.length : 0), 0);
  const gptAtt = gptChats.reduce((acc, c) => acc + (c.attachments ? c.attachments.length : 0), 0);

  document.getElementById("geminiCount").innerText = `${geminiChats.length} محادثة (${geminiAtt} مرفق)`;
  document.getElementById("gptCount").innerText = `${gptChats.length} محادثة (${gptAtt} مرفق)`;

  const listEl = document.getElementById("chatList");
  if (chats.length === 0) {
    listEl.innerHTML = `<div style="text-align:center; color:#64748b; padding:12px;">لا توجد محادثات محفوظة في الأرشيف بعد</div>`;
    return;
  }

  listEl.innerHTML = "";
  chats.forEach((c) => {
    const row = document.createElement("div");
    row.className = "chat-item";
    const isGem = c.platform === "Gemini";
    const attCount = c.attachments ? c.attachments.length : 0;

    row.innerHTML = `
      <div style="overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; max-width:260px;">
        <span class="platform-tag ${isGem ? 'tag-gemini' : 'tag-gpt'}">${c.platform}</span>
        <strong title="${c.title}">${c.title}</strong>
        <div class="chat-meta">الرسائل: ${c.messageCount} | المرفقات: ${attCount} | المعرف: ${c.chatId}</div>
      </div>
      <button class="del-chat" data-id="${c.chatId}" title="حذف">✖</button>
    `;
    listEl.appendChild(row);
  });

  listEl.querySelectorAll(".del-chat").forEach((btn) => {
    btn.addEventListener("click", async (e) => {
      const id = e.currentTarget.getAttribute("data-id");
      const current = await getStoredChats();
      await setStoredChats(current.filter((x) => x.chatId !== id));
      refreshUI();
      setStatus("تم حذف المحادثة من الأرشيف.", "#f87171");
    });
  });
}

// Crucial Fix for Kiwi Browser: Find the open Gemini/ChatGPT tab even when the popup itself is the active tab!
async function findTargetAIChatTab() {
  const allTabs = await chrome.tabs.query({});
  const aiTabs = allTabs.filter((t) =>
    t.url && (
      t.url.includes("gemini.google.com") ||
      t.url.includes("chatgpt.com") ||
      t.url.includes("chat.openai.com")
    )
  );
  if (aiTabs.length === 0) return null;
  // Prefer active tab if on desktop, otherwise pick the most recently accessed / last AI tab in Kiwi
  const activeAi = aiTabs.find((t) => t.active);
  if (activeAi) return activeAi;
  aiTabs.sort((a, b) => (b.lastAccessed || b.index || 0) - (a.lastAccessed || a.index || 0));
  return aiTabs[0];
}

async function extractFromTargetTab() {
  const targetTab = await findTargetAIChatTab();
  if (!targetTab) {
    setStatus("⚠️ لم يتم العثور على تبويب مفتوح لـ Gemini أو ChatGPT!", "#fbbf24");
    return null;
  }

  setStatus(`⏳ جاري سحب المحادثة من تبويب (${targetTab.title.slice(0, 25)})...`, "#38bdf8");

  try {
    await chrome.scripting.executeScript({
      target: { tabId: targetTab.id },
      files: ["zip_builder.js", "content.js"]
    });
  } catch (e) {}

  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    // Safety timeout so popup NEVER hangs for 30 minutes
    const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
      setStatus("⚠️ التبويب في الخلفية متجمد بسبب نظام أندرويد. افتح صفحة الدردشة واضغط على الزر العائم 🗂️ بداخلها!", "#fbbf24");
      resolve(null);
    }, 10000);

    chrome.tabs.sendMessage(targetTab.id, { action: "EXTRACT_FULL_CHAT", autoScroll: false }, (res) => {
      clearTimeout(timeoutId);
      if (chrome.runtime.lastError || !res || !res.ok) {
        setStatus("⚠️ افتح تبويب الدردشة واضغط على الزر العائم 🗂️ أسفل يسار الشاشة للسحب المباشر!", "#fbbf24");
        resolve(null);
      } else {
        resolve(res.data);
      }
    });
  });
}

function dataUrlToUint8Array(dataUrl) {
  const parts = dataUrl.split(",");
  const byteString = atob(parts[1]);
  const arr = new Uint8Array(byteString.length);
  for (let i = 0; i < byteString.length; i++) arr[i] = byteString.charCodeAt(i);
  return arr;
}

function exportChatsDual(chatsToExport, exportLabel = "ALL") {

  txt += `• ملف المرفقات المضغوط المرتبط بهذا النص: ${totalAttachments > 0 ? zipFilename : "لا توجد مرفقات"}\\n`;
  txt += "--------------------------------------------------------------------------------\\n";
  txt += "💡 [ملاحظة توجيهية للذكاء الاصطناعي عند قراءة هذا الملف]:\\n";
  txt += "هذا الملف يحتوي على النص الكامل للمحادثات مقسماً بوضوح بين منصتي (Gemini) و (ChatGPT).\\n";
  txt += "تم فصل الصور والملفات في ملف ZIP مستقل لسرعة قراءتك للنص. ستجد مكان كل صورة أو ملف\\n";
  txt += "بطاقة تعريفية تحتوي على (معرّف المرفق ID + المسار داخل الـ ZIP + الوصف). إذا احتجت لفحص\\n";
  txt += "أي صورة أو ملف برمجي أثناء النقاش، اطلب من المستخدم رفع الملف المذكور بالاسم في البطاقة.\\n";
  txt += "================================================================================\\n\\n";

  txt += "📑 [فهرس المحادثات المضمنة في هذا الملف]:\\n";
  chatsToExport.forEach((c, idx) => {
    const icon = c.platform === "Gemini" ? "🟦 [GEMINI]" : "🟩 [CHATGPT]";
    const attCount = c.attachments ? c.attachments.length : 0;
    txt += `  ${idx + 1}. ${icon} | المعرف: (${c.chatId}) | العنوان: ${c.title} | الرسائل: ${c.messageCount} | المرفقات: ${attCount}\\n`;
  });
  txt += "\\n================================================================================\\n\\n";

  chatsToExport.forEach((chat, idx) => {
    const banner = chat.platform === "Gemini"
      ? "🟦 🌐 [منصة المحادثة: GOOGLE GEMINI]"
      : "🟩 🤖 [منصة المحادثة: OPENAI CHATGPT]";

    txt += `╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗\\n`;
    txt += `  محادثة رقم (#${idx + 1}) | ${banner}\\n`;
    txt += `  • معرف المحادثة (Chat ID) : ${chat.chatId}\\n`;
    txt += `  • عنوان المحادثة          : ${chat.title}\\n`;
    txt += `  • تاريخ الحفظ             : ${chat.date}\\n`;
    txt += `  • الرابط الأصلي           : ${chat.url}\\n`;
    txt += `  • عدد الرسائل             : ${chat.messageCount} | عدد المرفقات: ${chat.attachments ? chat.attachments.length : 0}\\n`;
    txt += `╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝\\n\\n`;

    chat.messages.forEach((m) => {
      const speakerTag = m.role === "User"
        ? `👤 [المستخدم -> موجه إلى ${chat.platform}] (رسالة #${m.index})`
        : `🤖 [${m.role}] (رد #${m.index})`;

      txt += `${speakerTag}:\\n${m.text}\\n\\n--------------------------------------------------------------------------------\\n\\n`;
    });

    txt += `\\n════════════════════ [نهاية محادثة #${idx + 1} (${chat.platform} - ${chat.chatId})] ════════════════════\\n\\n\\n`;
  });

  const txtBlob = new Blob([txt], { type: "text/plain;charset=utf-8" });
  const txtUrl = URL.createObjectURL(txtBlob);
  const aTxt = document.createElement("a");
  aTxt.href = txtUrl;
  aTxt.download = `${baseFilename}.txt`;
  aTxt.click();

  if (totalAttachments > 0) {
    const zip = new window.SimpleZip();
    const manifestJson = {
      exportDate: new Date().toISOString(),
      linkedTextFile: `${baseFilename}.txt`,
      totalAttachments,
      files: []
    };

    chatsToExport.forEach((chat) => {
      (chat.attachments || []).forEach((att) => {
        manifestJson.files.push({
          id: att.id,
          chatId: chat.chatId,
          platform: chat.platform,
          zipPath: att.zipPath,
          type: att.type,
          alt: att.alt,
          originalUrl: att.originalUrl
        });

        if (att.dataUrl) {
          try {
            zip.addFile(att.zipPath, dataUrlToUint8Array(att.dataUrl));
          } catch (e) {
            zip.addTextFile(att.zipPath + ".url.txt", att.originalUrl);
          }
        } else {
          zip.addTextFile(att.zipPath + ".url.txt", att.originalUrl);
        }
      });
    });

    zip.addTextFile("attachments_index.json", JSON.stringify(manifestJson, null, 2));
    const zipBlob = zip.generateBlob();
    const zipUrl = URL.createObjectURL(zipBlob);
    setTimeout(() => {
      const aZip = document.createElement("a");
      aZip.href = zipUrl;
      aZip.download = zipFilename;
      aZip.click();
    }, 600);

    setStatus(`✅ تم تنزيل الـ TXT + ملف الـ ZIP (${totalAttachments} مرفق)!`, "#4ade80");
  } else {
    setStatus(`✅ تم تنزيل ملف الـ TXT بنجاح!`, "#4ade80");
  }
}

  1. لماذا ظهر خطأ في المرة الأولى؟ على الكمبيوتر، الإضافة تفتح كنافذة صغيرة فوق صفحة الدردشة، فيكون التبويب النشط (activeTab) هو صفحة Gemini أو ChatGPT. ، وعندما بحث الكود عن التبويب النشط وجد نفسه بدلاً من صفحة الدردشة!
  2. لماذا علقت في المرة الثانية لمدة نصف ساعة بدون توقف؟ عندما انتقلت إلى تبويب الإضافة في Kiwi، أصبحت صفحة الدردشة (Gemini أو ChatGPT) في الخلفية (Background Tab). نظام أندرويد ومتصفح Kiwi يقومان بتجميد التمرير (Scroll) والمؤقتات الزمنية (setTimeout) في التبويبات الخلفية لتوفير البطارية، فظل الكود ينتظر انتهاء التمرير التلقائي إلى ما لا نهاية!

🛠️ الحل الجذري في النسخة الجديدة (V3 - Kiwi & Mobile Fix):

قمت بتعديل هندسة الإضافة بالكامل لتعمل على متصفح Kiwi والموبايل والكمبيوتر بسلاسة تامة:

  1. إضافة زر عائم مباشر داخل صفحة Gemini و ChatGPT (🗂️):
    • بمجرد فتحك لموقع Gemini أو ChatGPT، ستظهر لك أيقونة عائمة صغيرة 🗂️ أسفل يسار الشاشة.
    • عندما تضغط عليها وأنت داخل صفحة الدردشة نفسها، تفتح لك لوحة سريعة بضغطة واحدة تسحب المحادثة بالتمرير التلقائي أمام عينك (لأن الصفحة نشطة أمامك فلن يجمدها أندرويد أبداً!) وتحفظها في الأرشيف أو تحملها فوراً في ثوانٍ.
  2. باحث التبويبات الذكي (Smart Tab Finder) داخل صفحة الإضافة:
    • حتى لو فتحت صفحة الإضافة المستقلة في Kiwi، لم تعد تبحث عن activeTab، بل تبحث في كل تبويبات المتصفح المفتوحة عن آخر تبويب مفتوح لـ Gemini أو ChatGPT وتسحب منه فوراً بدون التمرير الخلفي المتجمد.
  3. حماية ضد التعليق (Safety Timeout):
    • أضفت مؤقت حماية (4.5 ثانية لكل مرفق و10 ثوانٍ للاتصال) بحيث يستحيل أن تعلق الأداة أو تتجمد مرة أخرى.
